articles.title: From Corpora to Co-Evolving Capabilities: Capability-Centric Data Design for Generalist Image Generation
articles.content: Large-scale image generation has benefited from advances in data scale, quality, rebalancing, and recaptioning, yet conventional pipelines typically optimize task-specific datasets in isolation. A central challenge is not only how to curate each task-specific corpus, but also how to organize heterogeneous supervision according to the dependencies among generative capabilities. We present a \textbf{capability-driven data infrastructure} that couples capability-specific supervision construction with capability-aligned curriculum scheduling. Its three specialized yet interoperable data engines build complementary relational supervision for text-image grounding, inter-image transformation, and image-knowledge association, while caption experts align T2I and editing supervision across tasks and granularities. A multi-stage curriculum jointly evolves task composition, visual-concept distribution, data quality, and image resolution along the dependency order of capability acquisition, with capability-aware evaluation closing the loop through targeted retrieval, expert construction, and gap-aware resampling. At scale, the framework curates a 440M-image T2I corpus, 120M editing pairs, and over 27M image-entity pairs. With this infrastructure, we train multimodal diffusion models at two scales from scratch, with 3B and 6B sizes respectively. We conduct quantitative evaluation on CPI-Bench, along with qualitative evaluations across diverse text-to-image and editing scenarios. Experimental results present broad visual coverage, versatile rendering, and effective transfer across generative capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 从Corpora到共同演化的能力:通用图像生成的能力-计算机数据设计
articles.content_zh: 大规模图像生成得益于数据规模、质量、再平衡和重述方面的进展,但传统管道通常孤立地优化特定任务数据集。 中心挑战不仅在于如何管理每个具体任务机构,而且在于如何根据基因能力的依赖性组织不同的监督。 我们提出一个\textbf{由能力驱动的数据基础设施},即结合能力调整的课程时间安排,进行针对能力的监管建设。 其三个专业但可互操作的数据引擎为文本图像定位、图像间转换和图像知识协会建立了互补的关系监督,而字幕专家则对T2I和跨任务和颗粒的编辑监督进行协调。 多阶段课程沿着能力获取的依赖顺序,共同发展任务构成、视觉概念分布、数据质量和图像分辨率,通过目标检索、专家构建和对差距的认识再现,对能力的认识评价关闭了循环。 在规模上,框架将一个440M-图像的T2Ibel,120M编辑对,以及超过27M图像实体对. 有了这种基础设施,我们从零开始在两个尺度上培训多式联运模式,分别为3B和6B尺寸。 我们对消费物价指数-奔驰进行定量评价,同时对不同文本到图像和编辑方案进行定性评价。 实验结果提供了广泛的视觉覆盖面、多功能渲染以及跨基因能力的有效转移。

articles.title: EDITBRIDGE: Towards Faithful and Efficient Ultra-High-Resolution Image Editing
articles.content: High-resolution image editing is increasingly demanded in professional workflows, yet existing diffusion-based models remain constrained to resolutions below 1K due to quadratic attention complexity and prohibitive memory requirements. A prevalent workaround employs a two-stage pipeline: editing at low resolution followed by independent super-resolution. However, this approach suffers from two critical issues: information divergence, where hallucinated details contradict the original high-resolution (HR) source, and texture degradation, manifesting as over-smoothed or over-sharpened artifacts. We propose EditBridge, a diffusion bridge framework for efficient ultra high-resolution editing. Unlike conventional diffusion that regenerates from noise, we formulate refinement as structured data-to-data translation from the low-resolution (LR) edited result to its HR counterpart, explicitly conditioned on the original HR source to preserve authentic details. To efficiently incorporate HR source guidance, we introduce a prior-guided block-wise sparse attention mechanism that exploits semantic correspondence from first-stage editing to constrain cross-image interactions to spatially aligned regions, significantly reducing computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EditBridge achieves high-fidelity editing with superior perceptual quality at resolutions up to 4K, delivering 3.6--8.4$\times$ speedup at 2K and enabling practical 4K editing in 61 seconds.

articles.title_zh: EDITBRIDGE: 迈向忠实高效的超高分辨率图像编辑
articles.content_zh: 在专业工作流程中,对高分辨率图像编辑的需求日益增加,但由于四重关注的复杂性和令人望而却步的内存要求,现有的基于传播的模型仍然受到低于1K的决议的限制. 一个普遍的工作是采用两阶段的管道:低分辨率编辑,然后是独立的超级分辨率。 然而,这种方法有两个关键问题:信息差异,即幻觉细节与原始的高分辨率来源相矛盾,以及纹理退化,表现为过度沉闷或过度萎缩的文物。 我们提议编辑Bridge, 一个传播桥架框架 高效的超高分辨率编辑。 与从噪音中再生的常规扩散不同,我们提出完善,作为结构化的数据对数据翻译,从低分辨率(LR)编辑的结果到人力资源对应结果,明确以人力资源原始来源为条件,以保存真实细节。 为了有效地纳入人力资源源指导,我们采用了一种先导的零散注意力机制,利用第一阶段编辑时的语义通信,将跨图像交互限制在空间对齐的区域,大大减少计算间接费用。 广泛的实验证明,EditBridge在分辨率最高达4K时,实现了具有较高知觉质量的高精度编辑,在2K时提供3.6-8.4美元\时速,并允许在61秒内进行实用的4K编辑.

articles.title: Primitive Representation Learning for Unsupervised Dynamic Contrast Enhanced MRI Reconstruction
articles.content: Reliable quantitative analysis of dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI requires high-quality spatiotemporal reconstructions at high undersampling rates. Scan-specific reconstructions using Gaussian and Gabor primitives have shown promising results without the need for large training datasets, but have not addressed the additional dimension of dynamic contrast. We propose a multi-dimensional, primitive based framework for dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI reconstruction that disentangles the underlying anatomy, the dynamic contrast enhancement, and residual motion into separate temporal basis functions, thereby enabling a geometrical interpretation of the representation. We show that this architecture achieves performance competitive with conventional reconstruction methods, both in reconstruction quality and in the accuracy of extracted aorta and kidney enhancement curves. The modular tier design extends naturally to additional dynamic factors and higher acceleration rates. Code available at https://github.com/compai-lab/ 2026-GaborDCE-spieker.

articles.title_zh: 为无监督的动态对比增强核磁共振进行初级代表性学习 重建
articles.content_zh: 对动态对比增强的核磁共振进行可靠的定量分析,需要以高抽样率进行高质量的瞬间重建。 使用高斯琴和加博尔原始语的扫描特异性重建,在不需要大型训练数据集的情况下,显示出了有希望的结果,但没有解决动态对比的附加层面. 我们提出一个多维、原始的框架,用于动态对比增强的核磁共振重建,将基础解剖学、动态对比增强和剩余运动分解成单独的时序函数,从而能够对表示进行几何解释。 我们表明,这种建筑在重建质量和提取的主动脉和肾脏增强曲线的准确性方面都与传统的重建方法具有竞争力。 模块级设计自然延伸至额外的动态因素和更高的加速度. 在https://github.com/compai-lab/2026-GaborDCE-spieker上可以找到代码.

articles.title: Optimize Your Sampling: Tuned Diffusion Sampling with Bayesian Optimization
articles.content: Sampling from a diffusion model typically requires many forward passes through a large neural network, making generation computationally expensive. While much work has focused on efficient solvers and samplers, comparatively little attention has been paid to selecting the sampling timesteps themselves. A recent line of work optimizes theoretically derived surrogates for sample quality rather than the quality metric itself. We propose Optimizing Your Sampling (OYS), which instead treats timestep selection as a black-box optimization problem, optimizing the target metric directly with Bayesian optimization. OYS outperforms both the default schedules and those of Align Your Steps on text-to-image generation, and improves over the default schedules on inpainting and other image tasks, in both quantitative and human evaluations. OYS requires no additional training, is applicable even to distilled models, and improves both simple and sophisticated samplers such as Euler and DPM-Solver++. A 5-step OYS schedule retains 89%-94% of the quality of a 50-step schedule while reducing inference cost by 10x.

articles.title_zh: 优化你的取样:与巴伊西亚优化的土质扩散取样
articles.content_zh: 从扩散模型中取样通常需要许多前行经过大型神经网络,使生成在计算上变得昂贵. 尽管许多工作都侧重于高效的解析器和取样器,但相对较少注意自行选择取样时间步骤。 最近的工作线优化了理论上衍生出来的样本质量替代物,而不是质量衡量标准本身. 我们提议优化你的样本(OYS),它将时间步选择视为黑盒优化问题,直接通过巴伊西亚优化优化目标度量. OYS在文本到图像生成上超越了默认的进度表和“对齐您的步骤”的进度表,并在定量和人类评价方面改进了印画和其他图像任务的默认进度表。 OYS不需要额外的训练,甚至适用于蒸馏模型,并且改进了Euler和DPM-Solver++等简单和复杂的采样器. 5步的OYS计划保留50步计划质量的89%-94%,同时将推论成本降低10x.

articles.title: Harnessing Magnitude-Only and Complex Measurements for Improved Dynamic MRI Reconstruction with Learned Priors
articles.content: MRI reconstruction methods for undersampled k-space data naturally utilize complex-valued measurements. Parallel developments in sparse phase retrieval have shown that magnitude-only measurements may provide complementary information for signal recovery. However, their use in MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, due to lack of practical settings where informative magnitude measurements can be obtained without additional scan time. In this work, we investigate the use of auxiliary k-space magnitude information for accelerated steady-state dynamic MRI reconstruction, and demonstrate strong consistency of k-space magnitudes across time-frames. Building on this observation, we propose $\mathbb{C}+\text{Mag}$, a magnitude-informed physics-driven deep learning reconstruction method. The proposed method employs an ADMM-based unrolling framework with a novel magnitude-aware data-fidelity formulation, where quadratically smoothed optimization and momentum-based updates are introduced to address the non-differentiability and non-convexity of the magnitude constraints. Experiments on retrospectively undersampled cine MRI and phase-contrast flow MRI datasets, as well as prospectively undersampled real-time cine MRI acquisitions, demonstrate improved artifact suppression, sharper anatomical recovery, and better preservation of phase information compared to conventional PD-DL methods, which is further supported through blinded expert reader evaluations.

articles.title_zh: 利用强度和复杂度量法改进动态核磁共振重建
articles.content_zh: 对K-空间数据进行不足取样的核磁共振重建方法自然利用了复杂值的测量。 零星相检索的平行发展显示,仅限量测量可以为信号恢复提供补充信息。 然而,由于缺乏实际环境,无法在没有额外扫描时间的情况下获得信息量的测量,它们在核磁共振重建中的使用基本上仍未得到探讨。 在这项工作中,我们调查利用辅助的k-空间尺度信息加速稳定状态动态核磁共振重建的情况,并显示各时间段的k-空间尺度的强烈一致性。 基于这一观察,我们提出 $\ mathbb{C}+\text{Mag} $,一种量级的物理学驱动的深度学习重建方法。 拟议方法采用基于ADMM的无滚动框架,采用新型的量级认识数据可靠性配制,采用四平整优化和以势头为基础的更新,以解决量级限制的无差异性和不一致性问题。 关于回溯性下取样的焚化核磁共振和相位连续流磁共振数据集的实验,以及预期下取样的实时焚化核磁共振采集的实验显示,与传统的PD-DL方法相比,文物抑制得到改进,解剖恢复更加尖锐,并更好地保存相位信息,通过盲目专家的读者评价进一步支持了这一方法。

articles.title: Plug-and-Play Traffic Element Awareness for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Traffic elements such as traffic lights and road signs play a fundamental role in human driving decisions and should naturally influence end-to-end driving performance. However, existing end-to-end driving research predominantly focuses on dynamic road participants (e.g., vehicles and pedestrians), while the role of traffic elements remains largely unexplored. The community still lacks a systematic study quantifying their impact, largely because public datasets rarely provide structured traffic-element annotations and modern driving systems vary widely in architecture and training paradigm. In this work, we present the first systematic investigation of traffic element awareness for end-to-end autonomous driving. We construct a unified research infrastructure by augmenting multiple public driving datasets with comprehensive traffic-element annotations. To support diverse model families, we adopt a minimal and universal integration design that incorporates traffic-element signals into existing pipelines in a plug-and-play manner with negligible architectural modification. We evaluate this design across modern paradigms, including perception-prediction-planning pipelines, vision-language-action models (VLA), regression-based planners, diffusion-based policies, and trajectory-scoring frameworks, on nuScenes, NAVSIM-v1, NAVSIM-v2, and Bench2Drive. Across all paradigms and datasets, this simple integration consistently improves driving performance, demonstrating that traffic element awareness provides a robust and generalizable signal for end-to-end driving systems. Notably, on the challenging NAVSIM-v2 benchmark, our approach significantly improves state-of-the-art architectures and data pipelines, establishing a new state of the art.

articles.title_zh: 终端至终端自动驾驶的插件和管道交通要素意识
articles.content_zh: 交通灯和道路标志等交通要素在人行驶决策中发挥着根本作用,自然应影响端到端的驾驶性能. 然而,现有的端对端驾驶研究主要侧重于动态道路参与者(如车辆和行人),而交通要素的作用基本上仍未被探讨. 社区仍然缺乏对其影响进行量化的系统研究,主要是因为公共数据集很少提供结构化的交通要素说明,现代驾驶系统在建筑和培训模式上差异很大. 在这项工作中,我们提出了对交通要素意识的第一次系统调查,以便进行端到端自主驾驶。 我们通过增加多个公共驱动数据集并配有综合交通内容说明,构建统一的研究基础设施. 为了支持不同的模范家庭,我们采用了一种最低限度的和普遍的一体化设计,以插座和游戏的方式将交通要素信号纳入现有管道,对建筑进行微小的修改。 我们通过现代范式,包括感知预测规划管道、视觉语言行动模型、回归规划者、传播政策和轨迹评分框架,在nuScenes、NAVSIM-v1、NAVSIM-v2和Bench2Drive上评价这一设计。 在所有范式和数据集中,这种简单的整合不断提高驾驶性能,表明交通元件意识为端到端的驾驶系统提供了有力而普遍的信号. 值得注意的是,在具有挑战性的NAVSIM-v2基准上,我们的方法大大改进了最先进的结构和数据管道,建立了新的技术水平。

articles.title: Deep Academic Survey: Stateful Agentic Closed-Loop Paradigm for Academic Survey Automation
articles.content: Academic surveys play a central role in organizing rapidly expanding scholarly literature, yet their construction requires extensive paper analysis, coherent knowledge organization, fine-grained citation support, and reliable manuscript assembly. Existing Deep Research and automated survey generation systems address parts of this process, but typically do not coordinate paper understanding, literature organization, evidence-grounded drafting, and manuscript validation through a shared, revisable state. We introduce DAS, a stateful agentic framework for generating publication-oriented academic surveys. Its key idea is to separate reusable paper analysis from topic-specific manuscript construction. DAS builds on DAS-2M, a dynamically updated metadata lake containing survey-oriented representations of approximately two million papers. Its agents maintain explicit literature, organization, writing, and finalization states through candidate-grounded taxonomy planning, reverse paper-to-section routing, and hierarchical claim and citation planning. Semantic review reactivates only the affected writing states for repair and reevaluation, forming a scoped closed loop with deterministic validation. We further introduce DAS-Bench, a 30-topic benchmark, together with DAS-Eval, which assesses scholarly citation quality, taxonomic synthesis, hierarchical discourse, and manuscript assembly reliability through 16 criteria. Among systems evaluated on all 30 topics, DAS achieves the highest average in all four dimensions, with an overall score of 4.34 compared with 4.03 for the strongest competitor, and the same ordering is preserved on the matched 21-topic CS subset. Blinded expert evaluation further prefers DAS to Naive RAG on 27 of 30 topics and to AutoSurvey on 19 of 21 shared CS topics. The project page is available at https://zhikaixu24.github.io/projects/DAS/.

articles.title_zh: 深学术 调查:学术调查自动化的国有代理闭环式示范
articles.content_zh: 学术调查在组织迅速扩展的学术文献方面发挥着中心作用,但是其构建需要广泛的论文分析,连贯的知识组织,精细的引用支持,以及可靠的手稿组装. 现有的Deep Research和自动调查生成系统处理这个过程的部分内容,但通常不协调对文件的理解,文献组织,证据基础的起草,以及手稿通过共享的,可修改的状态进行验证. 我们引入了DAS,这是一个以出版为导向的学术调查的高效框架。 其主要想法是将可重复使用的纸张分析与针对特定主题的手稿构建分开. DAS基于DAS-2M,这是一个动态更新的元数据湖,包含约200万份面向调查的论文。 其代理人通过候选人的分类规划、反向纸面到片面的路线、分级主张和引用规划,保持明确的文献、组织、写作和定稿状态。 语义审查只恢复了受影响的写作状态进行修复和重新评价,形成范围封闭的循环,具有确定性的验证. 我们进一步采用了DAS-Bench, 与DAS-Eval一起,通过16项标准评估学术引用质量、分类综合、分级论述和手稿组装可靠性。 在对全部30个专题评价的系统中,DAS在所有四个维度中的平均成绩最高,总体得分为4.34分,而最强的竞争对手为4.03分,对对应的21个专题CS子集也保留了同样的顺序. 盲目专家评价进一步倾向于DAS在30个专题中的27个与Naive RAG,在21个共享CS专题中的19个与AutoSurvey. 项目网页见https://zhikaixu24.github.io/projects/DAS/。

articles.title: Initialization-Free Bundle Adjustment Revisited: A Controlled Experimental Study
articles.content: Initialization-free bundle adjustment (InitFree BA) aims to recover camera poses and scene structure directly from image observations, avoiding the geometric initialization stages of conventional structure-from-motion pipelines. Recent methods based on Object-Space Error (OSE) formulations and Variable Projection (VarPro) show encouraging optimization behavior from random camera configurations. However, existing evaluations primarily measure optimization success, leaving unclear whether a low OSE objective yields a valid metric 3D reconstruction. We revisit InitFree BA experimentally through a unified evaluation framework combining a C++ implementation of existing OSE formulations with a Blender-based dataset generator providing exact ground truth and controlled camera configurations and observation densities. Our experiments reveal a previously overlooked optimization--reconstruction gap: projective solutions with similarly low OSE values can lead to substantially different Euclidean reconstructions after metric upgrade. We identify initialization priors, landmark observation density, and metric-upgrade stability as key factors governing reconstruction success. Overall, our results suggest that the main challenge of InitFree BA is not merely minimizing OSE objectives, but obtaining projective reconstructions that admit reliable metric upgrade. We believe that the proposed benchmark, implementation, and analysis establish stronger experimental foundations for future research on initialization-free bundle adjustment, a problem largely unexplored within the computer vision community. Project page is available at https://github.com/simonwebertum/InitFreeBA.git.

articles.title_zh: 初始化- 自由套装调整 重审: 受控实验研究
articles.content_zh: 初始化无捆绑调整(InitFree BA)旨在直接从图像观测中恢复相机姿势和场景结构,避免常规结构的几何初始化阶段-从运动管道. 基于对象-空间误差(OSE)配方和可变投影(VarPro)的近期方法显示从随机相机配置中可以鼓励优化行为. 然而,现有的评价主要衡量优化成功与否,因此尚不清楚一个低水平的OSE目标能否产生有效的三维重建。 我们通过一个统一的评价框架,试验性地重新审视InitFree BA,将C++实施现有的OSE配方与一个基于Blender的数据集生成器结合起来,提供准确的地面真象和可控制的相机配置以及观测密度。 我们的实验揭示了一个以前被忽视的优化-重建差距:具有同样低的OSE值的投影式解决方案可以导致在度量升级后欧几里得体的重建大不相同. 我们确定初始化前科、标志性观测密度和度量升级稳定性是决定重建成功的关键因素。 总体来看,我们的结果显示,Initfree BA的主要挑战不仅仅是将OSE的目标降到最低,而是获得能够接受可靠度量升级的预测性重建。 我们认为,拟议的基准、执行和分析为今后关于无初始化捆绑调整的研究奠定了更牢固的实验基础,这个问题在计算机视觉界内基本上没有得到探讨。 项目网页见https://github.com/simonwebertum/InitFreeBA.git。

articles.title: Automated ACL Footprint Identification Using 3D Deep Learning
articles.content: One of the most common reasons for anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction failure is femoral tunnel malpositioning (ACL footprint center and tunnel orientation). Such failures may lead to the development of meniscal pathology and osteoarthritis. Accurate ACL femoral footprint identification is therefore essential for precise tunnel placement, restoration of the native knee joint mechanics, post-surgical knee joint health and prevention of graft failure. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) bring new opportunities to improve image-guided orthopedic surgery. However, at present, existing AI research focuses primarily on ACL segmentation and rupture classification based on pre- and post-operative magnetic resonance (MR) images. Identification of the ACL footprint center using deep learning methods has not been thoroughly researched. Thus, the purpose of this study is to explore 3D deep learning models for ACL femoral footprint identification directly from 3D MR images. Two comprehensive 3D deep learning architectures were developed: a 3D graph convolutional neural network-based geometric model applied to 3D femoral meshes; and a 3D landmark-enhanced identification model based on 3D MR images. A total of 4883 right and 3087 left knee image sets were used from a publicly available database. Eighty percent (80%) were applied to model generation, and twenty percent (20%) were preserved for model testing. Both models achieved excellent performance; however, the image-based method outperformed the model-based method (average error of 2.1mm vs 2.8 mm). Thus, 3D deep learning provides a feasible clinical approach for ACL footprint localization and has the potential to improve ACL reconstruction footprint accuracy.

articles.title_zh: 使用3D深层学习进行自动ACL脚印识别
articles.content_zh: 造成前十字韧带(ACL)重建失败的最常见原因之一是畸形隧道的错位(ACL脚印中心和隧道方向). 这种失败可能导致脑膜病理学和骨质炎的发展。 因此,准确的ACL足迹识别对于准确的隧道布局,恢复本土膝关节力学,手术后膝关节健康以及防止膝关节衰竭至关重要. 人工智能(AI)近期的进步为改进图像引导的矫形手术带来了新的机遇. 然而,目前,现有的AI研究主要侧重于根据操作前和操作后磁共振(MR)图像进行的ACL分解和断裂分类. 尚未彻底研究使用深入学习方法确定ACL足迹中心的问题。 因此,本研究的目的是探索直接从3D MR图像中识别ACL femory足迹的3D深层学习模型. 开发了两个全面的3D深层学习架构:一个应用到3D femoral meshes的3D图解神经网络基几何模型;和一个基于3D MR图像的3D标志性增强识别模型. 共有4883套右膝和3087套左膝的图像从一个公开的数据库使用。 80%(80%)用于模型生成,20%(20%)用于模型测试。 这两个模型都取得了优异的性能;然而,基于图像的方法的性能超过了基于模型的方法(平均错误为2.1毫米对2.8毫米). 因此,3D深度学习为ACL足迹本地化提供了可行的临床方法,并有可能提高ACL重建足迹的准确性.

articles.title: Memory Tree Guided Key Frame Querying for Efficient 3D Question Answering
articles.content: Answering questions accurately and efficiently in embodied scenarios presents significant challenges due to limited computational and memory resources for Vision Language Model (VLM) inference. Existing methods adopt visual search key frame retrieval method to select critical question-related key frames for VLM input. However, visual search methods are inefficient because they require visual search among thousands of video frames for each individual user query. In this work, we propose a memory tree guided key frame selection paradigm for efficient 3D question answering in embodied scenarios. Our method leverages a compact and reusable 3D scene representation, termed MemTree3D, which supports real-time online construction leveraging camera 6-DoF poses. MemTree3D captures multi-level 3D scene information, enabling a Large Language Model to efficiently query and retrieve question-relevant key frames through our scoring-based frame selection without reprocessing the entire video stream. On OpenEQA, our method improves the LLM-Match of GPT-4o by 17.4%, LLaVA-OneVision-7B by 5.8%, outperforms existing visual search methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/MemTree3D

articles.title_zh: 内存树导键框架查询高效3D问答
articles.content_zh: 由于VLM(VLM)推论的计算和内存资源有限,在包含的各种假设中准确和高效地回答问题带来了重大挑战。 现有方法采用视觉搜索密钥帧检索方法,为VLM输入选择与关键问题相关的密钥帧. 然而,视觉搜索方法效率低下,因为每个用户查询都需要数千个视频帧的视觉搜索. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个由记忆树指导的关键框架选择范式,以便在包含的情景中高效的3D问题回答. 我们的方法利用了一种紧凑且可重复使用的3D场景表现,称为MemTree3D,它支持实时在线构造,利用相机6-DoF的姿态. MemTree3D捕捉多层次的3D场景信息,使得一个大语言模型能够通过我们基于评分的帧选择来高效查询和检索与问题相关的密钥帧,而无需再处理整个视频流. 在OpenEQA上,我们的方法将GPT-4o的LLM-Match改进了17.4%,LLaVA-One Vision-7B改进了5.8%,超过了现有的视觉搜索方法. 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/MemTree3D.

articles.title: AViTS: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Token Selection for Efficient Dynamic-Resolution Generation
articles.content: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve high-quality generation but are costly due to iterative sampling. Dynamic-resolution sampling reduces early-stage cost by denoising at low resolution; however, uniformly upsampling all latent tokens at resolution transitions incurs redundant computation and may degrade fine-detail consistency. Existing partial upsampling strategies typically rely on local latent structure cues or single-step statistics, making it difficult to jointly capture token-text semantic relevance and token-wise representation dynamics across diffusion steps. We propose AViTS, an adaptive spatiotemporal token selection framework for dynamic-resolution DiTs. AViTS models spatial importance via latent-text attention and temporal importance via token-level feature variation across diffusion timesteps, and fuses them to enable spatiotemporal importance-aware selective upsampling: it prioritizes resolution refinement for critical tokens while deferring less important ones, thereby reducing redundant high-resolution computation and improving the quality-efficiency trade-off. AViTS achieves up to 6.34x on FLUX and nearly 9x FLOPs reduction on Qwen-Image-Edit and FLUX.1-Kontext-dev, orthogonal to distillation, quantization, and feature caching, and reaching 14.76x with distilled models. Code: https://github.com/QHR69/AViTS
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AVITS: 适应性 Spatiotemporal 选择高效动态解析生成
articles.content_zh: 扩散变压器(DiTs)实现了高质量的生成,但由于迭代采样,成本很高. 动态分辨率采样通过低分辨率去诺来降低早期成本;但是,在分辨率过渡时统一更新所有潜在符号需要进行冗余计算,并可能降低详细一致性。 现有的部分抽样战略通常依靠当地潜在结构提示或单步统计,因此难以联合捕捉到象征性文字语义相关性和各种传播步骤的象征性表达动态。 我们提出AVitS,一个适应性的Spatiotal符号选择框架,用于动态分辨率DiTs. AVitS模型通过潜在文字注意的空间重要性和通过信使级特征在扩散时段的变异而具有的时间重要性,并将它们连接起来,以便能够对瞬间重要性-有选择性地进行抽样:它优先考虑关键信使的分辨率改进,同时推迟不太重要的信使,从而减少多余的高分辨率计算,改进质量效率的权衡。 AVitS在FLUX上实现高达6.34x,在Quen-Image-Edit和FLUX.1-Kontex-dev上实现近9xFLOP的还原,正交以蒸馏,量化,和特征缓存,并以蒸馏模型达到14.76x. 代码:https://github.com/QHR69/AVitS

articles.title: GS-Voxel: Fitting-Free Structured Latents for Large-Scale 3DGS Generation
articles.content: Many scalable latent 3D generators operate on structured tensors, whereas pre-optimized 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructions are unordered, spatially irregular, and vary widely in primitive count. We present GS-Voxel, a fitting-free structured latent framework, and evaluate it for large-scale aerial 3D Gaussian scene generation. GS-Voxel deterministically converts a compatible pre-optimized 3DGS reconstruction into sparse active voxels without additional per-scene optimization, retaining the sub-voxel positions and rendering attributes of the selected primitives. A GS-specific factorized VAE then separately encodes voxel geometry and local Gaussian attributes into sparse 3D latents whose size grows with the number of occupied voxels rather than being limited by a fixed scene-wide primitive count. We train image-conditioned flow models in the GS-Voxel latent space to generate aerial 3DGS scenes. A key application enabled by GS-Voxel is large-area scene generation: overlap-aware tiled inference extends synthesis beyond a single training crop conditioned on satellite-view images. Our results show that GS-Voxel provides structured latents for pre-optimized aerial 3DGS reconstructions, with latent capacity that grows with the number of occupied voxels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GS-Voxel:大型3DGS无缝结构梯队 生成
articles.content_zh: 许多可伸缩的潜在3D发电机在结构式的变压器上运行,而预优化的3D高斯电镀(3DGS)重建则无序,空间不规则,在原始计数上差异很大. 我们提出GS-Voxel, 一个无结构化的潜在框架, 并评估它大规模航空 3D高斯场景生成。 GS-Voxel定型将兼容的预优化的3DGS重建转换为零散的活性Voxel,而不需要额外的单色优化,保留了子voxel位置,并渲染选定原始人的属性. 一个GS特异性因素化的VAE然后将voxel几何学和局部高斯属性分别编码成稀疏的3D潜质,其体积随占用的voxel数量而增长,而不是受到固定的全景原始数的限制. 我们在GS-Voxel潜伏空间中训练有图像条件的流量模型,以产生空中3DGS场景. GS-Voxel所启用的一个关键应用程序是大面积场景生成:重叠感推论将合成扩展到卫星视像条件下的单一训练作物之外。 我们的结果表明,GS-Voxel为预先优化的航空3DGS重建提供了结构化的潜伏物,其潜伏能力随占用的Voxel数量而增加。

articles.title: Dual Co-Train: Cross-Dataset Ultrasound Tongue Segmentation Under Extreme Data Scarcity
articles.content: Ultrasound tongue contour segmentation remains challenging under cross-dataset domain shift, where limited annotations, probe variability, and acquisition noise often degrade model generalization. We present a source-free domain adaptation framework for robust ultrasound tongue segmentation built on a lightweight UltraUNet backbone. Starting from a checkpoint pretrained on only five labeled source images, simulating an underfitted constrained source model, the proposed method adapts to a fully-unlabeled target domain by iteratively refining pseudo-labels, filtering unreliable masks with a contour-based quality-control module, and generating target-style synthetic image-mask pairs through a segmentation-guided conditional GAN. The student model is then trained on a mixture of clean pseudo-labeled target images, noisy pseudo-labels with consistency regularization, and synthetic samples, enabling closed-loop adaptation without access to source data. We evaluate the method on 12 source-target transfer pairs across eight ultrasound tongue imaging datasets, and conduct source-size scaling experiments and ablation studies. Across all comparisons, the proposed framework improves segmentation overlap and contour accuracy over the baselines, including supervised ones. These results suggest that task-specific pseudo-label refinement and synthetic target-style augmentation can substantially improve source-free adaptation for ultrasound tongue imaging.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 双联运列车:极端数据稀缺下跨数据集超声波切分
articles.content_zh: 在跨数据集域转移下,超声波舌轮廓分解仍然具有挑战性,其中有限的说明,探针变异,获取噪声往往会降解模型泛化. 我们提出一个无源域适应框架,用于基于一个轻量级UltraUNet主干线的强超声波舌片分。 从仅5个标签源图像上预先训练的检查点开始,模拟一个装配不足的受限源模型,提议的方法通过迭代精炼伪标签来适应一个完全无标签的目标域,用轮廓质控模块过滤不可靠的口罩,并通过分块制导的有条件GAN生成目标式合成图像掩码对. 学生模型随后接受了关于清洁的伪标签目标图像、有一致性规范的吵闹伪标签和合成样本的混合培训,使得无法获取源数据而进行闭路调整。 我们通过8个超声波舌部成像数据集,对12个源-目标传输对进行该方法的评价,并进行源大小缩放实验和衰减研究. 在所有比较中,拟议框架都改进了基线(包括监督基线)的分割重叠和轮廓准确性。 这些结果表明,针对特定任务的伪标签完善和合成目标式增强可以大大改进超声波舌像的无源适应.

articles.title: aDSL: Agentic 3D Creation via Joint Agent-Program Design
articles.content: Programmatic representations provide a compelling paradigm for 3D content creation, enabling fine-grained edits, interpretability, and explicit structural control. Yet, agentic workflows that rely on large language models (LLMs) to author 3D programs remain brittle, often failing to translate high-level intent into consistent low-level geometry. We attribute this fragility to a mismatch between existing programmatic interfaces and the reasoning strengths of LLMs, which favor semantic structure and spatial relations over fragile numeric choices. In this paper, we jointly design an Agent-centric Domain-Specific Language (aDSL) and a role-specialized multi-agent system to close this gap. aDSL bridges semantic logic and geometric constraints by emphasizing composability and spatial reasoning; it enables agents to manipulate geometry through relational operators instead of brittle absolute coordinates. Building on aDSL, our training-free multi-agent system follows a Plan-Execute-Critic loop to decompose requests, synthesize code, and iteratively repair errors and constraint violations using execution feedback. Experiments show that this co-design improves robustness, controllability, and faithfulness to user intent. Our method outperforms prior LLM-based baselines on text-to-shape and image-to-shape tasks while preserving explicit structure, editability, and interpretability. It also enables downstream applications such as articulated object creation and structured scene composition. Our code is available at https://github.com/sig-pku/aDSL.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: aDSL: 通过联合代理-程序设计创建代理 3D
articles.content_zh: 程序表述为三维内容的创建提供了一个令人信服的范例,能够进行精细的编辑、可解释性和明确的结构控制。 然而,依赖于大型语言模型(LLMs)来编写3D程序代理工作流程依然不灵活,往往未能将高层次意图转化为一致的低层次几何. 我们将此脆弱性归因于现有程序接口与LLMs的推理优势之间的不匹配,后者有利于语义结构和空间关系,而不利于脆弱的数字选择。 在本文中,我们联合设计了以代理为中心的域语(aDSL)和角色专用的多代理系统来缩小这一差距. aDSL通过强调相容性和空间推理,将语义逻辑和几何限制联系起来;它使物剂能够通过关系操作员来操纵几何,而不是通过脆性绝对坐标来操纵几何. 在ADSL的基础上,我们无培训的多代理系统遵循一个Plan-Execute-Critic循环,通过执行反馈来解析请求,合成代码,并迭代修复错误和约束违规. 实验显示,这种共同设计可以提高强健性,可控性,以及对用户意图的忠诚度. 我们的方法在文本到形状和图像到形状的任务上超过了先前基于LLM的基线,同时保留了明确的结构,可编辑性和可解释性. 它还可以使下游应用如清晰的物体创建和结构化的场景组成. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/sig-pku/aDSL上查阅。

articles.title: LinCa: Accelerating Diffusion Models via Learnable Decomposed Feature Caching
articles.content: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image and video generation, yet the high computational cost of iterative sampling remains a critical bottleneck for practical deployment. Feature caching has emerged as a promising acceleration paradigm by reusing or predicting intermediate features across timesteps. However, existing training-free methods apply uniform prediction strategies that cannot adapt to the heterogeneous feature dynamics, causing significant quality degradation under high acceleration ratios. We propose LinCa, a feature caching framework based on learnable invertible networks. LinCa decomposes cached features into sub-components with distinct continuity properties via a lightweight invertible network and applies differentiated prediction orders matched to each component. The strict invertibility guarantees lossless reconstruction back to the original feature space, forming a unified Decompose-Predict-Reconstruct pipeline. By training separate predictors for different models and timestep segments, LinCa adapts to heterogeneous feature dynamics. Experiments on FLUX, Qwen-Image, and HunyuanVideo demonstrate that LinCa, with less than 0.2% additional parameters, significantly outperforms existing methods and maintains near-lossless quality at 5-7x speedup. Code: https://github.com/QHR69/LinCa
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LinCa:通过可学习的分解功能缓存加速扩散模型
articles.content_zh: 传播模型在图像和视频生成方面取得了显著成功,然而迭代取样的高计算成本仍然是实际部署的关键瓶颈。 通过跨时段重新使用或预测中间特征,地物缓存已成为一个很有希望的加速范式。 然而,现有的无培训方法采用了统一的预测战略,无法适应不同的特征动态,导致在高加速率下质量严重退化。 我们提议LinCa,一个基于可学习的不可逆网络的特征缓存框架. LinCa通过轻量级的不可逆网络将缓存特性分解为具有明显连续性特性的子组件,并应用与每个组件相匹配的不同预测命令. 严格的不可逆性保证了无损失重建回原地貌空间,形成统一的分解-预测-重建管道. 通过培训不同的模型和时序段的单独预测器,LinCa适应了不同的特征动态. FLUX,Quen-Image,和HunyuanVideo的实验证明,附加参数不足0.2%的LinCa明显超越了现有方法,并在5-7x加速时保持了近乎无损的质量. 代码:https://github.com/QHR69/林卡

articles.title: SFMformer: A Spatial-Frequency Modulation Transformer for Lightweight Image Super-Resolution
articles.content: Sparse attention mechanisms, which score all token pairs but propagate only the strongest, now underpin the most efficient Transformers for lightweight image super-resolution. This paper observes that sparsification changes what it means to improve such a network. A dense attention layer has one place where representation quality matters: the aggregation of attended features. A sparse layer has two, because the top-k operator first decides which tokens survive and only then decides what to do with them, and a token discarded at the selection stage cannot be recovered downstream. Selection quality and aggregation quality are therefore separable targets, addressed by modules placed before and after the attention respectively. We test this by pairing a dual-branch spatial enhancement on the input of a progressive focused attention with a wavelet-domain modulation on its output, forming SFMformer. Measuring each module alone and jointly over all fifteen benchmark-scale pairs, we find their gains are not additive: the joint gain exceeds the sum of the individual gains on nine pairs, and the sign of the discrepancy is predicted by how much the weaker module contributes on its own (r = -0.72), so the two compound when they relieve different constraints and overlap when they relieve the same one. Enabling spectral modulation once per block rather than once per layer retains the effect at roughly one-sixth of its cost, keeping the model below one million parameters at every scale. SFMformer ranks first on 28 of 30 PSNR/SSIM entries across five benchmarks and three upscaling factors. We report the cases where the pairing does not help, and deploy the model on a Raspberry Pi 5 to confirm the design is practical under tight resource budgets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SFMformer:轻量级图像超解析器的空间-频率模块化变换器
articles.content_zh: Sparse关注机制,它得分所有符牌配对,但只传播最强,现在支撑最高效的变形器,用于轻量级图像超分辨率. 本文指出,垃圾邮件化改变了改进这种网络的意义。 密集的注意层有一个代表质量很重要的地方:被关注特征的集合. 一个稀疏的层有两层,因为顶端-k操作器首先决定哪个符号能存活下来,然后才决定如何处理它们,在选择阶段丢弃的符号无法在下游回收. 因此,选择质量和汇总质量是可分开的目标,分别由在关注前后放置的模块处理。 我们通过将双分支空间增强在渐进式重点注意的输入上配对,在输出上加波段调制,形成SFMform. 单独地和联合地衡量每个模块在所有15个基准级对齐上,我们发现它们的收益不是添加剂:联合收益超过9对单倍收益的总和,差异的征兆是根据较弱的模块自己贡献多少(r=-0.72)来预测的,因此,当它们解除了不同的制约和重合时,这两个复合体在解除同一个约束时会起到多大的作用. 使光谱调制每块一次,而不是每层一次,其效果大约保持其成本的六分之一,使模型在每个尺度上都低于100万参数。 在30个PSNR/SSIM条目中,可持续森林管理在5个基准和3个升级系数中排名第一。 我们报告配对无济于事的情况,并在Raspberry Pi 5上部署模型,以证实设计在紧张的资源预算下是切合实际的。

articles.title: Cross-Domain Generalization in Machine Unlearning via Label-Conditioned Energy Magnitude Regularization
articles.content: Machine unlearning removes the influence of specific data from a trained model. However, most methods treat the forgotten concept as isolated. In this paper, we study what happens to the rest of the model when a class is forgotten, using a label-conditioned energy-based model (EBM) that assigns per-class energies, making the effect directly observable. We forget a class by raising the energy of its image-label pairs, training with a forget term, a retain anchor to the pretrained model, a global margin, and an energy regularizer that stops the energy magnitudes from growing without limit. A propagation term applies the same forget signal to retain samples, weighted by each sample's DINOv2 similarity to the forget class, so forgetting reaches images that resemble it and leaves the rest untouched. We evaluate on two benchmark datasets: 1) On a subset of DomainNet across four visual domains, we forget tiger, lion, and scissors one at a time. Forgetting a class in the sketch domain also erases it from real, clipart, and painting, with forgetting error reaching 98% and 99% for lion and scissors, and the effect carrying over to the most similar class. 2) On CIFAR-10, we turn off the propagation term and forget each of the ten classes on its own. Forgetting is complete (100%), while the other nine classes retain 98.5% of their pre-unlearning accuracy on average.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过Label-Contentioned Energy Magnitualization实现机器的跨领域通用化
articles.content_zh: 机器不学习可以消除特定数据对训练有素模型的影响. 然而,大多数方法都认为被遗忘的概念是孤立的。 在本文中,我们研究当一个类被遗忘时,模型的其余部分会发生什么,使用一个标注条件的基于能量的模型(EBM)来分配每个类的能量,使效果可以直接观察到. 我们忘记了一个课程,通过提升其图像标签对子的能量,用一个忘却名词的训练,保留对预先训练过的模型的锚,一个全球比值,以及一种能调节器来阻止能量的无限增长。 一个传播术语使用同样的忘却信号来保留样本,按每个样本的DINOv2与忘却类的相似性进行加权,所以忘却到达了类似它的图像,使其余的不受影响. 我们评价两个基准数据集: 1)在覆盖四个视觉领域的域网子集上,我们一次一次忘记老虎,狮子和剪刀. 忘记草图域中的某一类,也会从真实的,剪辑的,和绘画中抹去,忘记错误的狮子和剪刀达到98%和99%,效果也延续到最相似的类. 2) 在CIFAR-10上,我们关闭了传播术语,并单独忘记了这十门课中的每一个。 遗忘完成(100%),而其他9个班平均保留了98.5%的失学前精度.

articles.title: Beyond Instrument Motion: Recognizing Tissue Tension Toward Surgical Skill Assessment
articles.content: Surgical performance assessment in minimally invasive surgery largely relies on manual expert review, making it time-consuming, subjective, and difficult to scale. While existing surgical video understanding methods address tasks such as instrument segmentation, surgical phase recognition, and action recognition, they do not explicitly capture fine-grained tissue handling, a key indicator of surgical quality. To address this gap, we introduce tissue tension recognition, a new clinically motivated video understanding task for laparoscopic and robot-assisted rectal cancer surgery. To support this task, we construct SurgTension, the first expert-annotated tissue tension dataset, providing a benchmark for objective tissue tension recognition. We further propose TensionTRAC, a lightweight trajectory-based framework that models tissue tension from sparse point trajectories. Using a compact trajectory encoder, TensionTRAC achieves competitive performance against strong pretrained video backbones.

articles.title_zh: 超越仪器运动:认识到组织紧张,进行外科技术评估
articles.content_zh: 最小侵入性外科手术的手术性能评估主要依靠人工专家审查,使其耗时,主观,难以规模化. 虽然现有的外科视频理解方法涉及仪器分解,手术阶段识别,动作识别等任务,但它们没有明确捕捉到细纹组织处理,这是手术质量的关键指标. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了组织张力识别,这是在临床上为脑膜和机器人辅助的直肠癌手术进行新的视频理解任务。 为了支持这项任务,我们构建了SurgTension,这是第一个由专家注释的组织张力数据集,为客观组织张力识别提供了基准. 我们进一步提议建立 " 紧张TRAC " ,这是一个以轻量级轨迹为基础的框架,从稀疏的点轨迹模拟组织张力。 利用一个紧凑的轨迹编码器,TRAC在使用经过预先训练的强大的视频主干线时,实现了竞争性能.

articles.title: PerFact: Perception-Derived Fact Prompting for 3D Brain MRI Report Generation
articles.content: Radiology report generation has matured almost entirely on 2D chest radiographs, where the default route to better reports is a larger backbone or a pre-training one on medical data. We revisit that assumption on 3D multi-sequence brain MRI, a volumetric multi-disease regime, and find that the model is not the lever. Zero-shot medical and radiology vision-language models transfer poorly to brain MRI, with chest radiograph specialists failing most conspicuously, and five backbones fine-tuned identically across three model families and an order of magnitude in scale differ only marginally. What determines the quality of the report is the information injected into the prompt. We delegate perception to upstream 3D segmentation and classification, serialize their outputs into a structured fact sentence, and prompt a LoRA-adapted vision-language model with it; we call this \textbf{PerFact}. In a controlled study that fixes the backbone, data split, target reports, and adaptation while varying only the injected grounding, perception-derived facts outperform retrieved prior reports, retrieval becomes redundant once facts are present, and end-to-end predicted facts remain effective without any ground-truth annotation at inference. The residual gap between predicted and oracle facts is explained by the granularity of the facts rather than by the generator. Closed-ended visual question answering comes at no measurable cost to report quality, though the grounding source has little effect on it. On 3D brain MRI, grounding information, not model choice, is the dominant controllable factor in report quality.

articles.title_zh: PerFact: 3D 脑磁共振的感知 - 演示事实提示 报告生成
articles.content_zh: 放射学报告生成器几乎完全在2D胸腔放射图上成熟,其中更好的报告的默认途径是更大的骨干或医学数据预训. 我们重新审视3D多序列脑磁共振的假设,一种体积多病的系统,发现模型不是杠杆. 零射医学和放射学视觉语言模型向大脑核磁共振转移不良,胸部射电学专家的失败最为明显,五个骨干在三个模范家庭都进行了同样的微调,规模的顺序也略有不同。 报告质量的决定因素是输入提示的信息。 我们把感知委托给上游的3D分解和分类,将其输出序列化为结构化的事实句子,并用它来推动一个LORA适应的视觉语言模型;我们称之为\textbf{PerFact}。 在一项控制性研究中,确定主干、数据分割、目标报告和调整,同时只改变注入的地基、感知产生的事实比以前检索的报告要好,一旦发现事实,检索就变得多余,端到端的预测事实仍然有效,无须在推断时作任何地面真实的说明。 预测事实和甲骨文事实之间的剩余差距是由事实的颗粒性而不是由生成者来解释的. 闭门视觉问题的回答没有以可衡量的成本来报告质量,尽管地面来源对其影响不大。 在3D脑核磁共振上,地面信息,而不是模型选择,是报告质量中主要的可控制因素.

articles.title: AppendiGrade: An XAI-Enhanced Deep Learning Framework for Grading Appendicitis in Ultrasound with Gaussian Blur and Grad-CAM
articles.content: Appendicitis is one of the most common abdominal emergencies worldwide and requires prompt diagnosis and treatment to prevent life-threatening conditions. However, accurately differentiating complicated cases, such as perforation or abscess formation, from uncomplicated appendicitis remains a significant clinical challenge. Among other methods, ultrasound is a safer and more cost-efficient diagnostic technique because of the lack of radiation exposure. In this research, an advanced system capable of automatically detecting complicated appendicitis from ultrasound images was developed. A dataset consisting of 4679 ultrasound images with 5 classes, namely perforated, abscess, acute, appendicolith, and normal, was used for the proposed model training and testing. Four pretrained deep learning models, DenseNet201, InceptionV3, ConvNextTiny, and VGG19, have been employed for detecting and classifying complicated appendicitis. In the initial configuration, InceptionV3 achieved the second highest accuracy, with a value of 69.21%. Owing to suboptimal performance with raw images, further optimization techniques, including image preprocessing, hyperparameter tuning, model fine-tuning, and image sharpening, were applied. These enhancements significantly improved the model's performance, with an accuracy of 95.58% for InceptionV3. The model performance is then explained with gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM), which creates a heatmap of the regions responsible for the model's prediction of the infected areas. This could make crosschecking with experts much easier.

articles.title_zh: AppendiGrade:与高斯蓝和Grad-CAM一起在超声波中强化了增级Appendicitis的深层学习框架
articles.content_zh: 阑尾炎是全世界最常见的腹部紧急情况之一,需要及时诊断和治疗,以防止危及生命的情况。 然而,准确区分诸如穿孔或脓肿形成等复杂病例与非复杂阑尾炎仍然是临床上的一大挑战。 除其他方法外,超声波是一种更安全,成本效益更高的诊断技术,因为缺乏辐射照射. 在这一研究中,开发了能够自动检测来自超声波影像的复杂阑尾炎的先进系统. 提议的模型培训和测试使用了由4679个超声波图像组成的数据集,包括5个班,即穿孔、骨灰、急性、阑尾石和普通。 四个预先训练的深层学习模型DenseNet201、InceptionV3、ConvNextTiny和VGG19被用于检测和分类复杂的阑尾炎。 在初始配置中,InceptionV3实现了第二高的精度,其值为69.21%. 由于原始图像的性能不理想,进一步应用了优化技术,包括图像预处理、超参数调制、模型微调和图像磨合。 这些增强大大改善了模型的性能,InceptionV3的精度为95.58%. 然后用梯度加权的类激活绘图(Grad-CAM)来解释模型性能,这造就了负责模型预测受感染地区的区域的热图. 这将使与专家的交叉核对更加容易。

articles.title: Comparative Study of Out-of-the-Box Technology for Automatic Target Detection and Recognition
articles.content: Automatic Target Detection and Recognition (ATD/R) is critical for military decision support and (semi-)autonomous operations. Recent advances in object detection and artificial intelligence (AI) significantly boosted the potential performance of ATD/R. However, the scarcity of publicly available military datasets limits the application of these systems. As a solution, this paper explores the use of publicly available models and civilian datasets to achieve reasonable performance in military contexts. We benchmark several state-of-the-art models, including six iterations of the YOLO series and two variations on the DETR framework, on a newly acquired military relevant dataset. This dataset features military vehicles and challenging circumstances, including various degrees of occlusions and small targets. The out-of-the-box version of each model is validated alongside a version finetuned on the VisDrone dataset. This dataset features small objects, an Air-to-Ground (A2G) perspective and relevant classes, potentially generalizing to our military ATD/R task. We compare the performance of the models using mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95, across A2G and Ground-to-Ground (G2G) perspective, target size and model size, giving insight into the real-time capabilities of models. Our main findings are: (1) bigger models outperform smaller models, (2) DETR-based models show promising results compared to the YOLO series,(3) fine-tuning models on an out-of-domain A2G dataset, improves their A2G performance and slightly improves their performance on small objects, but (4) all models still struggle with detecting small objects in an A2G scenario. We conclude that, despite recent advances in object detection, in-domain training is still crucial for creating capable ATD/R systems.

articles.title_zh: 用于自动目标检测和识别的盒外技术比较研究
articles.content_zh: 自动目标探测和识别对军事决策支持和(半)自主行动至关重要。 最近物体探测和人工智能(AI)的进步大大提高了ATD/R的潜在性能. 然而,公开的军事数据集的缺乏限制了这些系统的应用。 作为解决方案,本文探索使用公开的模型和民用数据集在军事背景下实现合理性能. 我们以一套新获得的军事相关数据集为基准,对若干最新模型进行基准,包括YOLO系列的6个迭代和DETR框架的两个变体。 该数据集的特点是军用车辆和具有挑战性的情况,包括不同程度的隔离和小目标. 每个模型的外框版本与VisDrone数据集上微调的版本一起验证. 这个数据集的特点是小物体、空对空视角和相关类别,有可能概括到我们的军事ATD/R任务。 我们用mAP@0.5和mAP@0.5:0.95来比较这些模型的性能,跨越A2G和地对地(G2G)视角,目标大小和模型大小,从而深入了解模型的实时能力. 我们的主要发现是:(1)更大的模型超越了较小的模型,(2)基于DETR的模型与YOLO系列相比显示有希望的结果,(3)在域外的A2G数据集上微调模型,改进其A2G性能,并在小物体上略微提高性能,但(4)所有模型在A2G情景下仍然难以探测小物体. 我们的结论是,尽管最近在探测物体方面取得了进展,但国内培训对于建立有能力的ATD/R系统仍然至关重要。

articles.title: CFB-GBM v2.0: An Augmented Longitudinal Dataset for Multi-Modal Glioblastoma Segmentation, Radiomics, and RANO Progression Tracking
articles.content: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most aggressive primary brain tumor in adults, with a median overall survival of 15 months. Longitudinal, multi-modal imaging datasets with comprehensive clinical and treatment data are essential to support the development of reproducible computational methods for treatment response prediction, disease progression modelling, and personalized medicine. We present CFB-GBM v2.0, an extension of our previously released CFB-GBM dataset comprising 264 GBM patients treated according to the standard Stupp protocol. The primary contribution of this release is the completion of Gross Tumour Volume (GTV) delineations across all available timepoints ($t_0$, $t_1$ and $t_2$), increasing the overall GTV completion rate from 35% to 97%. This was achieved using a nnU-Net model pre-trained on BraTS 2021 and fine-tuned on CFB-GBM ground-truth contours, with the generated segmentations validated by five radiation oncologists. From these longitudinal GTV annotations, volumetric RANO 2.0 response category labels were derived for all available temporality pairs ($t_0 \rightarrow t_1$, $t_0 \rightarrow t_2$ and $t_1 \rightarrow t_2$). To further ease dataset usability and reproducibility, brain masks computed with HD-BET and pre-computed radiomic features extracted with PyRadiomics are provided for each patient timepoint and MRI modality. Additionally, the WHO classification guideline (2016 vs. 2021) applicable to each patient's diagnosis is now explicitly documented. CFB-GBM v2.0 is publicly available on The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) at https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/cfb-gbm .

articles.title_zh: CFB-GBM v2.0: 多摩达尔胶囊瘤增强纵向数据集 分离、放射和RANO进展跟踪

articles.title: Improving Complex Moiré Removal with Generative Supervision
articles.content: The availability of high-quality paired data is essential for training learning-based image demoiréing models. However, it remains challenging for existing datasets to encompass the complex moiré patterns captured in uncontrolled real-world scenarios. Such degradations typically manifest as large-scale, multicolored moiré patterns. Moreover, these patterns frequently occur in images for which clean counterparts are difficult to obtain, such as photographs acquired from public displays or existing online resources. In this work, we propose a novel data engine designed to improve the removal of complex moiré patterns by generating training supervision. Specifically, we initially collect real-world images containing complex moiré patterns and localize the corresponding screen regions. Multiple image-conditioned generative foundation models are subsequently deployed to produce candidate references. To establish reliable supervision, these candidates are subjected to patch-level quality control to filter and select the optimal results. Based on this systematic paradigm, we construct the WildMoiré dataset, which contains 6.8K moiré-GT training pairs. For evaluation, we additionally build an independent test set comprising $\sim$250 pairs with captured clean ground truth. Extensive experiments on ESDNet, SDXL, and Qwen-Image-Edit demonstrate that the proposed generative supervision consistently improves the performance of complex moiré removal.

articles.title_zh: 在基因监督下改进复杂的Moiré清除
articles.content_zh: 提供高质量的配对数据对于培训基于学习的图像演示模型至关重要。 然而,现有数据集要涵盖在失控的现实世界情景中捕获的复杂的模版模式,仍然具有挑战性。 这种退化通常表现为大规模、多彩的摩尔模式。 此外,这些模式经常出现在难以获得清洁图像的图像中,例如从公共展示或现有在线资源获得的照片。 在这项工作中,我们提出一个新的数据引擎,旨在通过产生培训监督,更好地消除复杂的摩尔模式。 具体地说,我们最初收集包含复杂摩尔图案的现实世界图像,并使相应的屏幕区域本地化. 多个图像条件的基因基础模型随后被部署,以产生候选参考. 为了建立可靠的监督,这些候选人受到补丁级质量控制,以过滤和选择最佳结果。 基于这一系统模式,我们构建了WildMoiré数据集,其中包含6.8K moiré-GT训练对. 为了评估,我们另外建造了一套独立的测试装置,由250美元左右的两套带捕捉到的干净地面真相的测试装置组成。 关于ESDNet、SDXL和Quen-Image-Edit的广泛实验表明,拟议的基因监督一贯改善复杂的moiré清除的性能。

articles.title: DistillPath: An Efficient 22M Distilled Pathology Encoder Approaching Large Foundation Model Performance
articles.content: Many high-performing pathology tile encoders are now foundation models with hundreds of millions to over a billion parameters. Encoding and storing the thousands of tiles in each whole-slide image with such models is costly on commodity hardware, so compact encoders that retain useful downstream performance are a valuable alternative. We present DistillPath-KS16, which starts from the existing 22M kaiko ViT-S/16 encoder and improves it by distilling from released pathology encoders used as frozen teachers. The recipe reads only the teachers' final class and patch tokens and trains on 6,000 public slides, needing neither their DINO nor iBOT pretraining heads nor a billion-tile corpus, so it applies to any released encoder that exposes backbone tokens. We distill four teachers spanning 86M to 1.1B parameters into the same student. Every variant improves the kaiko baseline on all three benchmarks we use, EVA, HEST, and PLISM, and the strongest teacher is task-dependent. On the seven-task EVA mean, DistillPath-KS16-Virchow2 reaches $0.795$, within $0.015$ points of Virchow2, the top-scoring model in our evaluation, at about $29\times$ fewer parameters; it also scores above H0-mini and GPFM on this aggregate metric, though that advantage is task-concentrated rather than uniform. Because it remains a 22M ViT-S/16 with 384-dimensional features, DistillPath-KS16 runs more than $25\times$ faster than Virchow2. Code is available at https://github.com/RamonKaspar/DistillPath, and released model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/RamonK/distillpath.

articles.title_zh: 抖动 路径: 一个高效的22M抖动病理编码器接近大型基金会 模型性能
articles.content_zh: 许多高性能的病理瓷砖编码器现在是基础模型,有数亿到十亿个参数. 用这种模型在每幅全塌方图象中编码和储存数千块瓷砖,对商品硬件来说代价高昂,因此保留有用的下游性能的紧凑编码器是一种宝贵的替代办法。 我们介绍DistillPath-KS16,它从现有的22M kaiko ViT-S/16编码器开始,并通过从作为冷冻教师的释放的病理编码器中蒸馏出来加以改进。 食谱只读老师的终极课,在6000张公共幻灯片上补补符和火车,既不需要他们的DINO,也不需要iBOT预训头部,也不需要十亿瓷器,因此它适用于任何释放的能暴露骨干符号的编码器. 我们把四位教师 分为86M到1.1B的参数 分解成同一个学生 每个变体都改进了我们使用的所有三个基准的kaiko基线,EVA,HEST,和PLISM,最强的教师是任务依赖的. 在7个任务EVA中,DistillPath-KS16-Virchow2的得分达到0.795美元,在Wirchow2的0.015美元点内,我们评价中得分最高的模型大约为29\times的参数;在这个总的度量上,它也得分高于H0-mini和GPFM,尽管这一优势是任务集中而不是统一的。 由于它仍然是具有384维特性的22M Vit-S/16,DistillPath-KS16运行速度超过25\tims$比Virchow2. 代码见https://github.com/RamonKaspar/DistillPath,发布的模型权重见https://huggingface.co/collections/RamonK/distillpath。

articles.title: GenRec: Knowing Where to Reconstruct and Where to Generate
articles.content: Generative novel view synthesis from sparse input images is rarely all reconstruction or all generation: pixels visible in some source view have a unique correct value modulated only by view-dependent shading, while pixels in disocclusions or beyond the captured volume admit a distribution of plausible completions. Existing generative novel-view-synthesis methods conflate these regimes under a single uniform loss, blurring the line between geometric fidelity and creative hallucinations even when scene geometry is injected through warped point clouds or projected depth. We introduce GenRec, a multi-view flow matching model that builds the reconstruction--generation split directly into its architecture, supervision, and gradient flow. Guided by an observation mask derived from the source cameras and a monocular depth estimator, a flow matching backbone jointly denoises RGB and scene-coordinate maps across all target views, while a pixel-space refinement stage restores high-frequency detail on observed pixels; the same mask gates supervision so regression signals do not contaminate the generative prior. Across RealEstate10K, DL3DV-10K, and Mip-NeRF~360, in both single-view extrapolation and two-view interpolation, GenRec attains the best reconstruction fidelity in observed regions while also surpassing purely generative baselines on perceptual quality in unobserved ones, showing the effectiveness of our approach.

articles.title_zh: GenRec: 知道在哪里重建, 在哪里生成
articles.content_zh: 从稀疏的输入图像中生成的基因小说视图合成很少是所有重建或所有生成:一些源视图中可见的像素具有独特的正确值,只能通过依赖视图的阴影来调节,而散射量或捕获量以外的像素则承认了似似完成量的分布. 现有的基因小说-观点-合成方法将这些制度混为一谈,在单一的统一损失下,模糊了几何忠诚度和创造性幻觉之间的界限,即使场景几何通过扭曲点云或预测深度注入. 我们引入了GenRec,一种多视图流匹配模型,将重建-生成直接分为其架构,监督,梯度流. 在从源相机和单视深度估测器衍生出来的观测罩的指引下,一个流量匹配的骨干会联合使RGB和场景坐标图覆盖所有目标视图,而像素空间的精细级则会恢复观测到像素上的高频细节;同样的遮罩门监督使得回归信号不会污染之前的基因. 在整个RealEstate10K、DL3DV-10K和Mip-NERF~360中,在单视推论和双视插图中,GenRec在观察区域实现了最好的重建忠心,同时也超过了在未观察区域中在知觉质量上的纯基因基线,显示了我们的方法的有效性。

articles.title: Scale Matters: Adaptive Granularity Selection for Cross-Species 3D Plant Organ Segmentation
articles.content: Recent 3D foundation models provide powerful feature representations for point cloud learning by controlling spatial granularity. However, relying on a fixed spatial granularity severely limits generalization in applications like plant phenotyping, where organ morphology and size vary substantially across species and growth stages. To address this, we propose AGS-PlantSeg, a few-shot 3D plant organ segmentation method that leverages the frozen Utonia (arXiv:2603.03283) foundation model combined with Adaptive Granularity Selection. By dynamically selecting the best granularity levels for each specific plant model, our method extracts optimized geometric features for a lightweight MLP segmentation head. Extensive experiments across PLANesT-3D (arXiv:2407.21150), Pheno4D , and Crops3D demonstrate that AGS-PlantSeg significantly improves cross-species generalization, achieving 88.9% average mIoU performance and outperforming fixed-granularity baselines by 2.5 mIoU points. Despite requiring minimal annotated data, our approach is highly competitive with fully supervised, plant-specific architectures.

articles.title_zh: 缩放事项: 适应性颗粒性 跨类 3D 植物器官分裂
articles.content_zh: 最近3D基础模型通过控制空间颗粒性为点云学习提供了强大的特征表示. 然而,依靠固定的空间颗粒性严重限制了植物花序等应用中的泛化,植物花序的器官形态和大小因物种和生长阶段而有很大差异。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出AGS-PlantSeg,一种几弹三维植物器官分化方法,利用冷冻的Utonia(arXiv:2603.03283)的基础模型,结合适应性颗粒性选择. 通过动态地为每个特定的植物模型选择最好的颗粒度水平,我们的方法提取出一个轻量级的MLP分区头的优化几何特征. 跨PlanesT-3D(arXiv:2407.21150)、Pheno4D和Crops3D的广泛实验表明,AGS-PlantSeg显著改进了跨物种泛化,实现了平均mIoU性能88.9%和超过2.5 mIoU性能的固定角基线. 尽管需要最低限度的附加说明的数据,但我们的做法与充分监督的植物特有结构具有高度的竞争力。

articles.title: Training with synthetic data for drone detection in thermal imagery
articles.content: Ground-to-Air (G2A) drone detection in medium- and long-wave infrared (MWIR/LWIR) imagery is challenging due to reduced texture information, sensor noise, weak thermal contrast, and the scarcity of annotated data. This work investigates a synthetic-first training strategy that combines synthetic scene generation with fine-tuning on real data. We show that synthetic data provides an effective basis for learning initial object representations, while real in-domain thermal imagery is still essential for reliable deployment. Even small amounts of real IR data substantially reduce domain gaps. Our experiments indicate that dataset alignment has a stronger impact on performance than model scale. Finally, our analysis of the dataset suggests that semantic alignment in feature space is the strongest predictor of model performance, while radiometric properties such as entropy and dynamic range also contribute to detection robustness. This work provides a foundation for combining synthetic and real IR data for effective G2A drone detection.

articles.title_zh: 利用合成数据进行热成像中无人机探测培训
articles.content_zh: 由于纹理信息减少,传感器噪声,热量对比弱,加上注释数据稀缺,中长波红外线(MWIR/LWIR)图像中的地对空(G2A)无人机探测具有挑战性. 这项工作调查了合成第一训练策略,将合成场景生成与真实数据的微调相结合. 我们显示,合成数据为学习初始物体表示提供了有效的基础,而真正的域内热成像对于可靠的部署仍然是必不可少的. 即使是少量真实的IR数据也能大大减少域间隙. 我们的实验表明,数据集对性能的影响大于模型尺度。 最后,我们对数据集的分析表明,特征空间的语义一致是模型性能的最强的预测器,而 en和动态范围等辐射测量特性也有助于探测稳健性. 这项工作为合成和真实的IR数据相结合以有效探测G2A无人机奠定了基础.

articles.title: ETHEREAL: A 25.6-$μ$s/inf. Low-latency Event-driven Graph-neural-network Processor for High-resolution Vision at the Edge
articles.content: Dynamic vision sensors (DVS) are enticing candidates to reach the low-latency, sub-ms target of edge-vision applications, as they generate events with a $μ$s-level time resolution. However, using DVS front ends also calls for novel algorithm/hardware back ends capable of efficiently handling streams of sparse spatiotemporal events. While event-driven graph neural networks (EV-GNNs) have emerged as a solution on the algorithmic side that is both accurate and efficient, there is no dedicated hardware to date capable of efficiently supporting their mixed requirements of dense-regular compute operations and sparse-irregular memory accesses. We therefore introduce ETHEREAL, the first EV-GNN processor chip, capable of bridging this gap by means of a neighbor-parallel spline-convolution engine combined with a split-2D/3D memory hierarchy that introduces a novel spatiotemporal event-caching mechanism. Measurement results demonstrate a 25.6$μ$s latency and a 1.6$μ$J energy per end-to-end event-wise inference on the state-of-the art DAGr-GNN workload and VGA-resolution (640x480 pixels) DSEC dataset.

articles.title_zh: 低频事件驱动高分辨率图-神经网络处理器 在边缘的视野
articles.content_zh: 动态视觉传感器(DVS)正在诱导考生到达边缘视效应用的低纬度,子ms目标,因为它们产生带有$μs级时间分辨率的事件. 然而,使用DVS前端也要求新颖的算法/硬件后端能够高效地处理稀少的spatiotopal事件的流. 虽然事件驱动的图神经网络(EV-GNNs)作为算法方面的一种既准确又高效的解决方案而出现,但迄今为止还没有专门的硬件能够有效支持其密集-正常计算操作和稀疏-正常内存访问的混合要求. 因此,我们引入了ETHEREAL,这是第一个EV-GNN处理器芯片,它能够通过一个相邻的平行的Spline-curvation引擎与一个分解-2D/3D内存结构结合来弥补这一差距,该结构引入了一种新的spatiental事件-catching机制. 测量结果表明,有25.6元的耐用性和1.6元的耐用性。 J每端到端事件能量对最先进的DAGr-GN工作量和VGA分辨率(640x480像素)DSEC数据集进行推断.

articles.title: TINA+: Probing Residual Visual Knowledge in Unlearned Diffusion Models via Diffusion-Consistent Text-Free Inversion
articles.content: Although text-to-image diffusion models exhibit remarkable generative power, concept erasure techniques are essential for preventing harmful content. Existing adversarial probes evaluate these methods by testing whether erased concepts can still be recovered. However, existing erasure and probe methods remain largely text-centric, focusing on whether the text-to-image mapping is severed while overlooking whether the corresponding visual knowledge remains. To investigate this question from a visual perspective, we leverage diffusion inversion to probe whether a generative trajectory can reconstruct visual instances of an erased concept. Under a null-text condition, standard inversion avoids the textual pathway but amplifies approximation errors, hindering faithful trajectory recovery. To address this challenge, we introduce TINA+, a diffusion-consistent Text-free INversion Attack equipped with optimization-based inversion. We also find that unconstrained diffusion inversion may discover spurious trajectories, even allowing a randomly initialized diffusion model to reconstruct the target concept. Such trajectories may falsely indicate residual visual knowledge. TINA+ therefore introduces Diffusion-Consistent Trajectory Regularization to suppress this failure mode. By penalizing trajectories that fall far below the expected marginal energy evolution of diffusion, TINA+ suppresses spurious inversion paths while preserving its ability to recover erased concepts. Experiments across twelve erasure methods, four concept-erasure tasks, and different model architectures demonstrate that TINA+ reliably probes residual visual knowledge through diffusion-consistent visual trajectories. These results provide stronger evidence that current methods often obscure concepts by severing text-image links rather than eliminating the underlying visual knowledge.

articles.title_zh: TINA+:通过传播-一致的文本自由反转,在未吸取的传播模型中检测剩余视觉知识
articles.content_zh: 虽然文字到图像的传播模式显示出显著的基因力量,但概念消除技术对于防止有害内容至关重要。 现有的对抗探测器通过测试被抹去的概念是否仍然可以回收来评价这些方法. 然而,现有的消除和探测方法基本上仍然是以文字为中心的,侧重于文本到图像映射是否被断开,而忽略了相应的视觉知识是否仍然存在. 为了从视觉角度来调查这个问题,我们利用传播反转来探究一个基因轨迹是否能够重建一个被抹去的概念的视觉实例. 在无文字条件下,标准反转避免了文字路径,但放大了近似错误,阻碍了忠实的轨迹恢复. 为了应对这一挑战,我们引入了TINA+,一种具有传播一致性的无文本反演攻击,配备了基于优化的反演. 我们还发现,不受约束的传播反演可能发现虚假的轨迹,甚至允许随机初始化的传播模型重建目标概念. 这种轨迹可能错误地表明残余的视觉知识。 TINA+因此引入了扩散-恒定的轨迹规范化来抑制这种故障模式. TINA+通过惩罚远低于预期的传播边际能量演化的轨迹,抑制了虚假的反向路径,同时保持其恢复被抹去的概念的能力. 跨越十二个消除方法的实验,四个概念时代的任务,以及不同的模型架构都表明,TINA+可靠地通过扩散-一致的视觉轨迹探测残余的视觉知识. 这些结果更有力地证明,目前的方法往往通过切断文本-图像链接而不是消除基本的视觉知识来模糊概念。

articles.title: Evaluation of AI-based Visual Crack Detection in Steel Bridges Using Probability of Detection
articles.content: Bridge structures are regularly inspected for structural damage such as cracks and corrosion in order to ensure public safety and reduce maintenance costs. Much research has been done on automating this process using computer vision methods, which are often evaluated and compared using metrics such as intersection over union, mean average precision, etc. However, predicting the actual effectiveness of an inspection method within the field of structural engineering from these metrics remains challenging. To enable the systematic use of these increasingly popular methods in engineering practice, evaluating the performance of these methods in a way that is compatible with standard engineering approaches is therefore an urgent necessity. We present a new statistical evaluation framework to allow the comparison of computer vision methods with conventional visual inspection for crack detection in steel bridges. The framework is based on probability of detection curves and can account for the influence of image resolution. We apply this evaluation method to the real-world ``Cracks in Steel Bridges'' dataset, which contains annotated images of cracks in bridge structures. The quantification of the probability of detection and its uncertainty enables a practical assessment of the effect of automated methods for damage detection in structural reliability analyses. In turn, this enables the wide-spread use of automated (AI-based) damage detection in safety critical applications. This evaluation method provides evidence that the proposed computer vision approach approach is robust for the crack detection task and can have a high added value as an addition to conventional visual inspection methods.

articles.title_zh: 评价基于AI的利用检测可能性的钢桥视觉裂缝检测
articles.content_zh: 定期检查桥梁结构,检查裂缝和腐蚀等结构损坏,以确保公共安全,降低维护成本. 在使用计算机视觉方法使这一过程自动化方面已经做了许多研究,这些方法往往通过诸如交叉比结合、平均精度等衡量标准进行评估和比较。 然而,从这些衡量尺度来预测结构工程领域视察方法的实际效力仍然具有挑战性。 因此,为了能够在工程实践中系统地使用这些日益流行的方法,迫切需要以与标准工程方法相符的方式评估这些方法的性能。 我们提出了一个新的统计评价框架,以便能够将计算机视觉方法与传统的视觉检查进行比较,以便在钢桥中发现裂缝。 框架基于检测曲线的概率,可以说明图像分辨率的影响. 我们把这个评估方法应用到现实世界的"钢桥"的数据集中,其中包含了桥体结构中裂缝的注释图像. 通过量化探测概率及其不确定性,可以在结构可靠性分析中实际评估自动探测损害的方法的效果。 这反过来又使得安全关键应用中能够广泛使用自动(基于AI的)损害探测。 这种评价方法提供了证据表明,拟议的计算机视觉方法对于裂缝检测任务来说是强有力的,并且作为常规视觉检查方法的一种补充,具有很高的附加值.

articles.title: Vision-Language Models for Analog Gauge Reading: An Empirical Study of Specialization, Transfer and Reliability
articles.content: Analog gauges remain common in industrial environments where manual inspection is costly or hazardous. The engineering application addressed here is direct numerical reading of single-target analog-gauge images, while the artificial-intelligence contribution is a systematic evaluation of specialization, transfer, robustness and reliability for a general-purpose vision-language model (VLM) without an explicit pointer-segmentation and geometric-reading pipeline. The Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model is evaluated using zero-shot prompting, in-context learning (ICL) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning with Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) on a public synthetic dataset, a video-derived Pressure Gauge dataset and a proprietary industrial dataset. All fine-tuning experiments use a fixed 20-epoch protocol with the final epoch used for analysis; separate models with and without supplied gauge ranges remove prompt-setting confounds. The primary metric is range-normalized mean percentage error (MPE). The best fine-tuned MPE values are 2.39% on the synthetic dataset, with a 95% bootstrap confidence interval (CI) of 1.43-3.90%; 2.61% on the Pressure Gauge dataset, with a CI of 1.66-3.80%; and 4.43% on the proprietary industrial dataset, with a CI of 2.31-7.14%. Leave-one-dataset-out experiments reveal substantial transfer degradation on held-out synthetic and proprietary data, while robustness tests identify Gaussian blur as the strongest tested corruption. Reliability analysis shows that high-confidence errors remain possible, motivating abstention and independent validation in safety-critical use. These results support QLoRA-specialized VLMs for direct single-gauge reading but not yet a deployment-ready plant-monitoring pipeline.

articles.title_zh: 模拟Gauge阅读的远景-语言模型:关于专门化、转移和可靠性的经验研究
articles.content_zh: 在人工检查费用昂贵或危险的工业环境中,模拟测量仍然很常见。 这里述及的工程应用是对单目标模拟加成图像的直接数值读取,而人工智能的贡献则是对通用视觉语言模型(VLM)的专业化,转移,稳健性和可靠性进行系统评价,没有明确的指针分和几何读取管道. Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型在公共合成数据集上采用零镜头提示,内文本学习(ICL)和参数效率高的微调与量化低Rank适应(QLORA),视频衍生的压力高格数据集和专有工业数据集进行评价. 所有微调实验都使用一个固定的20世纪协议,其中最后的时代用于分析;有和无供给的测量范围的独立模型消除了即时设定的混乱. 主要衡量标准是范围正常平均百分比差(MPE)。 最佳微调的MPE值在合成数据集上为2.39%,靴子置信间隔(CI)为1.43-3.90%;压力高氏数据集上为2.61%,CI为1.66-3.80%;专利工业数据集上为4.43%,CI为2.31-7.14%. 留一数据集实验显示,在搁置的合成和专有数据上,转移退化程度相当严重,而强力测试则将高斯语模糊度确定为最强的测试腐败. 可靠性分析显示,高信任度错误仍然是可能的,促使弃权,并在安全关键用途方面进行独立验证。 这些结果支持QLORA专业的VLM进行直接的单调读取,但还没有一个可部署的工厂监测管道。

articles.title: DynaForcing: Overcoming Dynamic Collapse in Self-Forcing Distillation for Streaming Avatar Generation
articles.content:
Audio-driven avatar generation requires realistic lip-sync, expressive motion, and real-time streaming. Recent work achieves the latter via self-forcing with Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), but this paradigm suffers from a critical failure that has not been systematically characterized: dynamic collapse, where the student model converges to a near-static optimum with high perceptual quality but severely suppressed temporal dynamics. We trace this to two causes: the reverse KL objective in DMD, which biases toward low-motion modes, and unanchored self-conditioning, which creates a feedback loop that amplifies collapse. This is especially harmful for avatars, where even subtle motion loss breaks lip-sync and expression.
  To address this, we propose DynaForcing, a training framework with three complementary strategies applied at different levels. Specifically, Hybrid Forcing anchors rollouts to ground-truth dynamics at the data level to break the feedback loop. Dynamics-Aware Reward Regularization introduces explicit motion rewards via the RL interpretation of DMD to counteract the reverse KL bias at the loss level. Reference Perturbation perturbs reference images to decouple identity from static details, forcing the model to rely on audio for motion at the conditioning level. We further introduce computation graph pruning and gradient replay, reducing the GPU footprint of self-forcing by over an order of magnitude. Experiments show that DynaForcing recovers dynamics to teacher-comparable levels (Dyn-Deg: 0.31 -> 0.73, Sync-C: 7.03 -> 7.68) while improving visual quality, resolving the quality-dynamics trade-off throughout training without early stopping.

articles.title_zh: 动态强制 : 克服流水神通一代自强制抖动中的动态崩溃
articles.content_zh:
音频驱动的阿凡达生成需要现实的唇音同步,表达式运动,以及实时流线. 近期的作品通过自我强制与分布匹配抖动(DMD)实现后者,但这一范式遭遇了尚未系统化的关键性失败:动态崩溃,学生模式汇聚到近乎静态的最佳状态,具有高知觉质量,但严重抑制了时间动态. 我们将此追溯到两个原因:DMD中的反向KL目标,它偏向于低运动模式,以及无意识的自我调节,这创造了一个反馈循环,放大崩溃. 这对阿凡达人特别有害,因为即使微妙的运动丧失也打破了唇拍和表达.
为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用DynaForcing,这是一个培训框架,在不同级别上适用三项相辅相成的战略。 具体来说,混合加固锚在数据层面向地面真实动态展开,以打破反馈循环. Dynamics-Award Reward Regionalization通过DMD的RL解释引入了明确的运动奖励,以抵消损失级的反向KL偏差. 参考 Perturbation 扰动参考图像从静态细节中解析身份,迫使模型依赖音频在调制级别上运动. 我们进一步引入了计算图的回放和梯度重放,将自强制的GPU足迹减少超过一个数量级. 实验显示,DynaForcing在提高视觉质量的同时,将动力学恢复到师资可比较的水平(Dyn-Deg:0.31 - > 0.73,Sync-C:7.03 - > 7.68),在整个训练过程中解决质量-动力学的权衡,而不提前停止.

articles.title: Monitoring Pasture Restoration from Satellite Image Time Series: Caveats and Opportunities
articles.content: Monitoring nature restoration at scale is an important but difficult ecological problem. Deep learning methods to analyze satellite image time series (SITS) have been widely used for land surface monitoring. In semi-natural grasslands - the habitat type in focus in this work - restoration outcomes develop gradually, yet satellite observations are influenced by weather, acquisition conditions, and processing artefacts, making it difficult to distinguish genuine restoration signals from unrelated temporal variation. In this work, we examine - to the best of our knowledge, for the first time - whether restoration status can be detected directly from satellite image time series by formulating pasture restoration as a binary deep learning classification problem. We evaluate two common SITS deep learning architectures on different Sentinel-2 image combinations, across 1,397 restored Swedish pastures and find that explicitly modeling intra-year variability and per-pasture normalization increases separability, reaching 0.88 accuracy for the best model. We further investigate our results and perform a targeted bias analysis finding that reliable deployment requires temporally balanced labels and evaluation protocols that explicitly test for year-related confounding. We therefore frame our contribution not as a solved restoration-monitoring system, but as a realistic case study of what works, what fails, and what future studies should control for. Code and models are available at https://github.com/aleksispi/ml-nature-resto.

articles.title_zh: 从卫星图像时间系列监测草原恢复:洞穴和机会
articles.content_zh: 大规模监测自然恢复是一个重要但困难的生态问题。 分析卫星图像时间序列的深层学习方法已广泛用于地面监测。 在半自然草原 -- -- 这项工作重点关注的生境类型 -- -- 恢复结果逐步发展,但卫星观测受到天气、获取条件和加工工艺的影响,因此难以区分真正的恢复信号与不相关的时间变化。 在这项工作中,我们从我们所知的情况出发,第一次审查是否可以通过将牧场恢复确定为二元深层学习分类问题,从卫星图像时间序列中直接检测恢复状况。 我们评价了在1 397个恢复的瑞典牧场上不同哨兵-2图像组合上的两个共同的STS深层学习架构,发现明确模拟年内变异性和每帕斯常态会增加可分离性,最佳模型的精确度达到0.88。 我们进一步调查我们的结果,并进行有针对性的偏见分析,发现可靠的部署需要时间上平衡的标签和评价协议,明确检验与年份有关的混乱。 因此,我们把我们的贡献描述为一个解决的恢复监测系统,而是一个现实的个案研究,研究什么是可行的,什么是失败的,以及未来的研究应该控制什么。 守则和模型见https://github.com/aleksispi/ml-nature-resto。

articles.title: Environment-Invariant Subspace Learning for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
articles.content: Cross-distribution generalization remains a critical bottleneck in deepfake detection. While recent efforts leverage the semantic priors of large-scale visual foundation models (VFMs), a noteworthy yet underexplored challenge remains: the susceptibility of these semantic priors to environmental interference from factors such as lighting and style. Crucially, this interference establishes spurious correlations between forgery cues and environmental patterns that severely limit generalization. To address this fundamental challenge, we propose an innovative Environment-Invariant Subspace Learning (EISL) framework. The core contribution of EISL is that it aims to disentangle features into orthogonal forgery-relevant invariant factors and environment-related residual factors via a learnable low-rank projection. To facilitate robust feature disentanglement, we also design an Environmental Intervention module that generates diverse and challenging intervention pairs, simulating out-of-distribution environmental shifts to guide the model toward discovering truly invariant forgery representations. Experiments across cross-dataset, cross-generator, whole-face synthesis, and corruption settings show consistent gains and competitive or leading performance against strong detectors, demonstrating improved robustness to unseen forgery types and environmental variations. This work provides a new perspective and a valuable exploration for understanding and tackling the generalization barriers of VFMs in deepfake detection.

articles.title_zh: 用于通用深假检测的环境- Invariant 子空间学习
articles.content_zh: 交叉分布通俗化仍然是深假检测中的一个关键瓶颈. 虽然最近的努力利用了大规模视觉基础模型(VFM)的语义学前科,但一项值得注意但探讨不足的挑战依然存在:这些语义学前科容易受到照明和风格等因素的环境干扰。 关键的是,这种干扰在伪造提示和环境模式之间建立了虚假的关联,严重限制了通俗化。 为了应对这一根本挑战,我们提出了一个创新性的“环境-生物多样性子空间学习”框架。 EISL的核心贡献是,它旨在通过可学习的低排名预测,将特征分解为正交假构相关变异因素和环境相关残余因素. 为了促进扎实的特征分解,我们还设计了一个环境干预模块,生成多样化和具有挑战性的干预对子,模拟分布外的环境变化,以指导模型发现真正无差异的伪造表述。 跨越跨数据集、跨源、全面合成和腐败环境的实验显示,对强探测器的一致收益和竞争性或领先性能,表明对隐形伪造类型和环境变化的强性有所提高。 这项工作为了解和解决VFM在深假探测方面的普遍化障碍提供了新的视角和宝贵的探索。

articles.title: Magnitude-Direction Decoupling for Fast Video Generation with Flow Matching Models
articles.content: Flow matching models for video generation achieve impressive performance but suffer from high computational overhead due to iterative denoising. In fact, the original model is not necessary for all denoising steps, allowing some steps to use lightweight alternatives for faster sampling. However, directly using caching or lightweight models can deviate from the original denoising trajectory, resulting in suboptimal performance. Through empirical analysis, we find that lightweight models can robustly capture the magnitude components of the original model's output, while caching provides reliable directional guidance. Building on this insight, we propose the Magnitude-Direction Decoupling (MDD) method, which adaptively employs a direction-calibrated lightweight model as a substitute for the original model to accelerate inference and effectively correct deviations in the denoising trajectory. Moreover, MDD further reduces inference costs by reusing magnitude information under classifier-free guidance (CFG). As a result, MDD offers a more reliable and lightweight solution to accelerate sampling. Experiments show that MDD outperforms existing acceleration methods, delivering promising speedups (e.g., up to 2.95x on Wan2.1) while preserving high visual fidelity and content richness.

articles.title_zh: 用于快速视频生成的磁带- 直线脱钩与流匹配模型
articles.content_zh: 视频生成流程匹配模型取得了令人印象深刻的性能,但因迭代调值而导致高计算间接费用。 实际上,最初的模型并不是所有去诺步骤都必需的,允许一些步骤使用轻量级替代品来更快地取样. 然而,直接使用缓冲或轻量级模型可以偏离原来的去诺化轨迹,导致性能不理想. 通过实证分析,我们发现轻量级模型可以强力地捕捉原始模型输出的尺寸成分,而缓存则提供可靠的方向引导. 基于这种洞察力,我们提出磁力-定向脱钩(MDD)方法,它适应性地采用方向校准的轻量级模型来替代原模型,以加速推论,有效纠正脱钩轨迹的偏差. 此外,MDD通过在无分级制导(CFG)下重新使用量值信息,进一步降低了推论成本. 因此,MDD为加速取样提供了更加可靠和轻度的解决方案. 实验显示,MDD超越了现有的加速方法,提供有希望的加速(例如,在Wan2.1上达到2.95x),同时保持较高的视觉忠诚度和内容丰富度.

articles.title: Differentiable Voronoi Ray Tracing Beyond Rasterization Speeds
articles.content: Real-time novel view synthesis is dominated by rasterized explicit primitives. These projection-based pipelines provide high throughput but require specialized extensions for non-pinhole effects such as distortion, rolling shutter, and depth of field. Ray-based rendering expresses these effects naturally but is generally assumed too slow for competitive real-time rendering. We analyze the factors governing throughput in differentiable Voronoi ray tracing and identify traversal length, per-cell work, and memory locality as principal determinants. Guided by this, we introduce VoroTracing, which co-designs the scene representation, optimization, and GPU execution to reduce these costs. Compact octahedral appearance textures reduce memory traffic, while surface-concentrated opacity promotes early termination. The fixed-budget representation is optimized without pruning or densification and rendered with a GPU implementation designed for coherent traversal. On Mip-NeRF 360, VoroTracing renders at 623 FPS on an RTX 5090, providing $3.2\times$ the throughput of the fastest prior ray-based method and $2.8\times$ that of 3D Gaussian Splatting, while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. Our renderer supports fisheye, rolling-shutter, motion-blur, and depth-of-field effects through ray generation and sampling, requiring no specialized rasterization. These results show that real-time throughput can be achieved with the flexibility of ray-based rendering. We release our source code, see https://research.zenseact.com/publications/vorotracing

articles.content_zh: 实时小说景观合成以光栅化的显性原始人为主. 这些基于投影的输油管提供较高的吞吐量,但需要对非管道效应,如扭曲、滚动百叶窗和外地深度进行专门扩展。 基于Ray的渲染会自然地表达这些效果,但一般认为对于竞争性实时渲染来说过于缓慢. 我们分析不同Voronoi射线追踪的吞吐量因素,并确定转盘长度、每个细胞的工作和记忆位置是主要的决定因素。 以此为指导,我们引入了VoroTracing,它共同设计了场景表现,优化,以及GPU执行以减少这些成本. 压缩八面体外观纹理会减少内存流量,而表面集中的不透明则促进提前终止. 固定预算代表制在不磨损或密集的情况下得到优化,并配有为连贯的转弯而设计的GPU执行。 在Mip-NERF 360上,VoroTracing在RTX 5090上制造了623 FPS,提供了3.2\times的以往最快射线法的吞吐量和2.8\times的3D高斯镀板,同时保持了竞争性重建质量. 我们的渲染器通过射线产生和采样支持鱼眼、滚射、运动和场深效应,不需要专门的光栅化。 这些结果表明,实时吞吐量可以通过射线渲染的灵活性来实现. 我们发布源代码,见https://research.zenseact.com/publications/vorotracing.

articles.title: Is Haar Enough? Exploring Symlets and Coiflets for Wavelet Convolution Layers
articles.content: Wavelet convolution layers have recently emerged as an efficient mechanism for enlarging receptive fields through multiresolution analysis, but prior work has fixed the wavelet basis to Haar or Daubechies at a chosen decomposition depth, leaving open whether a different basis can shift the underlying efficiency frontier. We identify and characterize a previously unexplored trade-off in this setting: bases with stronger approximation properties (longer filters) can reduce the decomposition depth required for competitive accuracy, yielding a net reduction in parameters and FLOPs despite higher perlevel transform cost. We formalize this as an F-vs.-L tradeoff (filter length vs. decomposition levels) and study it systematically across Haar, Daubechies, Symlets, and Coiflets under controlled architectures and budgets. On image classification (CIFAR-10, ImageNet-1K) and semantic segmentation (Cityscapes), Coiflet-based wavelet convolutions match Haar at deeper levels with approximately 32% fewer additional parameters and 33% fewer additional FLOPs, providing a concrete and actionable design choice for practitioners building wavelet-based architectures.
