articles.title_zh: 够吗? 探索波浪革命层的交响曲和交响曲
articles.content_zh: 最近出现了波浪演化层,作为通过多解析分析扩大可接受字段的有效机制,但以前的工作已经将波浪基固定在选定的分解深度上到Haar或Daubechies,留下了不同基础是否能够改变基本效率前沿的空洞. 我们在此设定中确定并定性以前未探索的权衡:具有较强近似特性(较长的滤波器)的基座可以降低竞争性精度所需的分解深度,导致参数和FLOP的净减少,尽管每层变换成本较高. 我们正式将它作为F-vs.-L的权衡(过滤长度与分解水平),并在受控制的架构和预算下,系统研究Haar,Daubechies,Symlets和Coiflets。 在图像分类(CIFAR-10,ImageNet-1K)和语义分类(Cityscapes)方面,Coiflet基波列演化在更深层次上与Haar匹配,额外参数减少约32%,额外FLOP减少33%,为实践者构建波列建筑提供了具体且可操作的设计选择.

articles.title: Denoised Variance-Based Pruning with Optimal Brain Bias Compensation
articles.content: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve state-of-the-art performance but carry massive computational overhead that restricts edge deployment. Although structural pruning has emerged as a key strategy to reduce these costs, existing methods often suffer from severe accuracy degradation or require expensive retraining. Recently, Variance-Based Pruning (VBP) introduced a promising paradigm by selecting neurons based on activation variance; however, it remains limited by statistical noise in finite-sample activation covariance and reliance on bias-only updates that cannot fully account for structural reconstruction error. To address these limitations, we introduce Denoised Variance-Based Pruning with Optimal Brain Bias Compensation (DVBP + OB$^2$C). We leverage random matrix theory to filter noise from the activation covariance spectrum for robust neuron selection and mathematically prove that integrating mean-shift compensation into the Optimal Brain Compression objective reduces the layer-wise Hessian exactly to the activation covariance matrix. This enables an optimal, closed-form update of the remaining weights using the same statistics gathered for selection. Extensive experiments on DeiT, Swin, and ConvNeXt architectures demonstrate that DVBP + OB$^2$C achieves state-of-the-art training-free performance; at 50% MLP pruning, it retains over 90% of the original Top-1 accuracy on Small and Base variants, outperforming VBP by up to 29.46% (ConvNeXt-T) and 7.33% (Swin-S). The code is available at: https://github.com/geontackee/DVBP_OB2C.

articles.title_zh: 以最佳脑病补偿方式消除差异
articles.content_zh: 视觉变形器(ViTs)实现了最先进的性能,但搭载了巨大的计算间接费用,限制了边缘部署. 虽然结构修补已成为减少这些费用的关键战略,但现有方法往往严重精度下降或需要昂贵的再培训。 最近,基于差异的Pruning(VBP)引入了一个很有希望的范式,根据激活差异选择神经元;然而,它仍然受到有限样本激活共变的统计噪声的限制,并依赖不能充分说明结构重建错误的仅偏偏的更新. 为了克服这些限制,我们采用了基于差异的Danoized Pruning(最佳脑病补偿)方法(DVBP+OB$^2C)。 我们利用随机矩阵理论从激活共变谱中过滤噪声,以进行强力的神经元选择,并用数学方法证明,将平均转值补偿纳入优化大脑压缩目标中,会将层层完全降低到激活共变矩阵中. 这使得能够利用所收集的相同统计数据对剩余权重进行最佳的封闭式更新。 对DeiT、Swin和ConvNEXt架构的广泛试验表明,DVBP + OB$^2$C实现了最先进的无培训性能;在50%的MLP普跑中,它保留了小变体和基变体上原有的Top-1精度的90%以上,比VBP高29.46%(ConvNEXt-T)和7.33%(Swin-S). 该代码可在https://github.com/geontackee/DVBP_OB2C查询.

articles.title: MaLViL: Multi-axis Low-rank Vision-LSTM for Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Vision-LSTM (ViL) enables efficient global modeling, but its cost still scales with the number of spatial tokens, so existing segmenters confine ViL to a coarse bottleneck and lose fine anatomical detail. Rasterizing 2D features into a 1D sequence further breaks adjacency across the orthogonal scan axis. We propose MaLViL, a Multi-axis Low-rank Vision-LSTM network that extends ViL across decoder resolutions. Bidirectional low-rank ViL (Bi-LRViL) reasons on a compact orthonormal subspace and preserves detail through an orthogonal residual; scale-aware SaLViL restores cross-axis neighbors before serialization; and a Cross-Directional Mixer (CDM) fuses orthogonal horizontal and vertical traversal paths. Statistics-Guided Skip Modulation (SGSM) further retains boundary cues in encoder skips. On skin-lesion, ultrasound, and multi-organ CT benchmarks, MaLViL achieves competitive or state-of-the-art segmentation accuracy, while reducing ViL operator memory by up to $83\times$ at fine decoder resolutions. Code is available at: https://github.com/xmindflow/malvil.

articles.title: RetiWave-Mamba: A Dual-Stream Network for Retinal Disease Detection based on Multi-scale Context and Frequency-Adaptive Mamba Projection
articles.content: Retinal diseases are a leading cause of irreversible vision impairment, making early and accurate diagnosis essential for effective treatment. Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) serves as a critical imaging modality for this purpose, yet its automated analysis is hindered by inherent speckle noise, varying lesion scales, and subtle inter-class similarities. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework, RetiWave-Mamba, which integrates spatial-frequency domain learning with state-of-the-art state space models. The framework utilizes Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) to decompose OCT images into low- and high-frequency streams, enabling decoupled processing of structural context and fine-grained details. For the low-frequency branch, we design a Multi-scale Contextual Localization Module (MCLM), which synergizes multi-scale dilation with spatial attention to expand the global receptive field and precisely localize lesion regions. For the high-frequency branch, we introduce an Attention-Guided High-Resolution Network (AG-HRNet) equipped with an intelligent gating mechanism to suppress noise propagation during multi-scale interactions. Furthermore, a Frequency-Adaptive Mamba Projector (FAMP) is incorporated to capture long-range dependencies within disjoint high-frequency textural features. Extensive experiments on the OCT-C8 dataset demonstrate that our approach achieves a state-of-the-art (SOTA) classification accuracy of 98.25%, surpassing existing methods. These results highlight the efficacy of RetiWave-Mamba in robustly identifying retinal pathologies under noisy conditions, offering a promising tool for clinical diagnosis.

articles.title_zh: RetiWave-Mamba:基于多尺度背景和频率的Mamba预测的视网膜疾病检测双层网络
articles.content_zh: 视网膜疾病是造成不可逆视力损伤的主要原因,因此,早期和准确诊断对有效治疗至关重要。 光学一致性摄影学(OCT)是这方面的关键成像模式,但其自动化分析受到内在的光谱噪音、各种损伤尺度和细微的阶级间相似性的影响。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了一个名为RetiWave-Mamba的新框架,将空间频域学习与最先进的国家空间模型结合起来。 该框架利用Discrete Wavelet Transform(DWT)将OCT图像分解为低频和高频流,使得结构上下文和细细细细细细细细节的处理得以解密. 对于低频分支,我们设计了一个多尺度背景本地化模块(MCLM),该模块将多尺度放大与空间注意力协同,以扩大全球可接受领域,并准确地将损伤区域本地化. 对于高频分支,我们引入了注意定向高分辨率网络(AG-HRNet),它配备了智能的测距机制,以抑制多尺度相互作用过程中的噪音传播。 此外,还加入了一个频率辅助Mamba投影仪(FAMP),以捕捉离散的高频纹理特征中的长距离依赖性。 对OCT-C8数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法实现了98.25%的先进分类精度,超过了现有方法。 这些结果突出表明了RetiWave-Mamba在强力识别吵闹条件下的视网膜病变方面的功效,为临床诊断提供了一个很有希望的工具.

articles.title: PathoArgus: Advancing Evidence-Grounded Long-Context Visual Reasoning across Gigapixel Whole-Slide and Multi-Slide Case Contexts
articles.content: Whole-slide pathology reasoning requires models to integrate gigapixel-scale visual evidence across complete case-linked slides, yet current question-answering benchmarks primarily measure final answer accuracy--a metric vulnerable to linguistic priors and benchmark regularities, and insufficient to establish that predictions are grounded in the supplied tissue. We introduce PathoArgus-Bench, a benchmark and evaluation protocol that explicitly tests the full evidence chain: availability, accessibility, use, and responsiveness. PathoArgus-Bench comprises 22,078 four-choice questions from 4,913 patients across 15 TCGA projects, covering six pathology capabilities across three levels of evidence demand, and operates under a fixed reader budget that retains only a small fraction of the gigapixel context. To further isolate evidence-grounded reasoning, we contribute ESG (Evidence State Quartets), a controlled set of 483 quartets where the question text is fixed while the target WSI set is moved, replaced, or removed, requiring consistent predictions across all states. Evaluating 20 general-purpose, medical, and pathology-specific systems reveals a stark gap: while GPT-5.6 achieves 57.09% overall accuracy and 57.04% on ESG, it correctly completes only 19 of 483 quartets (3.93% QExact), exposing that row-level accuracy does not translate into reliable evidence grounding. We also introduce PathoArgus, a fixed-budget reader that allocates context via question relevance and spatial coverage, attaining 50.39% overall accuracy yet only 1.86% QExact--demonstrating that improved context access alone does not ensure consistent evidence-based prediction. Our benchmark and diagnostics establish that acquiring useful whole-slide context is necessary but far from sufficient, and call for a shift from answer-centric to evidence-grounded evaluation in computational pathology.

articles.title_zh: PathoArgus: 推进跨 Gigapixel 全滑和多滑动案例背景的 环绕证据的长文字视觉理性
articles.content_zh: 整个滑坡病理推理需要模型将千兆像素尺度的视觉证据整合到完整的与案例相关的幻灯片中,然而目前的问答基准主要衡量最终答案的准确性-一个易受语言学前科和基准规律影响的度量指标,并且不足以确定预测基于供给的组织. 我们引入了PathoArgus-Bench,这是明确测试整个证据链:可用性、可获取性、使用性和反应性的基准和评价协议。 PathoArgus-Bench包含来自TCGA15个项目中4,913名患者的22,078个四选题,涵盖证据需求三个层次的6个病理能力,并在固定的阅读预算下运作,只保留一小部分的千兆像素上下文. 为了进一步孤立基于证据的推理,我们贡献了ESG(证据国四方),这是一套由483个问题文本固定在目标WSI集移动,替换或移除时的可控的一组四重奏,需要各州一致的预测. 评估20个通用、医学和病理特异性系统发现一个明显差距:GPT-5.6在总体精确度达到57.09%,在ESG上达到57.04%,但正确完成的只有483个四重奏中的19个(3.93%的QExact),暴露出行级精确度没有转化为可靠的证据依据。 我们还引入了PathoArgus,一个固定预算阅读器,通过提问相关性和空间覆盖来分配语境,达到50.39%的整体准确度,但只有1.86%的QExact-discription,仅改善语境访问并不能确保基于证据的一致预测. 我们的基准和诊断确定,获得有用的整体滑坡背景是必要的,但远远不够,并要求在计算病理学中从以答案为中心的评价转向以证据为基础的评价。

articles.title: SpurCon: Weighted Supervised Contrastive Learning for Mitigating Spurious Cues in Medical Imaging
articles.content: Despite the rapid progress of deep neural networks in visual recognition, their adoption in high-risk medical applications remains limited due to reliability and robustness concerns. Models may exploit spurious correlations, particularly in medical imaging, where devices or treatment artifacts often co-occur with pathology. In small or imbalanced datasets, such cues further reduce worst-group performance and undermine clinical trust. To solve these issues, two major challenges should be addressed: identifying dataset-specific spurious cues, which typically require domain knowledge, and mitigating reliance on them. To tackle both, we propose SpurCon, a lightweight framework based on a novel supervised contrastive loss formulation that leverages available metadata and predicted spurious labels to enhance robustness. We introduce a fast few-shot procedure, without network training, to estimate spurious labels using a small number of expert-annotated samples. We then propose a weighted supervised contrastive objective, WtSupCon, that reshapes the representation geometry by assigning sample-specific weights that depend on the [pathology, spurious, metadata] combination. For example, the highest weight is assigned to samples that differ only in their spurious label. This yields highly similar representations for images with the same metadata and pathology, differing only in the predicted spurious label. Our method operates on pretrained image encoders (such as BiomedCLIP) and trains only a lightweight projection head. We evaluate SpurCon on a synthetic setting and on Waterbirds, CheXpert, a chest X-ray classification dataset, and ISIC 2020, a skin cancer classification dataset. Our approach delivers the best spurious-mitigation performance, balancing well worst-group and overall accuracy on multiple datasets.

articles.title_zh: 购买:在医疗成像中为减低纯洁的丘陵进行加权监督的矛盾学习
articles.content_zh: 尽管深神经网络在视觉识别方面迅速取得进展,但由于可靠性和强性的关切,它们在高风险医疗应用中的采用仍然有限. 模型可能利用虚假的关联性,特别是在医疗成像方面,在医疗成像中,设备或治疗文物往往与病理学共同存在。 在小的或不平衡的数据集中,这种提示会进一步降低最差组的性能,破坏临床上的信任. 为了解决这些问题,应当解决两大挑战:确定通常需要域知识的数据集特有的虚假提示,并减少对它们的依赖。 为了解决这两个问题,我们提议建立Spurcon这一轻量级框架,其基础是新型的有监督的对比性损失表述,利用现有的元数据和预测的虚假标签来增强稳健性。 我们采用快速的几发程序,不经过网络培训,用少量专家说明的样本估计虚假标签。 然后,我们提出一个加权监督对比目标,即WtSupCon,它通过分配取决于[病理、虚伪、元数据]组合的特定样本权重来重塑代表几何。 例如,最高权重被分配到只有虚假标签的样品上. 这对具有相同元数据和病理的图像产生高度相似的表示,仅在预测的虚假标签中有所不同。 我们的方法在预先训练的图像编码器(如BiomedCLIP)上运行,并且只训练一个轻量级投影头. 我们对Spurcon进行合成环境评价,对Waterbirds、CheXpert、胸X射线分类数据集和ISIC 2020、皮肤癌分类数据集进行评价。 我们的方法提供了最佳的虚伪缓解性能,在多个数据集上平衡了最糟糕的组别和总体准确性.

articles.title: CoinVE-200K: A Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset for Compositional Instruction-Guided Video Editing
articles.content: The quality and diversity of instruction-based video editing datasets are steadily improving, yet existing datasets mainly focus on single editing operations and fall short in supporting compositional instruction-guided video editing. In particular, multiple editing intents must be jointly understood and faithfully executed within the same video. To address this issue, we introduce CoinVE-200K, a large-scale, high-quality dataset for Compositional Instruction-Guided Video Editing. CoinVE-200K contains 1080p video-editing pairs of up to 201 frames, covering diverse compositional scenarios where each sample involves 2 to 5 atomic editing operations. The instructions target humans, objects, and backgrounds, and cover edit types such as addition, removal, modification, and stylization. All samples are built through a carefully designed generation and filtering pipeline to ensure instruction faithfulness, visual quality, temporal consistency, and compositional diversity. We also introduce CoinVE-Bench, a benchmark for compositional-instruction video editing across diverse subjects, operation types, and instruction complexities. Furthermore, we present CoinVE-Edit, a 22B compositional video editing model built upon Wan2.1-T2V-14B and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. CoinVE-Edit disentangles region-aware attention for different editing instructions, enabling precise multi-region editing while preserving irrelevant content and temporal coherence. Experiments on CoinVE-Bench show that CoinVE-Edit achieves strong performance in instruction following, compositional editing accuracy, visual quality, and temporal consistency.

articles.title_zh: COINVE-200K:用于构成指令的大型高质量数据集-指导视频编辑
articles.content_zh: 以教学为主的视频编辑数据集的质量和多样性在稳步提高,然而现有的数据集主要侧重于单一编辑操作,在支持成分指导-指导视频编辑方面还存在不足. 特别是,必须在同一视频中共同理解并忠实地执行多种编辑意图。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了CoinVE-200K,一个大规模,高质量的数据集,用于组成指令-指导视频编辑. CoinVE-200K包含1080p视频编辑对最多201帧,涵盖不同构成情景,每个样本涉及2至5个原子编辑操作. 指令针对人类,物品,和背景,并覆盖编辑类型,如添加,移除,修改,以及结构化. 所有样品都是通过精心设计的生成和过滤管道建造的,以确保教学的忠实性、视觉质量、时间一致性和组成多样性。 我们还引入了CoinVE-Bench,这是不同主题、操作类型和教学复杂性的构成-教学视频编辑的基准。 此外,我们介绍CoinVE-Edit,一个基于Wan2.1-T2V-14B和Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct的22B组成视频编辑模型。 CoinVE-Edit对不同编辑指令的注意分散区域意识,使得能够进行精确的多区域编辑,同时保留不相关的内容和时间一致性. 在CoinVE-Bench上的实验显示,CoinVE-Edit在后续指令,组成编辑精度,视觉质量,以及时间一致性方面都实现了强效.

articles.title: Where a New Concept Must Enter: Entry Point Gates Cross-Task Usability in Unified Multimodal Models
articles.content: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) are motivated by the hope that understanding and generation reinforce each other but controlled ablations repeatedly find that adding a generation objective leaves understanding flat. Joint-training studies cannot settle the disagreement: with overlapping supervision, a gain cannot be attributed to the architecture rather than the data. To further investigate the relationship between the two directions in UMMs, we separate them by construction. A novel visual entity, a rendered 3D asset paired with a pseudo-word screened for absence from the frozen model's behavior, is bound through exactly one task direction, and the untrained direction is then measured. We find that the channel is real in both directions, but the directions differ in kind: generation training installs a name the model can only match among candidates; understanding training installs one it can also produce. What governs cross-task usability is where the binding enters the shared computation. An alignment probe predicts export across 36 configurations (Spearman $ρ= +0.68$). That objective's alignment term, maximized in closed form over activations with every weight frozen, makes a concept drawable when injected at layer 7 of 28 and is indistinguishable from the base model from layer 14 on, while the weight-based version of the same edit peaks at layers 10-14. In an observational series of four models, this window appears only where the understanding pathway is a semantic vision encoder, suggesting that unified weights are not enough: the two directions must share a semantic format at the entry point. Exploiting the rule, a mid-stack alignment objective acquires the concept for a $0.1\%$ relative loss of the model's general text-to-image ability, against $41\%$ for the standard generative route. Our code is at https://github.com/Zane-ZYQiu/entry-point-umm.

articles.title_zh: 新概念必须输入的地方: 统一多式联运模式中的任务交叉使用
articles.content_zh: 统一的多式联运模式(UMM)的动机是希望理解和生成能相互加强,但受控制的擦伤会一再发现,增加一代人的客观会使理解平坦。 联合培训研究不能解决分歧:由于监管重叠,不能将收益归结于架构而不是数据。 为了进一步调查UMM两个方向之间的关系,我们通过建筑来将它们分开. 一个新颖的视觉实体,一个制成的3D资产与一个假字对齐,被筛选出冷冻模型的行为,它通过完全一个任务方向绑定,然后测量未经训练的方向. 我们发现这个频道在两个方向上都是真实的,但是这个方向在形式上是不同的: 生成训练安装了一个这个模型只能在考生中匹配的名称; 理解训练安装了一个它也可以产生的名称. 规范跨任务可用性的地方是约束输入共享计算的地方. 一个对齐探测器预测出36种配置的出口(Spearman $ρ=+0.68美元). 这个目标的对齐术语,在每件重量冻结的激活上以闭合形式最大化,使得概念在28的7层注入时可以引出,并且从14层上与基模型无法区分,而同一编辑峰值的重量版则在10-14层上. 在由四个模型组成的观测系列中,这个窗口只出现在理解路径是语义视觉编码器的地方,这表明统一加权是不够的:两个方向必须在切入点共享语义格式. 利用这个规则,一个中档对接目标获得一个概念,即模型一般文字对图像能力的相对损失为0.1美元,而标准基因路线为41美元。 我们的代码在https://github.com/Zane-ZYQiu/entry-point-umm上.

articles.title: Leveraging existing sparse point annotations for benthic imagery dense segmentation
articles.content: The health of marine ecosystems is a critical indicator of global environmental change, yet the physical constraints of underwater observation and the intrinsic challenges of processing marine imagery severely limit the scalability of systematic monitoring. While recent visual foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) series show great promise, they still struggle with the fine-grained recognition required in these complex scenarios and still require expert supervision. Our work addresses this gap by bridging state-of-the-art foundation models with existing sparse supervision. Because historical benthic surveys are typically annotated with only a few sparse expert points per image, we utilize these legacy point-labels as visual prompts for SAM2. Our primary contribution is a novel mechanism to automatically identify which of these points are suitable, and which are actively harmful, when used for propagation. By filtering out unreliable points, we extract high-quality pseudo-ground-truth masks capable of training more accurate, fine-grained semantic segmentation models. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on public benthic data and introduce a new, challenging benchmark featuring real-world sparse expert annotations, paving the way for scalable ecological analysis.

articles.title_zh: 利用现有的海底图像密集分块稀疏点说明
articles.content_zh: 海洋生态系统的健康是全球环境变化的关键指标,但水下观测的实际限制和处理海洋图像的内在挑战严重限制了系统监测的可扩展性。 虽然近期的视觉基础模型,如September Anything Models(SAM)系列显示出巨大的希望,但它们仍然与这些复杂情景中所需的精细识别相抗衡,仍然需要专家监督. 我们的工作解决了这一差距,将最先进的基础模式与现有的有限监督联系起来。 由于历史底栖调查通常每幅图像只附带几个稀疏的专家点,我们利用这些遗留的点标签作为SAM2的视觉提示. 我们的主要贡献是一个新颖的机制,可以自动确定哪些要点是合适的,哪些要点在用于传播时是有害的。 通过过滤不可靠的点,我们提取出高质量的伪地面真实口罩,能够训练出更准确,精细的语义分区模型. 我们展示了我们在公共海底数据方面的做法的有效性,并引入了新的、具有挑战性的基准,其中包含现实世界稀少的专家说明,为可扩展的生态分析铺平了道路。

articles.title: MSEditor: Toward Consistent Multi-Shot Video Editing
articles.content: In this paper, we tackle the problem of performing consistent, unified modifications to a multi-shot video sequence. This task is particularly challenging because multi-shot videos consist of discontinuous temporal segments that vary significantly in viewpoint, camera scale, and subject pose, leading to severe identity drift and cumulative error propagation. Achieving coherent edits requires establishing reliable cross-shot semantic awareness to maintain stable subject appearance and visual continuity across these disjointed boundaries. To address this, we propose MSEditor, the first framework designed specifically for consistent multi-shot video editing. To overcome the scarcity of high-quality multi-shot training data, we repurpose existing multi-view video datasets to provide robust cross-shot supervision. Architecturally, we introduce a Supervisory Adapter that injects this cross-shot information into the diffusion backbone, enabling the model to learn identity-consistent representations. Furthermore, to effectively mitigate cumulative errors and ensure long-range temporal coherence, we design a Cross-Shot Packing strategy that dynamically aggregates information from semantically related shots within the self-attention window. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MSEditor significantly outperforms existing methods on our curated multi-shot video editing benchmark in terms of identity preservation, temporal stability, and overall visual quality.

articles.title_zh: MSEditor: 向一致的多热视频编辑
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们解决了对多镜头视频序列进行一致,统一修改的问题. 这项任务尤其具有挑战性,因为多镜头视频由不连续的时间段组成,在视线、相机尺度和主题布置方面差异很大,导致严重的身份漂移和累积错误传播。 实现连贯的编辑需要建立可靠的跨镜头语义意识,以保持稳定的主题外观和跨越这些脱节边界的视觉连续性. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出MSEditor,这是第一个专门为一致的多镜头视频编辑设计的框架. 为了克服高质量多镜头培训数据的稀缺性,我们重新使用现有的多视图视频数据集,以提供有力的交叉镜头监督. 从结构上来说,我们引入了一个监督适应器,将这种交叉镜头的信息注入传播主干,使模型能够学习与身份一致的表达. 此外,为了有效减少累积错误和确保时间上的长距离一致性,我们设计了一个跨热包装战略,在自觉窗口内动态地汇总来自精密相关镜头的信息. 广泛实验显示,MSEditor在身份保存、时间稳定性和整体视觉质量方面大大超过我们掌握的多镜头视频编辑基准的现有方法。

articles.title: Code as Representation: A Compilable Parsing Paradigm for Academic Documents
articles.content: Academic papers are a primary carrier of scientific knowledge, yet most of this knowledge remains locked in PDFs that are optimized for human reading rather than machine use. For Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), the core challenge is not only perception, but representation: scientific pages interleave text with Structured Academic Elements (SAEs) such as tables, formulas, charts, and pseudocode, whose structure, data, and logic are poorly preserved by common surrogates like Markdown. We therefore propose Compilable Academic Document Parsing (CADP), a paradigm that reconstructs a full page as contextual \LaTeX{} plus executable Python, so that structure-preserving elements and executable chart representations can be reconstructed, recompiled, and directly verified against the source page. To support this setting, we introduce CADP-Bench, an expert-verified benchmark of full academic pages containing tightly coupled text and multiple SAE types, evaluated through a re-injection compilation protocol. We further study current capabilities using SOTA MLLMs and an exploratory multi-agent baseline that incorporates common agentic techniques. Results show that even frontier models still struggle to produce high-fidelity executable reconstructions, highlighting substantial room for improvement in structure-aware scientific document parsing. CADP-Bench is released for future research.

articles.title_zh: 代表守则: 学术文件可编译解析范式
articles.content_zh: 学术论文是科学知识的主要载体,然而,这些知识大多仍然被锁定在PDF中,这些PDF被优化为人类阅读而非机器使用. 对于多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs),核心挑战不仅在于感知,而且在于表现:科学页与结构化学术元素(SAEs),如表格,公式,图表,以及伪码等文本互换,其结构,数据和逻辑被Markdown等常见代词保存不佳. 因此,我们提出可编译学术文档解析(CADP),这个范式将整页重建为背景\LaTeX{}+可执行 Python,这样结构保存元素和可执行图表表达可以重建,重新编译,直接对照源页面进行校验. 为支持这一设置,我们采用了CADP-Bench,这是经专家验证的全学术页面基准,包含紧密结合的文本和多种SAE类型,通过重新注入汇编协议进行评估. 我们利用SOTA MLLMs和包含共同剂技术的探索性多剂基线,进一步研究目前的能力。 结果显示,即使是前沿模型也仍然难以进行高可靠性的可执行重建,突出表明了在结构意识科学文件分析方面有很大的改进余地。 CADP-Bench发布 未来研究.

articles.title: GroupForward: Building Referable 3D Scenes via Instance-Grouped Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Simultaneously reconstructing and understanding 3D environments is essential for embodied agents. Toward this goal, feed-forward semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) efficiently constructs semantic scene representations from sparse multi-view observations. However, existing methods lack explicit instance discrimination and mainly support category- or phrase-based semantic queries. To this end, we propose GroupForward, an instance-grouped feed-forward Gaussian splatting model that reconstructs geometry, appearance, instance structure, and semantics from sparse, unposed, and uncalibrated multi-view images. Unlike existing methods that attach high-dimensional semantic features to each Gaussian, GroupForward learns compact instance embeddings that group Gaussians into cross-view consistent 3D instances, reformulating feed-forward semantic 3DGS from per-Gaussian semantic feature rendering to instance-level semantic aggregation and propagation. Building on these instance groups, we further propose a Referential Scene Reasoning Framework (RSRF) for complex 3D referring segmentation. RSRF constructs an instance-grouped 3D scene graph and retrieves candidate instances for a given referring expression. A vision-language model then reasons over structured instance evidence and multi-view observations to identify the referred instance among the candidates. RSRF thereby extends language interaction from simple semantic querying to complex referential scene reasoning. Experiments on semantic reconstruction and referential reasoning demonstrate the effectiveness of our instance-grouped reconstruction and reasoning framework.

articles.title_zh: GroupForward:通过实例组Feed-Forward Gaussian Splateting 构建可引用的 3D 屏幕
articles.content_zh: 同时重建和理解三维环境对体现的代理人至关重要。 为实现这一目标,向导语义学 3D 高斯白板(3DGS) 高效构建了从稀少的多视图观测中得出的语义场景表现. 然而,现有方法缺乏明确的例子歧视,主要支持基于类别或短语的语义查询。 为此,我们提出GroupForward(GroupForward),一个实例组合的Feed-forward Gaussian的浮雕模型,从稀疏,不可用,不校准的多视图图像中重建几何,外观,实例结构,和语义. 与现有方法将高维语义特征附加到每个高斯人身上不同,GroupForward学习了将高斯人组嵌入到交叉视图一致的3D实例中的紧凑实例,从每个高斯人语义特征中重新塑造了feed-forward语义 3DGS,渲染成实例级语义聚合和传播. 在这些实例组合的基础上,我们进一步提出了关于复杂三维参考分解的参考场景理由框架。 RSRF 构建一个实例组合的 3D 场景图, 并检索特定引用表达式的候选实例 。 然后,一个视觉语言模型对结构化案例证据和多观点观察提出了理由,以确定候选人中的推荐案例。 RSRF由此将语言交互从简单的语义查询扩展到复杂的偏好场景推理. 关于语义重建和特惠推理的实验表明,我们按实例分组的重建和推理框架是有效的。

articles.title: Explainable AI-Powered Framework for Video-Based Skill Assessment in Cataract Surgery
articles.content: Persistent shortages in the surgical workforce and inherent limitations of traditional training methods highlight the necessity of automated, data-driven approaches in surgical education. This study addresses these challenges by introducing a novel, explainable AI-powered framework for automated skill assessment, specifically focusing on cataract surgery. We present the world's largest dataset of cataract surgery videos, comprising 2,000 recordings. Additionally, we propose an AI-powered analytical framework that employs advanced computer vision and signal-processing techniques to automatically evaluate surgical videos to derive objective, quantitative performance indicators that complement or potentially replace subjective scoring methods. A significant advantage of our framework over previous methods lies precisely in its explainability of outputs, elevating it beyond merely an opaque skill classification tool. Through experimental analysis of 83 cataract surgery videos, we demonstrate that the automatically computed metrics exhibit strong correlations with expert-based subjective evaluations, achieving up to 87% accuracy in surgical skill assessment. Each metric was individually examined, and expert surgeons provided subjective ratings using the newly introduced Capsulorhexis Skill Assessment System (CSAS). These subjective assessments were compared with ten objective motion-based metrics extracted through our framework. The results indicated a robust correlation between subjective ratings and automated indicators, underscoring the framework's capacity to accurately model surgical expertise.

articles.title_zh: Cataract外科中基于视频的技术评估解释性AI授权框架
articles.content_zh: 外科医生队伍的持续短缺以及传统培训方法的固有局限性突出表明,在外科教育中必须采用自动化、数据驱动的方法。 本研究针对这些挑战,引入了全新的,可解释的AI动力框架,用于自动化技能评估,具体侧重于白内障手术. 我们介绍了世界上最大的白内障手术录像数据集,包括2000个录音。 此外,我们提出一个AI动力分析框架,采用先进的计算机视觉和信号处理技术,自动评价手术录像,以得出客观、量化的绩效指标,补充或可能取代主观评分方法。 我们的框架相对于以往方法的一个重要优势恰恰在于其产出的可解释性,将其提升到不仅仅是一种不透明的技能分类工具。 通过对83个白内障手术视频的实验分析,我们显示,自动计算的衡量标准与专家主观评价有很强的相关性,在手术技能评估中达到了高达87%的准确度. 每个衡量标准都经过个别审查,专家外科医生利用新采用的Capsulorhexis技能评估系统提供主观评级。 这些主观评估与通过我们框架提取的10项基于运动的客观衡量标准相比较。 结果表明,主观评级和自动化指标之间有着密切的关联性,强调了该框架准确模拟外科专业的能力。

articles.title: BrainNorm: A Foundation Model that knows Normal via Semantic Atlas Pretraining
articles.content: We introduce BrainNorm, a normative foundation model, trained and tested on ~66,000 T1-weighted structural MRI (T1w sMRI) scans. By leveraging language-image style contrastive pretraining on healthy cohorts across ages, BrainNorm learns a Semantic Atlas Latent space (SAL), where each scan is represented as a set of atlas-parcel embeddings. This yields parcel-specific healthy aging template trajectories that support age-consistent template matching and localized deviation scoring relative to a subject's chronological age. Across 6 downstream cohorts, BrainNorm demonstrates generalization evaluated across 25 task-setting combinations spanning age estimation, brain-age gap estimation, parcel identification, and single- & multi-disease classification tasks under direct inference, zero-shot, few-shot & full-data linear-probe settings. The resulting deviation patterns in SAL space enable zero-shot tasks for disease prediction using parcel-wise abnormalities. Fine-tuning on healthy-only cohorts of downstream datasets further improves the performance of various tasks. Across all classification tasks, linear probing on BrainNorm's frozen embeddings outperforms 9 baselines finetuned under end-to-end supervision. Furthermore, the localized deviations identified by BrainNorm across various neurodegenerative disorders closely align with established neurodegeneration pathology in clinical literature.

articles.title_zh: BrainNorm:通过语义图集预训来了解常态的基础模型
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了BrainNorm,一种规范性的基础模型,在~66,000T1加权结构核磁共振扫描(T1w SMRI)上接受训练和测试. BrainNorm通过利用语言-图像风格对不同年龄的健康群体进行对比性预训,学习了一套语义图集Latent空间(SAL),其中每次扫描都作为一组地图集-parcel嵌入. 这样可以产生特定包裹的健康老化模板轨迹,支持与年龄一致的模板匹配,并相对于一个学科的时间年龄进行局部偏差评分. 在下游的6个群体中,BrainNorm展示了对25个任务设定组合的概括性评价,这些组合涵盖年龄估计、脑龄差距估计、包裹识别、以及直接推断、零镜头、零镜头和全数据线性测试设置下的单一和多重疾病分类任务。 由此产生的SAL空间的偏差模式使得使用包裹异常来进行疾病预测的零镜头任务成为可能. 精细调整健康唯心型下游数据集,进一步提高各项任务绩效. 在所有分类任务中,线性探测 BrainNorm的冷冻嵌入 超过9个基线 在端到端监督下微调。 此外,BrainNorm在各种神经退化性紊乱中查明的局部偏差与临床文献中既定的神经退化病理学紧密一致。

articles.title: Looking Beyond the Scale: Do Surgical Skill Models Learn Transferable Representations Across Assessment Rubrics?
articles.content:
Vision-based surgical skill assessment has shown strong in-domain results, yet a fundamental question remains unasked: do these models learn transferable representations of surgical proficiency, or do they merely encode dataset-specific visual patterns?
  This paper systematically analyzes what limits cross-domain skill transfer between the GOALS and OSATS assessment scales using the LASANA and JIGSAWS datasets. Each evaluated method serves a targeted diagnostic purpose: end-to-end training to test whether supervised skill learning transfers directly, Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization (ASAM) to probe whether flatter loss landscapes improve generalization, and augmentation-based self-supervised and contrastive learning to assess whether domain-invariant pretraining decouples skill from visual context. Transfer is evaluated in both directions using a disjoint-participant held-out test set for JIGSAWS.
  Results reveal an asymmetry: backbones pretrained on JIGSAWS achieve CCC values of 0.77 to 0.80 on LASANA, closely matching the end-to-end baseline, showing cross-rubric transfer is feasible when the target domain provides consistent supervision. Transfer to JIGSAWS fails across all methods, likely due to annotation inconsistencies. Control experiments with a Kinetics-pretrained backbone suggest task-specific heads carry the majority of the skill prediction burden, while the backbone need only provide adequate spatiotemporal features.
  These findings offer a new perspective on vision-based skill assessment: the central question of whether skill representations transfer across scoring systems has not been previously investigated. Results indicate the visual component is dominant but not solely responsible for skill prediction; further work is needed to conclusively disentangle transferable skill features from those bound to a specific visual domain.

articles.title_zh: 《超越规模的展望:外科技术模型是否学习跨评估的可转让的描述?
articles.content_zh:
基于视觉的外科手术技能评估显示出强烈的内在效果,然而一个根本问题仍未解决:这些模型是学习手术熟练程度的可转移表现,还是只是编码数据集特有的视觉模式?
本文系统地分析了使用LASANA和JIGSAWS数据集限制GOALS和OSATS评估尺度之间跨域技能转移的因素。 每一种评估方法都具有有针对性的诊断目的:进行端到端培训,以测试是否直接进行受监督的技能学习转移;适应性尖锐-最小化(ASAM),以探究受宠损失景观是否改善概括性;基于增强的自我监督和对比性学习,以评估域-不变量预训脱钩技能是否从视觉上看。 转让使用JIGSAWS的脱节-参与者搁置测试装置,双向评估。
结果显示不对称:在JIGSAWS上预先训练的骨干在LASANA上达到0.77到0.80的CCS值,紧密匹配端对端基线,显示在目标域提供一致监督时交叉转录是可行的. 向JIGSAWS的转移在所有方法上都失败,可能是由于注释不一致。 使用 Kinetics 预先训练的骨干进行控制实验表明,任务特定头头承担了大部分技能预测负担,而骨干只需要提供足够的瞬间特征。
这些结论为基于愿景的技能评估提供了新的视角:以前是否没有调查过跨评分系统的技能表现转移这一核心问题。 结果表明,视觉部分占主导地位,但并不完全负责技能预测;需要进一步开展工作,最终将可转移的技能特征从捆绑到特定视觉领域。

articles.title: SE-MoLoRA: Shared-Expert LoRA Adapters for Domain-Specific Photographic Assessment
articles.content: Vision-language models can describe images fluently, but they often fail to provide actionable photographic critique because semantic content and aesthetic judgment remain entangled. We propose SE-MoLoRA, a modular parameter-efficient adaptation framework for domain-specific photographic assessment. The method separates general photographic knowledge from specialist residual judgments using an always-active shared LoRA expert and routed adapters for composition, lighting, and technical quality. A lightweight query router selects the relevant specialist, enabling targeted critique without training separate full models. A rank-64 shared adapter captures broad photographic vocabulary, while rank-32 specialists learn domain-specific residuals with an orthogonal regularization penalty that encourages disentangled representations. Training data is obtained by distilling the Reddit Photo Critique Dataset into domain-labeled critique samples. On held-out critique generation, SE-MoLoRA improves BERTScore-F1 from 0.2317 to 0.4215 over monolithic LoRA and is preferred in 84.6\% of pairwise comparisons, while using fewer active parameters than separate specialist models. SVD-based ablation study shows that shared-specialist decomposition and orthogonal regularization reduce expert overlap. These results demonstrate that modular adaptation improves controllability and specificity in multimodal photographic critique.

articles.title_zh: SE-MoLORA:用于特定领域摄影评估的共享-专家LORA适应器
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型可以流利地描述图像,但由于语义内容和审美判断仍然纠缠在一起,它们往往无法提供可操作的摄影批评. 我们提出SE-MoLORA,这是针对特定领域图片评估的模块化参数高效适应框架。 该方法将一般摄影知识与专业余量判断区分开来,使用始终活跃的共享LORA专家以及路由适配器进行配制、照明和技术质量。 轻量级查询路由器会选择相关的专家,从而能够进行有针对性的批评,而不培训单独的完整模型. 一个64级的共享适配器可以捕捉到广泛的摄影词汇,而32级的专家则学习特定领域残留物,其正交规范化处罚鼓励分散的表达. 培训数据是通过将Reddit Photo Critique Datas集蒸馏成域标注批评样本获得的。 在被搁置的批评生成中,SE-MoLORA将BERTScore-F1从0.2317改进为0.4215,优于单体LORA,在84.6+%对等比较中更受青睐,同时使用的有效参数比单独的专家模型少。 基于SVD的消化研究显示,共享专家分解和正统规范减少了专家的重叠. 这些结果显示,模块化的适应提高了多式摄影批评的可控性和特殊性。

articles.title: When More Foundation Models Means Less: Diagnosing and Addressing Multi-View Fusion Failure
articles.content: Foundation-model hubs turn multi-view fusion into a selection problem: from a large heterogeneous encoder pool, which views should be fused, and how many? We show that downstream performance is non-monotonic in the number of fused encoders; later views can be redundant or task-misaligned, causing accuracy to saturate or decline. We formalise this setting as view-set composition and propose KAGES (Kernel-Alignment Greedy Encoder Selector), a label-aware method that orders frozen encoders by their marginal gain in centred kernel-target alignment. KAGES requires no downstream classifier training during selection, evaluates each candidate in $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ time independent of encoder dimension, and admits a conditional $(1-e^{-γ})$ prefix-wise guarantee under monotonicity and a positive submodularity ratio. Across five recognition regimes and low-shot, larger-pool, and full-data protocols, KAGES improves average AULC over full fusion by 3.9, 5.8, and 3.3 points, respectively, and exceeds DPP and facility-location selection in average AULC. Image retrieval exhibits later, task-dependent saturation along the KAGES ordering, while peak-then-decline reproduces in frozen-LLM fusion. These results show that effective large-pool fusion depends on selecting a compact, task-aligned set of views rather than indiscriminately fusing more encoders.

articles.title_zh: 当更多基础模型意味着减少:诊断和解决多维融合失败
articles.content_zh: 基础-模型集线器将多视融合变成一个选择问题:从一个巨大的异形编码器集合中,哪些观点应该连接起来,以及有多少? 我们显示,下游的性能在引信编码器数量上是非摩诺化的;后来的视图可能是冗余的或任务密联的,导致精度饱和或下降. 我们把这个设置形式化为视图集组成,并提议KAGES(Kernel-Alignment Greedy Encoder Selector),这是一种具有标签意识的方法,它通过在中心内核-目标对齐中的边际收益来命令冻结编码器. KAGES 在选择时不需要下游分类器培训,以$\ mathcal{O}(n^2)$的时间对每个候选人进行独立于编码器维度的评分,并在单调性和正次模态比下接受有条件的$(1-e^{-γ})$前缀保证. 在所有五个识别制度和低射、大池和全数据协议中,KAGES将AULC的平均比全聚率分别提高3.9、5.8和3.3分,超过平均AULC的DPP和设施位置选择。 后期图像检索显示,任务依赖的饱和沿KAGES订购,而峰值-时下行在冷冻-LLM聚变中复制. 这些结果表明,有效的大集合聚变取决于选择一套紧凑、任务相配合的观点,而不是不加区别地使用更多的编码器。

articles.title: NeuroPath: Brain-Inspired Dual-Pathway Graph Convolutional Networks for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
articles.content: Skeleton-based action recognition aims to recognize human actions from sequences of human joint coordinates. Most existing Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (STGCNs) have achieved promising results by modeling skeletal structures with implicit spatial-temporal representations. However, our empirical study reveals a clear performance imbalance across different skeletal modalities, indicating that implicitly coupling spatial and temporal information limits the full exploitation of complementary structural and motion cues. Inspired by the ventral and dorsal pathways in human perception, we propose Dual-Pathway Graph Convolutional Networks (NeuroPath), which adopt a dual-pathway architecture for separate yet collaborative modeling of spatial and temporal information. Specifically, transformation units first convert the input into pathway-specific skeletal representations, allowing each pathway to focus on complementary aspects of human motion. To further capture coordinated joint behaviors and their interrelationships, we introduce a group graph convolution block that dynamically identifies key body parts and models their spatial-temporal dependencies. In addition, inter-pathway dynamic fusion modules integrate complementary inter-modal information across pathways, facilitating higher-level semantic interpretation of actions. Extensive experiments on Kinetics Skeleton 400, NTU RGB+D 60, and NTU RGB+D 120 demonstrate consistent performance improvements, validating the effectiveness of dual-pathway spatial-temporal modeling for skeleton-based action recognition.

articles.title_zh: Neuropath: 大脑启发双Pathway图解 用于Skeleton行动识别的革命网络
articles.content_zh: 基于Skeleton的动作识别旨在从人类联合坐标序列中识别人类行动. 大多数现有的空间-时空图脉冲网络通过模拟带有暗含空间-时空表示的骨骼结构,取得了可喜的成果。 然而,我们的经验研究揭示了不同骨骼模式之间明显的性能不平衡,表明空间和时间信息的隐含结合限制了互补结构和运动提示的充分利用。 在人类认知的通风道和内脏道的启发下,我们提议采用双路图革命网络(NeuroPath),采用双路结构,对空间和时间信息进行单独但合作的模型。 具体来说,转化单元首先将输入转化为路径特定骨骼表示,使每个路径都能够专注于人类运动的互补方面. 为了进一步捕捉协调的联合行为及其相互关系,我们引入了一个群图演化块,该块能动态地识别关键身体部分并模拟其空间-时空依赖性. 此外,跨路径动态聚变模块整合了跨路径互补的跨模式信息,促进了对行动的更高层次语义解释. 关于Kinetics Skeleton 400,NTU RGB+D 60,NTU RGB+D 120的广泛实验展示了一致的性能改进,验证了双路径空间-时态模型对骨架作用识别的有效性.

articles.title: S$^3$AM: A Single-Stream SAM with Reliability-Calibrated Frequency Adapter for Multi-modal Salient Object Detection
articles.content: Vision foundation models have recently advanced multi-modal salient object detection (MSOD) through parameter-efficient tuning and prompt learning. However, existing Segment Anything Model (SAM)-adapted MSOD methods often rely on dual-stream encoders or auxiliary prompt generators, leading to redundant computation. Although a single-stream alternative can reduce this cost, early fusion may also propagate noisy or misaligned auxiliary high-frequency cues through the backbone. In this paper, we propose a novel single-stream framework that integrates reliability-calibrated frequency adaptation into the adopted SAM backbone for MSOD. It avoids duplicated foundation backbones while explicitly controlling auxiliary frequency injection. Specifically, we design a mixture of frequency experts module, which uses the stationary wavelet transform to decompose each modality and aggregate cross-modal frequency information. We further introduce a reliability-calibrated frequency adapter with a dual-gate calibration mechanism, which selectively propagates the calibrated residual across transformer stages while jointly controlling its injection strength and cross-modal reliability. A hypernetwork-guided semantic-structural decoder then combines semantic mask features from the adopted backbone with Mamba-based structural detail recovery. Comprehensive experiments on RGB-D, RGB-T, and RGB-NIR salient object detection benchmarks validate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance with only 12.20M trainable parameters, accounting for 5.4\% of the total parameters. The code will be available at https://github.com/xuboyue1999/SSSAM.

articles.title_zh: S$^3$AM: 单层SAM, 具有可可靠性- 校准频率适配器, 用于多式敏感对象检测
articles.content_zh: 远景基础模型最近通过参数效率调试和及时学习,推进了多模式突出物体检测。 然而,现有的分段任意模型(SAM)适应的MSOD方法往往依赖于双流编码器或辅助的即时生成器,导致冗余计算. 虽然一种单流替代品可以降低这一成本,但早期聚变也可能通过骨干传播噪音或错位的辅助高频提示. 在本文中,我们提出了一个新的单流框架,将可靠性校准频率适应纳入MSOD所采用的SAM主干线. 它在明确控制辅助频率注射的同时避免了基础骨干重复. 具体来说,我们设计了一个频率专家模块的混合,该模块利用固定的波形变换来分解每一种模式和汇总跨模式频率信息. 我们进一步采用可靠性校准频率适配器,采用双门校准机制,有选择地在变压器各个阶段传播校准残留,同时联合控制其注射强度和跨模式可靠性. 一个超网络制导的语义-结构解码器,然后将被采纳的骨干中的语义面具特征与基于曼巴的结构细节恢复结合起来. 关于RGB-D,RGB-T,RGB-NIR显著对象检测基准的全面实验证实,拟议框架仅以12.20M可训练参数实现竞争性性能,占总参数的5.4\%. 该编码可在https://github.com/xuboyue1999/SSAM上查阅。

articles.title: NGS-Marker: Robust Native Watermarking for 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: With the rapid development and adoption of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), the need for effective copyright protection has become increasingly critical. Existing watermarking techniques for 3DGS mainly focus on protecting rendered images via pre-trained decoders, leaving the underlying 3D Gaussian primitives vulnerable to misuse. In particular, they are ineffective against Partial Infringement, where an adversary extracts and reuses only a subset of Gaussians. In this paper, we propose NGS-Marker, a novel native watermarking framework for 3DGS. It integrates a jointly trained watermark injector and message decoder, and employs a gradientbased progressive injection strategy to ensure full-scene coverage. This enables robust ownership decoding from any local region. We further extend NGS-Marker with hybrid protection (combining native and indirect watermarks) and support for multimodal watermarking. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NGS-Marker effectively defends against partial infringement while offering practical flexibility for real-world deployment.

articles.title_zh: NGS-Marker:3D高斯电镀的强力原生水标记
articles.content_zh: 随着3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)的快速发展和采用,有效版权保护的必要性变得越来越重要. 3DGS的现有水印技术主要侧重于通过预先训练的解码器保护渲染的图像,使得基础的3D高斯原始人容易被滥用. 特别是,它们对于局部侵犯是无效的,因为对手只提取和再利用高斯人的一部分。 在本文中,我们提出NGS-Mark,这是3DGS的新型本土水标框架. 它整合了联合培训的水印注射器和电文解码器,并采用了基于梯度的渐进注射策略,以确保全景覆盖. 这使所有者能够从任何当地地区进行有力的解码。 我们进一步扩展NGS-Mark,提供混合保护(合并本土和间接水印),并支持多式联运水印。 广泛的实验表明,NGS-Marker有效防御部分侵权,同时为实际世界的部署提供实际的灵活性.

articles.title: Counterfactual Anatomy-guided Spatial-Temporal Decoding for Annotation-Free Hallucination Mitigation in Medical VLMs
articles.content: Medical vision-language models (Med-VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on medical visual question answering, yet they remain prone to hallucination, generating clinically unsupported statements that are insufficiently grounded in image evidence. Mitigation methods applied during decoding offer a practical solution, but they typically lack anatomical awareness or rely heavily on ground truth annotations, which limits their applicability. We propose Counterfactual Anatomy-guided Spatial-Temporal decoding (CAST), a framework that operates entirely during inference and requires no manual annotations for anatomically grounded hallucination mitigation. CAST automatically discovers anatomical regions relevant to the given query through broad medical segmentation. It then selects a compact, causally informative area using counterfactual intervention based on the drop in answer likelihood under occlusion. Guided by this chosen region, CAST performs a unified contrastive decoding process, combining classifier-free guidance to correct spatial attention with stepwise temporal contrast to regulate generation dynamics. Experiments on the SLAKE and MIMIC-CXR datasets across three Med-VLMs demonstrate that CAST consistently outperforms strong baselines and surpasses decoding strategies reliant on ground truth. Our results indicate that compact, automatically selected regions provide highly effective contrastive guidance without expert annotations, offering a practical and generalizable solution for improving spatial grounding and reducing hallucinations. Code is available at https://github.com/csyifan/CAST.

articles.title_zh: 反事实 解剖学指导 空间-时空解码,用于医学 VLMs 中无致幻剂的解码
articles.content_zh: 医学视觉语言模型(Med-VLMs)在医疗视觉问题回答方面表现出了很强的性能,然而这些模型仍然容易产生幻觉,在临床上产生无根据的语句,这些语句在图像证据上的基础不足. 解码过程中采用的缓解方法提供了一个实际的解决办法,但它们通常缺乏解剖意识或严重依赖实地的真相说明,从而限制了其适用性。 我们提出反事实解剖学制导的空间-时空解码(CAST),这个框架在推论期间完全运作,不需要人工说明解剖基础幻觉的缓解. CAST通过广泛的医学分解,自动发现与给定查询相关的解剖区域. 然后,它选择一个紧凑的、因果信息丰富的领域,使用反事实干预方法,根据隔离下答案下降的可能性。 以这个选定的区域为指南,CAST执行统一的对比解码过程,将无分类器的导理结合起来,以纠正空间注意力和渐渐的时间对比来调节生成动力学. 对三个Med-VLM的SLKE和MIMICI-CXR数据集的实验表明,CAST的业绩始终超过强大的基线,超过了依赖地面真相的解码战略。 我们的结果表明,紧凑的、自动选定的区域在没有专家说明的情况下提供了高度有效的对比性指导,为改进空间地面和减少幻觉提供了实用和普遍的解决办法。 代码见https://github.com/csyifan/CAST。

articles.title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
articles.content: We introduce Semantic Task Completion Video Generation, an outcome-oriented video generation task. Under this formulation, success requires both achievement of the intended outcome and semantic grounding. Semantic grounding characterizes the correspondence between the reference image and the generated outcome in terms of high-level semantics relevant to the task. Evaluation focuses on the generated outcome and requires neither the presentation of a complete sequence of intermediate task steps nor conventional appearance consistency with the reference image. To support systematic evaluation, we construct SemComp-Data, an evaluation dataset covering six domains. Each instance comprises a reference image, a detailed instruction, a brief instruction, and an outcome-centric video clip. A scalable four-stage curation pipeline converts raw videos into standardized SemComp-Data instances. We further introduce SemComp-Bench, an evaluation protocol that uses a vision-language model (VLM) to answer structured binary questions. SemComp-Bench reports the OA Score and the GR Score for Outcome Achievement and Generation Reliability, respectively. Experiments on representative video generation models show that achieving intended outcomes while maintaining task-relevant semantic grounding in reference images remains challenging.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SemComp-Bench: 视频生成语义任务完成基准
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍语义任务完成视频生成, 一种面向结果的视频生成任务。 根据这一提法,成功既需要取得预期的结果,也需要语义基础。 语义定位在与任务相关的高级语义方面,是参考图像与生成结果的对应特征. 评价侧重于产生的结果,既不要求提出完整的中间任务步骤序列,也不要求常规外观与参考图像一致。 为了支持系统评价,我们建立了SemComp-Data,这是一个涵盖六个领域的评价数据集。 每个实例包括参考图像、详细指示、简短指示和以结果为中心的录像片段。 可缩放的四级管路将原始视频转换成标准化的SemComp-Data实例。 我们进一步引入SemComp-Bench,一种使用视觉语言模型(VLM)来回答结构化二进制问题的评价协议. SemComp-Bench分别报告OA分数和GR分数,用于实现成果和创造可靠性。 对有代表性的视频生成模型的实验表明,在实现预期结果的同时,在参考图像中保持与任务有关的语义定位仍然具有挑战性。

articles.title: GSToken: Geometry-Structured Gaussian Tokens for Compact 3D Medical Image Representation
articles.content: Effective segmentation of multi-modal MRI is central to improving neural network accuracy in brain tumor recognition. Existing methods typically compress 3D volumes into token sequences via fixed patch encoding or learned attention pooling (e.g., TokenLearner). However, these compression schemes discard explicit spatial shape information; the resulting tokens convey no notion of lesion morphology or spatial extent. Meanwhile, end-to-end evaluation entangles a tokenizer's information retention with the reconstruction capacity of the downstream decoder, and the lack of a unified capacity contract across methods makes performance differences difficult to attribute. In this paper, we introduce Gaussian tokens to multi-modal brain tumor segmentation for the first time: each token carries not only a semantic feature but also a learned 3D center, anisotropic scale, and orientation, endowing the representation with explicit geometric support at negligible parameter cost. We further propose a frozen-token utility evaluation protocol: the trained tokenizer is frozen, its output is cast into a fixed-capacity serialized contract, and a shared lightweight Transformer probe independently measures each tokenizer's retained information under strictly matched conditions. Multi-seed paired statistical testing shows that GSToken consistently and substantially outperforms capacity-matched adaptive baselines under frozen probing, with uniform advantages across all tumor sub-regions, surface, and distance metrics. These results demonstrate that explicitly encoding spatial geometry within tokens significantly improves the information density of volumetric representations, offering a new design principle for compact 3D medical image representation and downstream reading.

articles.title_zh: GSToken: 几何- Structured Gaussian Tokens 用于压缩 3D 医疗图像显示
articles.content_zh: 有效分割多模式核磁共振是提高脑肿瘤识别神经网络准确性的核心。 现有方法一般通过固定的补丁编码或学到的注意力集合(如TokenLearner)将3D卷压缩成符号序列. 然而,这些压缩方案丢弃了明确的空间形状信息;由此产生的符号没有传达损害形态或空间范围的概念。 同时,端对端评价将标注器的信息保留与下游解码器的重建能力纠缠在一起,而且缺乏跨方法的统一能力合同,使得性能差异难以归属. 在本文中,我们首次将高斯符号引入了多模式脑瘤分化:每个符号不仅包含语义特征,还包含一个有学识的3D中心,异位尺度,以及定向,以可忽略参数成本给代表物提供明确的几何支持. 我们进一步提出一个冷冻的功能评价协议:经过训练的活化剂被冷冻,其输出被投放到固定容量的序列化合同中,一个共享的轻量级变形器探测器在严格匹配的条件下独立测量每个活化剂保留的信息. 多种子配对统计测试显示,GSToken在冷冻检测下持续和大大超过能力匹配的适应基线,在所有肿瘤次区域、地表和距离测量中都有统一优势。 这些结果表明,在符内明确编码空间几何,大大提高了体积表达的信息密度,为紧凑的3D医疗图像表达和下游阅读提供了新的设计原则.

articles.title: TF-CADE: Foreground-Concentrated Text-Video Alignment for Zero-Shot Temporal Action Detection
articles.content: Zero-Shot Temporal Action Detection (ZSTAD) aims to lo- calize and recognize action instances from unseen action categories in untrimmed videos. Although existing meth- ods have shown effectiveness by advancing architectural text-video alignment, they still struggle with capturing se- mantic distinctions between action classes, resulting in text- irrelevant predictions. To address this issue, we propose a Text-Foreground Concentrated Alignment for zero-shot temporal action DEtector (TF-CADE) that explicitly aligns textual information with action-relevant foreground regions. Specifically, we introduce Action Concentrate Aggregation (ACA), which extracts action concentrate scores to aggregate temporally informative video segments into a foreground- weighted video embedding. This foreground concentrated alignment enhances the semantic consistency between text and video features and improves inter-class discriminabil- ity. In addition, a Certainty-based Confidence Re-weighting (CCR) strategy refines per-snippet confidence scores by lever- aging foreground-aware similarity, effectively suppressing irrelevant action classes during inference. Extensive evalua- tions show that our TF-CADE not only achieves state-of-the- art performance under in-distribution settings but also excels in cross-dataset generalization to unseen action classes.

articles.title_zh: TF-CADE: 面向零同步动作的面向前景的文本-视频对齐
articles.content_zh: Zero-Shot Timoral Action Detection(ZSTAD)旨在对未剪辑的视频中未见的动作类别进行校准并识别动作实例. 虽然现存的冰毒-od通过推进建筑文本-视频的对齐来显示有效性,但它们仍然难以捕捉动作类之间的se-mantic区分,导致文本无关的预测. 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用 " 文本前方 " 专注的零镜头时间动作 " Datector " (TF-CADE),明确将文字信息与行动前方区域保持一致。 具体地说,我们引入了Action Community(Action)聚合(ACA),它提取了Action(Action)的分数,将时间信息丰富的视频片段汇总成一个前方加权视频嵌入. 这种前景集中的对齐加强了文字和视频特征之间的语义一致性,并改进了阶级间的歧义-ity. 此外,基于确定性的信心再加权(CCR)策略通过杠杆-老化前缘-知觉相似性来完善每片信心分数,在推论时有效压制无关的动作类. 广泛的评价表明,我们的TF-CADE不仅在分配设置下实现了最先进的性能,而且在跨数据集概括到看不见的动作类方面也非常出色.

articles.title: TEAMS: Text-prompted spatiotEmporal dual-heAd Mamba Snake
articles.content: Deep snake is a promising family of instance segmentation methods that accurately predicts object-level contours, thereby overcoming common pixel-level misclassification issues such as mask cavities and jagged edges in semantic segmentation approaches. However, existing deep snake methods face challenges in handling complex morphological variations, accurately capturing fine-grained organ details, and correcting base detection errors. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a cohesive Text-prompted spatiotEmporal dual-heAd Mamba Snake (TEAMS), a novel vision-language Mamba snake framework with three key innovations: (1) A Spatiotemporal Snake Evolution Strategy (SSES) is introduced to tackle complex morphological variations by capturing bidirectional spatial dependencies along the snake contour and temporal dynamics across evolution steps in a state space model. (2) A Contour Morphology-Aware Mamba (CMAM) is proposed to quantify local contour morphologies to modulate the structured attention mask in the Mamba2 SSD dual form, which extends Mamba's capability to perceive the relative importance of its input sequence elements for better delineation of fine-grained organ details. (3) A Text-prompted Collaborative Dual-Head Snake (TCDHS) is designed to incorporate cues from textual prompts and transfer the evolved contour information to the base detection head, which enhances the deep snake workflow and mitigates wrong detections. Comprehensive evaluations on five datasets covering different organs and imaging modalities demonstrate that TEAMS outperforms existing semantic and deep snake segmentation methods (e.g., relative mDice/mBF improvements of 6.9%/9.1% in a spinal dataset), underscoring its potential as a reliable tool across diverse medical image segmentation scenarios.

articles.title_zh: TEAMS: 文本速记 双层马巴蛇
articles.content_zh: 深蛇是一种很有希望的实例分解方法家族,它准确地预测了对象级轮廓,从而克服了在语义分解方法中常见的像素级错分类问题,如面具腔和夹痕边缘. 然而,现有的深蛇方法在处理复杂的形态变异,准确捕捉细纹器官细节,以及纠正基础检测错误方面面临挑战. 为了减少这些限制,我们提议采用一个具有凝聚力的文本催化的双赫马达蛇(TEAMS),这是一个具有三大创新的新型视觉语言马达蛇框架: (1) 采用了Spatiotemporal蛇进化战略(SSES),通过在状态空间模型中捕捉蛇形轮廓沿线的双向空间依赖和跨进化步骤的时间动态,应对复杂的形态变化。 (2)建议采用Contour Morphology-Aware Mamba(CMAM)来量化局部轮廓形态,以调制Mamba2 SSD双重形态中结构化的注意罩,这扩展了Mamba的能力,使其能感知其输入序列要素对更好地划定细纹器官细节的相对重要性. (3) 设计了一个由文字推动的双头蛇协作(TCDHS),将文字提示的提示纳入其中,并将演化的轮廓信息传输到底部检测头,这将加强深蛇工作流程,减轻错误检测。 对涵盖不同器官和成像模式的五个数据集的全面评价表明,TEAMS的绩效超过了现有的语义和深蛇分解方法(例如,在脊柱数据集中相对mDice/mBF的改进率为6.9%/9.1%),强调了它作为不同医学图像分解情景中可靠工具的潜力。

articles.title: SPVC: Structured and Panoptic Video Fixing for Cross-Dataset Driving Scene Rendering
articles.content: Driving scene reconstruction and rendering, especially with 3D Gaussian Splatting, has become an important component of autonomous driving simulation. However, rendered views often degrade under extrapolated ego trajectories and scene edits, producing blurry structures, temporal flicker, and foreground-background misalignment. Existing refinement methods are commonly designed for a specific setting, such as image-level novel-view repair or object-editing correction. In this paper, we introduce SPVC, a structured and panoptic video fixing framework for cross-dataset driving scene rendering. The name summarizes four design principles. (1) Structured fixing denotes the use of explicit spatial conditions, including camera pose, 3D bounding boxes, and HD maps, to guide the repair process and reduce uncontrolled hallucination. (2) Panoptic fixing refers to correcting both background rendering artifacts, such as distorted roads, buildings, and lanes, and foreground vehicle artifacts introduced by scene editing, such as inconsistent object appearance. (3) Video fixing means that the model operates on driving sequences rather than isolated frames, allowing temporal cues to be used during artifact correction. (4) Cross-dataset fixing means that a single shared network is trained and applied across multiple driving datasets, reducing the need for dataset-specific or scene-specific fixers. Concretely, we construct paired degraded-clean training data by simulating under-constrained 3DGS rendering and foreground vehicle insertion artifacts, and train a two-stage controllable video diffusion model that first addresses video-level appearance and then refines scene layout with structured controls.

articles.title_zh: SPVC:用于跨数据集驱动场景的有结构的和泛光视频修复
articles.content_zh: 驾驶场景的重建与渲染,特别是3D高斯滑板,已经成为自主驾驶模拟的重要组成部分. 然而,在推算的自我轨迹和场景编辑下,视图往往会退化,产生模糊的结构、时间闪烁器和前缘背景错位。 现有的完善方法通常为特定设置设计,如图像级小视图修复或对象编辑校正. 在本文中,我们介绍了SPVC,一个结构化和泛光视频固定框架,用于跨数据集驱动场景渲染. 名称概括了四项设计原则. (1)结构固定表示使用清晰的空间条件,包括相机姿势,3D边框,以及HD地图,来引导修复过程,减少失控的幻觉. (2)泛光修饰,是指既纠正扭曲道路,建筑物,车道等背景渲染文物,又纠正场景编辑引入的前方车辆文物,如物体外观不一致. (3)视频修饰是指该模型运行于驱动序列而非孤立帧,允许在文物修饰过程中使用时间提示. (4)跨数据集修补,是指单一共享网络在多个驱动数据集中经过培训和应用,减少了对数据集特定或场景特定固定器的需求. 具体地说,我们通过模拟训练不足的3DGS渲染和前置车辆插入文物来构建成对的退化-清洁训练数据,并训练一种两阶段可控视频传播模型,首先处理视频层面的外观,然后用结构化控制来改进场景布局.

articles.title: Spectral Gradient Orthogonalization Improves Differentially Private Training at Scale
articles.content: Differentially private training adds isotropic Gaussian noise to clipped gradients, corrupting every singular direction equally. In vision models, where spatial correlation concentrates gradient energy into a low-rank subspace, most of this noise falls in directions that carry little signal. Spectral gradient orthogonalization via polar decomposition is introduced as a post-processing step that recovers directional signal from the noisy gradient's low-rank structure at zero additional privacy cost. A phase transition governs the utility of this approach: orthogonalization improves accuracy only when the per-direction spectral signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) suffices for singular vector recovery; in low-SNR regimes, the directional bias of the gradient is replaced by a nearly random orthogonal update, and the transformation is harmful. The recovery threshold is determined by the spectral gap of the gradient and is surpassed at large batch sizes. Empirically, the benefit scales with model capacity: spectral orthogonalization achieves a +20.9% improvement over DP-SGD on WRN-28-10 (B = 4096) and +14.9% on ResNet-18, while reducing inter-run variance by a factor of two to three. In the fine-tuning regime, spectral orthogonalization matches the stability of DP-Adam while maintaining a first-order memory footprint. Combining spectral with temporal denoising yields 50.3% on CIFAR-10 (epsilon = 4), the highest accuracy in any tested configuration. These gains are specific to moderate-to-high-SNR regimes such as large-batch training of higher-capacity models. Small-batch or low-SNR settings are better served by DP-SGD or temporal denoising.

articles.title_zh: 光谱渐变轨道化在规模上改善差别化的私人培训
articles.content_zh: 不同程度的私人培训 高斯的噪音可以剪断梯度,同样地腐蚀了每一个单一的方向. 在视觉模型中,空间相关性将梯度能量集中到低阶亚空间中,这些噪声大多掉落到很少带信号的方向. 通过极分解的光谱梯度正交化被引入作为后处理步骤,以零额外隐私成本从吵闹梯度低阶结构中恢复方向信号. 相位过渡支配着这种方法的效用:正交化只有在每个方向光谱信号对噪声比(SNR)足够单向矢量恢复时,才能提高精度;在低SNR制度中,梯度的方向偏差被近乎随机的正交更新所取代,变换是有害的. 回收阈值由梯度的光谱间隙决定,并在大批量大小时超过. 经验上,具有模型容量的受益尺度:光谱正交化在WRN-28-10(B=4096)上比DP-SGD提高20.9%,在ResNet-18上为+14.9%,同时将运行间差异减少2-3倍. 在微调制度中,光谱正交化与DP-Adam的稳定性相匹配,同时保持一阶记忆足迹. 在CIFAR-10(epsilon = 4)上,将光谱与时间调试结合得50.3%,是任何测试配置中最高的精度. 这些收益是中高国家自然资源保护制度特有的,例如对高能力模式进行大批量培训。 小批量或低 SNR 设置通过DP-SGD或时间解析得到更好的服务.

articles.title: REChart: Reasoning-Efficient Chart Editing with Large Reasoning Models
articles.content: Chart editing requires inferring and modifying visualization code from a reference chart image based on an editing instruction, challenging fine-grained visual reasoning, instruction following, and executable code synthesis capabilities of MLLMs. Large reasoning models (LRMs) with extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning are suitable for tackling such complex multimodal tasks. However, our preliminary study reveals an ``inverted-U'' relationship between reasoning length and chart-editing performance: Excessive reasoning often leads to ``overthinking,'' where models drift toward hallucinated visual details or get stuck in redundant reasoning loops. To address the gap, we introduce REChart, a two-stage training framework that provides process-level supervision over intermediate reasoning steps, improving both editing fidelity and reasoning efficiency. First, we synthesize 200k high-quality reasoning trajectories for supervised fine-tuning from a large image-instruction-code pool, using a role-specialized agentic Reason-Score-Refine workflow that iteratively refine the chart code toward higher quality. Second, we optimize the model via reinforcement learning with two complementary rewards: a \emph{fidelity} reward evaluating code correctness, visual fidelity, and structural consistency, and an \emph{efficiency} reward that assigns each rollout a random thinking budget, truncates the reasoning process, and credits the final reasoning segment according to its contribution to the output. On the ChartEdit and ChartMIMIC benchmarks, our model achieves state-of-the-art chart-editing performance among open-source models of comparable scale, while mitigating overthinking and reducing average reasoning token usage by 79.0\% under a maximum thinking budget of 16,384 tokens compared with the base model.

articles.title_zh: REChart: 理性- 高效图表编辑与大型理性模型
articles.content_zh: 图表编辑需要从基于编辑指令的参考图表图像中推导和修改可视化代码,挑战精细的视觉推理,指令跟随,以及MLLMs的可执行代码合成能力. 具有延伸的思维链(CoT)推理的大型推理模型(LRMs)适合处理这种复杂的多式联运任务. 然而,我们的初步研究揭示了“颠倒的U”在推理长度和图表编辑性能之间的关系: 过度推理往往导致"过度思考",""在其中,模型漂移到幻觉的视觉细节或者被卡在冗余推理循环中. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了REChart,这是一个两阶段培训框架,对中间推理步骤提供程序层面的监督,提高编辑忠诚度和推理效率。 首先,我们合成200k高品质的推理轨迹,从一个大型的图像指令码集合中进行有监督的微调,使用一个角色专用的代理理性-分数-Refine工作流程,迭代地完善图表代码,以达到更高的质量. 其次,我们通过强化学习来优化模型,同时给予两个互补的奖励:一个\emph{fidity}奖励评价代码正确性,视觉忠诚性和结构一致性,以及一个\emph{效率}奖励,分配每次推出随机思维预算,缩短推理过程,并根据其对输出的贡献,将最终推理部分记为信用. 在ChartEdit和ChartMIMIC基准上,我们的模型在可比规模的开源模型中实现了最先进的图表编辑性能,同时在与基准模型相比,最高思维预算为16 384个令牌的情况下,减轻了过度思考和平均推理符号使用量减少79.0%。

articles.title: MoE-ViE: Mixture of Experts Vision Encoder for Efficient Image and Video Understanding
articles.content: Vision encoders are a critical component of vision-language models, and scaling their capacity effectively improves performance. However, dense scaling increases compute cost and inference latency. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer a compelling alternative, having enabled efficient scaling in LLMs, yet the MoE design space for CLIP-style vision encoders remains underexplored at State-of-the-Art (SOTA) levels. In this work, we systematically study MoE designs for vision encoder scaling and find that fine-grained MoE topologies yield substantial gains over both dense and standard MoE counterparts. We further propose an auxiliary-loss-free balancing variant for better expert utilization, and design a specialized MoE kernel to mitigate inference latency overhead. To enhance video capabilities while preserving image knowledge, we introduce frame-level distillation paired with a novel freezing mechanism. We pretrain a series of Mixture-of-Experts Vision Encoders (MoE-ViE) across a range of sizes, all consistently outperforming their dense counterparts. Our largest model matches the zero-shot performance of a SOTA encoder 1.7x its size at 76% of its latency. When aligned with an LLM, MoE-ViE surpasses all compared encoders on image and video benchmarks, including those with up to 5x more activated parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/moe_vie.

articles.title_zh: MoE-ViE:高效图像和视频理解专家愿景编码器的混合
articles.content_zh: 视觉编码器是视觉语言模型的关键组成部分,其容量的提升有效地提高了性能. 然而,密集的缩放会增加计算成本和推断延迟。 专家混合结构提供了一个令人信服的替代方案,它使有限责任公司能够有效地进行规模化,然而CLIP式视觉编码器的教育部设计空间在艺术水平上仍然没有得到充分利用。 在这项工作中,我们系统研究了教育部的愿景编码器缩放设计,发现精细的教育部地形比教育部的密集和标准的对等部门都大有收获。 我们进一步提出一个辅助-无损失平衡方案,以更好地利用专家,并设计一个专门的教育部内核,以减少推论延迟间接费用。 为了在保存图像知识的同时增强视频能力,我们引入了帧级蒸馏,配以新的冻结机制. 我们预先训练了一系列的“专家视野”编码器(MOE-ViE),其规模都一直比其密集的对应器要好。 我们最大的模型 符合SOTA编码器的零射性能 1.7x 它的大小 76% 的潜伏。 在与LLM对齐时,MOE-ViE超越了图像和视频基准上所有比较的编码器,包括那些具有最多5x更多激活参数的编码器. 代码可见于https://github.com/facebookresearch/moe_vie.

articles.title: To Remove or Not to Remove Clouds: A Comparative Analysis and Fusion of Raw SAR and Synthetic NDWI for Overcast Water Segmentation
articles.content: Persistent clouds blind optical satellites during floods. While Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) penetrates clouds, its raw data is noisy and lacks clear contrast. To mitigate this, recent studies utilize deep learning models to translate SAR into cloud-free synthetic optical imagery for downstream tasks like water body segmentation. However, because raw SAR is the original source for both of these operations, a critical methodological dilemma arises: during complete overcast should segmentation models process the raw SAR directly, or rely on a translated synthetic Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) proxy? This study resolves the debate by demonstrating that synthetic NDWI yields better results, as the translation process acts as a powerful filter against radar noise. This raises a natural second question: what if we utilize both? Building on our findings, we introduce a Combined Framework that integrates both raw SAR and synthetic NDWI into a unified model. By fusing the sharp physical boundaries of raw SAR with the high contrast of synthetic NDWI, this hybrid approach consistently outperforms all standalone methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 要删除或不删除云:对 Raw SAR 和 合成 NDWI 进行对比分析和合并,用于重叠水分
articles.content_zh: 洪水期间持续云盲光学卫星. 虽然合成孔径雷达(SAR)穿透云层,但其原始数据很吵,缺乏明显的对比. 为了减轻这种情况,最近的研究利用深层学习模型将合成孔径雷达转化为无云合成光学图像,用于水体分解等下游任务。 然而,由于原始合成孔径雷达是这两种操作的原始来源,因此出现了一种关键的方法难题:在完全的透视过程中,应当直接处理原始合成孔径雷达,还是依赖一个翻译的合成常态化差分水指数(NDWI)代理? 这项研究通过表明合成NDWI产生更好的结果解决了争论,因为翻译过程对雷达噪声起到强大的过滤作用. 这引起了一个自然的第二个问题:如果我们利用两者呢? 根据我们的调查结果,我们引入了将原始合成合成孔径雷达和合成合成合成合成孔径雷达纳入统一模式的综合框架。 通过将原始合成孔径雷达的尖锐物理边界与合成NDWI的高度对比相连接,这种混合方法始终超越所有独立方法。

articles.title: Noisy group neurons with synchronous resetting for high-performance spiking neural networks
articles.content: Spiking neural networks (SNNs), characterized by bio-inspired neuronal dynamics and event-driven communication, have attained significant progress in recent years. Nevertheless, training deep SNNs remains challenging due to spatiotemporal information loss and gradient mismatching. To simultaneously address these issues, we propose a noisy group neuron (NGN) model, which incorporates population-level synchronous resetting and neural stochasticity as fundamental computational mechanisms. We then develop the NGN method as a framework that combines the NGN model with backpropagation learning based on mean-field dynamics. We demonstrate the advantages of the NGN method through theoretical analysis and experimental validation on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, DVS-Gesture, N-Caltech101, and CIFAR10-DVS. The proposed approach achieves an accuracy of 87.35% on CIFAR10-DVS within 10 inference time steps. These results support NGN as a practical approach to high-performance neuromorphic computing.
