articles.title_zh: 为高性能振荡神经网络同步重置的噪音组神经元
articles.content_zh: 螺旋神经网络(SNN)的特点是生物启发神经动力学和事件驱动的通信,近年来取得了显著进展. 然而,由于瞬间信息丢失和梯度不匹配,深层SNNs的培训仍然具有挑战性。 为了同时解决这些问题,我们提出一个吵闹的群神经元模型(NGN),这个模型将人口级同步重置和神经构造作为基本的计算机制. 然后我们发展NGN方法,作为将NGN模型与基于中场动态的反向传播学习相结合的框架. 我们通过CIFAR-10,CIFAR-100,Tiny-ImageNet,DVS-Gesture,N-Caltech101和CIFAR10-DVD的理论分析和实验验证,展示了NGN方法的优点. 拟议方法在10个推断时间步骤内使CIFAR10-DVD的精确度达到87.35%. 这些结果支持NGN作为高性能神经形态计算的一种实用方法.

articles.title: GeoWeaver: Accurate Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction via Hierarchical Geometric Assembly
articles.content: Long-sequence 3D reconstruction from RGB videos requires both accurate local geometry and globally consistent camera motion. Feed-forward models provide strong depth and pose predictions, but their memory cost prevents joint inference over long sequences. Chunk-wise processing improves scalability, yet independently predicted chunks often exhibit scale drift, pose errors, and point-cloud misalignment. We present GeoWeaver, a unified framework comprising a Geometric Prior Model (GPM) and Test-Time Adaptation (TTA). The GPM predicts chunk-wise depth, confidence, and camera parameters as adjustable geometric priors. TTA then performs sequential initialization, global chunk-level Sim(3) alignment, and coarse-to-fine refinement of camera poses, affine depth corrections, and intrinsics. Dense correspondences provide adjacent, cross-chunk, and long-range constraints, while a robust CDF-style objective jointly optimizes weighted 2D reprojection and 3D consistency residuals. This design preserves local geometric accuracy while correcting accumulated pose, scale, depth, and calibration errors. Experiments across diverse long-sequence benchmarks demonstrate improved camera accuracy, global consistency, and point-cloud quality. Ablations verify the contribution of each adaptation stage, and applying the same TTA procedure to different geometric prior models consistently improves their trajectory estimates, demonstrating that GeoWeaver is not tied to a specific GPM.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GeoWeaver:通过分级几何大会准确的长序三维重建
articles.content_zh: RGB视频的长序3D重建既需要准确的局部几何,也需要全球一致的相机运动. Feed-forward模型提供了很强的深度并提出了预测,但是它们的内存成本阻止了对长序列的联合推论. Chunk-wise处理提高了可伸缩性,然而独立预测的块往往显示出尺度漂移,造成错误,以及点云错位. 我们介绍GeoWeaver,这是一个由几何前模型和测试-时间适应(TTA)组成的统一框架。 GPM 预测可调整几何前缀的块形深度、置信度和相机参数。 然后TTA进行顺序初始化,全球块级Sim(3)对齐,以及粗细细细细化相机姿势,细深校正和内在. Dense函式提供相邻的,跨圆的,和长距离的制约,而强力的CDF式目标联合优化了加权2D重排和3D一致性残基. 这种设计保留了局部几何精度,同时纠正了累积的姿势,尺度,深度和校准错误. 跨越不同长序基准的实验表明,摄像机的准确性、全球一致性和点云质量都有提高。 校验每个适应阶段的贡献,对不同的几何前模型采用相同的TTA程序,不断改进它们的轨迹估计,表明GeoWeaver没有与特定的GPM挂钩.

articles.title: Multi-Agent AI System for Radiology Report Structuring and Quality Assurance with Independent Radiologist Evaluation
articles.content: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a locally deployed multi-agent AI system for radiology report structuring and quality assurance. Materials and Methods: This retrospective study included 638 radiology reports from CT examinations of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis dictated by 15 board-certified radiologists in 2023 and 2024. A multi-agent AI pipeline was developed to perform report structuring and quality assurance (QA). The system structured the report into standardized anatomical sections at the sentence level using regex rules and local large language models. It also detected mismatches between the Findings and Impression sections, or within sections; gender-anatomy conflicts; and undocumented communication of critical findings. Two board-certified radiologists independently evaluated a 45-report subset. Results: The multi-agent system structured the Findings sections of all reports (22,270 sentences) into a predefined anatomical format while retaining the original report content. The system flagged 90 (14.1%) reports, most commonly for section mismatches (80 reports, 12.5%). In the radiologist evaluation, both reviewers agreed that 31 (69%) were correctly restructured, 2 reports (4%) were incorrectly restructured, and disagreed on the remaining 12 reports (27%). Both reviewers agreed that no clinically important information was omitted and no fabricated content was introduced. Overall QA performance was rated as "excellent" or "good" in 84% of the evaluated reports, with the remaining reports rated as "fair". Conclusion: A locally deployed multi-agent AI system combined radiology report structuring and quality assurance within a single workflow. The system demonstrated favorable performance in radiologist evaluation. Such systems may support standardization of reporting and quality assurance in radiology practice.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多代理AI系统放射学报告结构与质量保证与独立放射学家评价
articles.content_zh: 目的: 开发和评价当地部署的用于放射科报告和质量保证的多代理AI系统。 材料和方法: 这项回顾性研究包括2023年和2024年由15名经董事会认证的放射学家对胸部、腹部和骨盆进行CT检查的638份放射报告。 开发了一个多代理AI管道,以进行报告结构和质量保证。 该系统利用regex规则和当地大语言模型,将报告结构化为句子层面的标准化解剖部分. 它还发现了调查结果和印象部分之间或各科内部的不匹配;性别-解剖冲突;以及没有记录的重要调查结果的交流。 两名经董事会认证的放射学家独立评估了一个45份报告子集。 结果: 多代理系统将所有报告(22 270句)的 " 调查结果 " 部分结构为预先界定的解剖格式,同时保留原始报告内容。 该系统标出了90份报告(14.1%),最常见的是各节不匹配(80份报告,12.5%)。 在放射学家评价中,两位审查者都同意,31份(69%)的结构调整是正确的,2份报告(4%)的结构调整不正确,其余12份报告(27%)有不同意见。 两位审查人员一致认为,没有遗漏临床上重要的信息,也没有引入任何捏造的内容。 总体质评业绩在84%的评价报告中被评为"优秀"或"优秀",其余报告被评为"公平". 结论:当地部署的多代理AI系统综合放射学报告在一个单一工作流程内的结构和质量保证。 该系统在放射学家评价方面表现良好。 这种系统可能有助于放射学实践中的报告标准化和质量保证。

articles.title: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification
articles.content:
Memory-based self-improving agents--those that learn from an online stream of tasks and improve over time by maintaining a textual memory bank--have shown great promise in recent literature. However, the reliability aspects of these methods have been critically overlooked. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive re-evaluation of two memory-based methods, broadening the scope of evaluation along two axes: (1) including multiple runs to quantify variance, and (2) randomly shuffling the tasks to investigate the effect of task order. Through these experiments, we make two observations that expose the fragility of current methods: First, agent evaluation is inherently noisy in complex environments and on multi-step tasks, and stacking a self-improving loop on top can further amplify this noise. Second, the agent's improvement is highly dependent on task order. Prior works often adopt default orderings that impose an implicit curriculum, acting as a hidden prerequisite for success.
  To better understand this fragility, we manually examine the agents' memory and hypothesize that task and environment underspecification contribute to this fragility. We validate this hypothesis by incorporating information that enables better specification, such as detailed rubrics and environment feedback, into the memory construction process. While this added information partially closes the performance degradation in previous experiments, significant gaps still remain, suggesting that other uncharacterized factors contribute to this fragility. Looking ahead, our work advocates for more rigorous evaluation protocols for self-improving agents by reporting results across multiple runs and stress-testing them under challenging conditions. Moreover, our findings on underspecification call for systems and interfaces that enable effective human oversight, preventing agents from failing in unforeseeable ways.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自我改进代理人的脆弱性:差异、任务顺序和规格不足
articles.content_zh:
基于记忆的自我改进代理商——那些从在线任务流中学习并随着时间推移而改进的代理商——在最近文献中表现出了巨大的希望。 然而,这些方法的可靠性方面被严重忽视。 在这项工作中,我们对两种基于内存的方法进行全面的重新评价,沿着两个轴线扩大评价范围:(1)包括多个运行以量化差异,(2)随机打乱任务以调查任务顺序的效果. 通过这些实验,我们提出了两个揭示目前方法脆弱性的观察: 首先,代理评价在复杂的环境和多步骤任务中本质上是吵闹的,在顶部堆放一个自我改进的循环可以进一步扩大这种噪音. 第二,代理人的改进高度依赖于任务顺序. 先前的作品往往采用强制设置隐含课程的默认命令,作为成功的一个隐蔽前提.
为了更好地了解这种脆弱性,我们手动检查代理人的记忆力,并假设任务和环境特性不足会助长这种脆弱性。 我们验证这一假设的方法是,在内存构建过程中纳入信息,使信息更能说明问题,如详细的标题和环境反馈。 虽然这些补充资料部分地弥补了以往实验中性能的退化,但仍然存在重大差距,表明其他未定性因素造成了这种脆弱性。 展望未来,我们的工作主张对自我改进的代理商采用更严格的评价规程,在挑战性的条件下报告多轮运行的结果并对其进行压力测试。 此外,我们关于规格不足的结论要求建立能够有效进行人类监督的系统和接口,防止代理人以不可预见的方式失败。

articles.title: TokEval: A Tokenizer Evaluation Suite
articles.content: Language model tokenizers are typically selected with minimal evaluation, despite the fact that their design choices directly impact model capabilities. This can be partly attributed to a limited understanding of which tokenizer properties affect which aspects of downstream performance. We introduce TokEval, a framework of tokenizer evaluation metrics that goes beyond standard measures like fertility and compression rate to capture linguistically and structurally meaningful properties, e.g., UTF-8 character boundary integrity and digit place-value boundary alignment for mathematics. To validate whether these metrics are predictive of downstream model performance, we conduct controlled language model pretraining experiments, varying solely the tokenizers' training data mixture, pretokenization strategy, and training algorithm. We evaluate the resulting models on bits-per-byte (a tokenizer-agnostic version of perplexity) and several benchmarks, spanning linguistic understanding, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. Our experiments suggest that different intrinsic properties have different impacts on model abilities: information-theoretic metrics predict language modeling abilities (Spearman rho up to 0.80), while structure-sensitive metrics, such as those measuring digit and line-break handling, correlate with task accuracy. We hope TokEval enables more principled tokenizer evaluation, replacing pretraining sweeps with intrinsic measurement wherever the two agree.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TokEval:一个Tokenizer评价套件
articles.content_zh: 语言模型示意器的选用通常只有最低限度的评价,尽管其设计选择直接影响模型能力. 这可以部分归因于对哪种标语特性影响下游业绩的哪些方面了解有限。 我们引入了TokEval,这是一个标注器评价度量框架,它超越了生育力和压缩率等标准度量,以捕捉语言和结构上有意义的属性,例如UTF-8字符边界完整性和数学上的数位位值边界对齐. 为了验证这些度量衡对下游模型性能是否具有预测性,我们进行了受控语言模型预训实验,这些实验完全改变了标致器的训练数据混合物,预训策略,以及训练算法. 我们用比特/比特(一种标致式-不可知性版本的复杂性)和若干基准来评价所产生的模型,包括语言理解、数学推理和代码生成。 我们的实验表明,不同的内在性质对模型能力有不同的影响:信息理论计量标准预测语言建模能力(Spearman rho至0.80),而结构敏感的计量标准,如测量数字和断线处理,则与任务准确性相关。 我们希望TokEval能够进行更具原则性的象征性评估,在双方同意的情况下,用内在的衡量方法取代训练前的检查。

articles.title: Language Has Two Parameters: Narrative-Induced Semantic Plasticity and Phase-Sensitive Interpretation
articles.content: Language has two parameters. Count how often words occur together and you estimate amplitude, the strength of association. Word embeddings and attention weights refine that count, which sums every writer in the corpus together. This paper claims a second parameter, phase, which signed weights learned from a corpus do not supply. Phase exists only between meanings: it determines how coactivated meanings combine, and it can reverse what a meaning contributes while that meaning stays fully present. A speaker can set phase in the signal through linguistic form; encounters install phase relations and history distributes them. Population averaging deletes history-indexed phase: agent-deindexed corpora identify the population marginal state and determine no individual or dyadic state, at any scale. The standard transformer has no explicit representation for phase in frozen inference, and the interpretability program measuring progress by monosemanticity is optimizing against it: the coexistence it treats as a defect is the condition of allusion, irony, and quotation. Six predictions test whether a suppressed meaning stays active, whether encounter order changes what a phrase does, whether marking the signal changes how a shared phrase is taken, and whether a model given a history is changed by it or only informed about it. The claim defended is the weak version: interpretation requires a second relational parameter, signed, persistent, and indexed to individuals and dyads. Quantum probability is one notation for the parameter; nothing in the formalism claims quantum processes in the brain. The strong version, that the quantum calculus constrains these phenomena as signed classical models do not, rests on an encounter-order constraint not yet derived. The architecture the theory calls for is a language model with agent-indexed, phase-bearing semantic states.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言有两种参数:叙述式诱导语义可塑性和分阶段敏感解释
articles.content_zh: 语言有两个参数. 数数词在一起发生的频率,你估计振幅,关联的强度. 文字的嵌入和注意力的分量使这个计数精细化,把每个编剧都集中在一起. 本文声称第二个参数,即阶段,从一项文书中汲取的符号重量不能提供。 阶段只存在于意义之间:它决定了共动意义是如何结合的,它可以逆转一个意义的贡献,而那个意义则保持充分的存在. 演讲者可以通过语言形式设定信号的阶段;遭遇安装阶段关系,历史分布. 平均人口删除历史指数化的阶段:代理-去索引化的corpora确定人口边缘状态,并且确定任何规模的个人或dyadic状态. 标准变压器对冷冻推论中的相位没有明确的表示,而通过单质异构衡量进度的可解释性程序正在优化与之相对:它视其为缺陷的共存是暗示,讽刺和引文的条件. 6个预测测试被压制的意义是否仍然活跃,遇到命令是否改变一个短语做什么,标记信号是否改变一个共享短语的取用方式,一个给定历史的模型是否由它改变,或者只告知它. 所辩护的主张是弱版本:解释需要第二个关系参数,签名,持久,并按个人和dyads索引. 量子概率是对参数的一种标记;形式主义中没有任何东西声称大脑中的量子过程. 强烈的版本,即量子微积分限制这些现象,因为签名的古典模型并不如此,它依赖于尚未衍生出的相遇命令限制. 理论要求的架构是一种语言模型,具有代理索引式,相位式语义状态.

articles.title: Chain-of-Experience for Continual LLM Improvement
articles.content: Humans continuously learn from experience, whereas conventional large language model (LLM) evaluations ignore the models' ability to improve through inference-time interaction. In this paper, we study how LLMs learn from iterative experience at test time, a setting we refer to as Chain-of-Experience (CoE), where models accumulate experiential traces through iterative interactions with self or environmental feedback to form a continual improvement loop beyond zero-shot inference. We instantiate CoE with diverse feedback mechanisms, including model self-feedback and environmental signals such as correctness or public coding test pass rates, and evaluate across math, coding, and knowledge domains using 8 LLMs, including GPT-5, Gemini-2.5 Pro, Claude-4.5 Sonnet. Our study shows that leveraging iterative experience consistently outperforms feedback-free baselines, achieving substantial gains with self feedback alone, alongside a 5.6% overall improvement and 19% lower API cost across tasks and models. We further show that combining complementary feedback channels (e.g., model and correctness signals) yields additional gains, and that CoE delivers higher accuracy per token than existing test-time strategies. We observe a positive correlation between LLM base ability and improvement capacity, and show that models remain robust under weak or spurious feedback, with different feedback contributing to distinct improvement aspects and most gains emerging early in the iterations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 连续LLM经验链 改进
articles.content_zh: 人类不断从经验中学习,而传统的大型语言模型(LLM)评价则忽略了模型通过推论-时间相互作用改进的能力. 在本文中,我们研究LLMs如何从测试时的迭代经验中学习,我们称之为 " 经验链 " (Cine-experience)(CoE)的设置,即模型通过与自我或环境反馈的迭代相互作用积累经验痕迹,形成一个超越零镜头推论的不断改进循环. 我们利用各种反馈机制,包括模型自我反馈和环境信号,如正确性或公开编码测试通过率,并利用包括GPT-5、双子座-2.5 Pro、Claude-4.5 Sonnet在内的8个LLMs对数学、编码和知识领域进行评价。 我们的研究表明,利用迭代经验持续超过无反馈基线,仅靠自我反馈就能取得实质性收益,同时总体改善5.6%,不同任务和模式的API成本降低19%。 我们进一步表明,将补充反馈渠道(如模型和正确性信号)结合起来可带来更多的收益,而且欧委会提供的准确度高于现有的测试时间战略。 我们观察到LLM基础能力与改进能力之间的正相关关系,并表明模型在弱或虚假反馈下仍然坚固,不同的反馈有助于不同的改进方面,大多数收益在迭代初期出现.

articles.title: The IOL-AI Challenge: An Open Challenge towards Advancing Linguistic Reasoning
articles.content: Reasoning in LLMs is overwhelmingly studied in domains that provide a model with rules: mathematics and code. Linguistic puzzles invert this: the solver must first discover the system before reasoning within it. We present the IOL-AI Challenge, an open-science competition run on the unseen problems of the International Linguistics Olympiad (IOL) 2026 Individual Contest, evaluated both automatically and, for the first time, by members of the official IOL Jury under the same rubrics applied to human contestants. The challenge drew 731 submissions from 46 teams under a strict compute budget (one T4, 30 mins). We additionally benchmark 15 unconstrained frontier and open models, with Claude Opus 4.8 earning a jury score equivalent to a gold medal, while both resource-constrained systems we submitted for jury grading scored in the range of the bottom 5% of contestants. Capability was not determined by scale: 14B submissions outperform models twice their size, and gains come from decoding and output-handling rather than model capacity. We also found that automatic metrics rank systems exactly as the jury does, but compress the scale, upscoring weak systems by ~13 points and understating strong ones. Our analysis shows that while frontier models might have prior knowledge about some of the problem languages, it does not significantly help them solve the linguistic reasoning tasks, leaving linguistic reasoning as a strong benchmarking proxy for generalizable reasoning skills.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: IOL-AI挑战:推进语言理性的公开挑战
articles.content_zh: 在提供有规则的模型:数学和代码的领域,绝大多数研究了法学硕士课程中的理由。 语言谜题颠倒了这个:解题者必须先发现系统,然后再进行内部推理. 我们提出IOL-AI挑战,这是一场以2026年国际语言奥林匹克(IOL)个人大赛的未见问题为主题的开放科学竞赛,由IOL官方评审团成员在适用于人类参赛者的相同标题下进行自动和首次评价. 挑战吸引了46支队伍在严格计算预算下提交的731份申请(1个T4,30分钟)。 我们还将15个不受约束的前沿和开放模式作为基准,克劳德·奥普斯4.8获得相当于金牌的评委分数,而我们提交的两个资源约束系统都获得了评委分数,评委分数在评委分数最低的5%。 能力不是由规模决定的:14B份提交量超过其规模的两倍,而收益来自解码和输出处理,而不是模型能力。 我们还发现自动度量衡的等级系统与陪审团完全相同,但压缩了尺度,以~13的分数对弱度系统进行评分,并低估了强度系统. 我们的分析表明,虽然边疆模型对一些问题语言可能具有事先的知识,但并不大有助于他们解决语言推理任务,留下语言推理作为通用推理技能的有力基准代名词.

articles.title: Judge, Retrieve, or Abstain: Uncertainty-Guarded LLM Judging with Provable Risk Guarantees
articles.content: Using LLMs as judges has become standard practice for evaluating model outputs at scale. This is particularly common for subjective, open-ended tasks such as assessing helpfulness or alignment, where no single reference answer exists. However, objective tasks introduce a distinct reliability challenge for reference-free LLM judging. In the absence of a reference answer, the judge evaluates factual correctness either through its parametric knowledge or through tool augmentation. Although the former enables efficient evaluation, the judge may hallucinate or lack sufficient evidence for its verdict. Conversely, tool augmentation can provide additional evidence but introduces extra computational cost and requires an appropriate mechanism to determine when and how that evidence should be used reliably. More importantly, neither approach alone provides formal control over the risk of accepted verdicts or guarantees their reliability at a specified level. We propose a risk-controlled framework that calibrates uncertainty thresholds on a held-out set so that the false discovery rate among accepted verdicts remains below a user-specified level~$α$ with high probability, using finite-sample Clopper--Pearson intervals. When the parametric mode is not sufficiently confident, the instance is routed to a retrieval-augmented mode, where the judge gathers web evidence and re-evaluates the instance under a second calibrated threshold. The finite-sample guarantee carries over to this two-threshold routing without additional assumptions. Across open-domain QA benchmarks and judges of varying scales, the framework maintains the target error rate while achieving substantially higher coverage than single-mode baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 法官,检索,或潜伏:不确定的受保障的LLM 以可证明的风险担保判断
articles.content_zh: 使用法学硕士作为法官已成为评价规模模型产出的标准做法。 这对于主观的、开放式的任务,如评估有用性或校正性等没有单一参考答案的任务,尤其常见。 然而,客观的任务为无参考LLM的判断带来了明显的可靠性挑战. 在没有参考答复的情况下,法官通过对参数的了解或通过工具增强来评价事实正确性。 虽然前者能够有效评价,但法官可能会产生幻觉或缺乏充分的证据来作出判决。 相反,工具增强可以提供更多的证据,但带来额外的计算成本,需要有一个适当的机制来确定何时以及如何可靠地使用这些证据。 更重要的是,单靠这两种方法都无法对接受判决的风险提供正式控制,或保证判决在规定水平上的可靠性。 我们提出一个风险控制框架,用有限的样本Clopper-Pearson间隔来校准一个搁置的设定上的不确定性阈值,使被接受的判决中的虚假发现率保持在用户指定的水平~α美元以下,而且概率很高。 当参数化模式不够自信时,该实例被引导到一个检索-增强模式,即法官收集网络证据,在第二个校准阈值下重新评价该实例. 有限-抽样担保在不附加假设的情况下延续到这一两码路段. 在整个开放域质量保证基准和不同规模的法官中,框架维持目标误差率,同时实现比单一模式基线高得多的覆盖率。

articles.title: Against Political Polarization: A Unified Framework for Tracing Evolving Political Ideologies on Social Media
articles.content: The rapid growth of social media has greatly influenced political discourse, highlighting the need to understand individual political ideologies and their temporal dynamics. This task faces challenges such as data scarcity, abundant non-political content, costly and bias-prone manual annotation, and difficulty in modeling future ideological inclinations. To address these issues, we propose TSN4PI, a unified framework for tracking the evolution of political ideologies on social media. It includes two core modules. The PIDN uses large language models with style transfer and unsupervised domain adaptation to enable robust ideology detection and filter irrelevant content from noisy, cross-domain data. The PIPN employs temporal graph neural networks to predict future ideological shifts, enabling comprehensive analysis of ideology presence, intensity, and evolution. We release two large-scale datasets for noncommercial research use to facilitate further work. Extensive case studies on multiple platforms (X and Truth Social) validate the effectiveness of TSN4PI and provide empirical insights into political polarization and the evolution of online ideologies. Our findings offer a nuanced perspective, advancing both methodological development and empirical understanding in this field.

articles.title_zh: 反对政治两极化:追踪社会媒体不断演变的政治意识形态的统一框架
articles.content_zh: 社交媒体的迅速发展极大地影响了政治言论,突出了理解个人政治意识形态及其时间动态的必要性. 这项任务面临着数据稀缺、大量非政治内容、费用高昂和容易产生偏见的人工注释以及难以模拟未来意识形态倾向等挑战。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议TSN4PI,这是跟踪社会媒体政治意识形态演变的统一框架. 它包括两个核心模块。 PIDN使用具有风格转移和无监督域适应功能的大型语言模型,能够从吵闹的跨域数据中进行强大的意识形态检测和过滤无关内容. PIPN利用时间图神经网络来预测未来意识形态的转变,从而能够全面分析意识形态的存在,强度和演变. 我们发布了两个大型数据集,供非商业性研究使用,以便利进一步的工作。 对多个平台(X和Treal Social)的广泛案例研究验证了TSN4PI的有效性,并对政治两极分化和网络意识形态的演变提供了经验性见解. 我们的研究结果提供了细微的视角,促进了这一领域的方法发展和经验理解。

articles.title: When Writing Style Drifts: Benchmarking Authorship Verification under Distribution Shifts in Genre, Time and the AI-Era
articles.content: Authorship verification (AV) assumes that an author's writing style remains sufficiently stable to distinguish it from that of other writers. In practice, however, this assumption is challenged by distribution shifts caused by changes in genre, time, and AI-assisted writing. Existing AV benchmarks typically study these factors in isolation and focus predominantly on English, limiting our understanding of model robustness under realistic conditions. We introduce AVShift, the first German benchmark for systematically evaluating AV under multiple distribution shifts. AVShift comprises over 150,000 text pairs spanning three genres and 21 years, enabling controlled evaluation of cross-genre, temporal, and AI-era shifts within a unified framework. We benchmark representative feature-based, embedding-based, and LLM-based approaches. Our experiments show that fine-tuned LLMs generalize best across genres and benefit substantially from stylistically diverse training data. We further demonstrate that temporal drift is one of the strongest factors affecting AV, with performance degrading significantly as the time gap between documents increases. In contrast, we find no evidence of a measurable AI-era distribution shift within AVShift. Finally, our feature analysis reveals stylistic features that remain stable across genres, while their relative importance varies depending on the specific genre transition. We release AVShift and our code for future research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在写样式漂移时:在流派、时间和AI-Era的流派移动下设定作者身份验证基准
articles.content_zh: 作者身份验证(AV)假设作者的写作风格保持足够稳定,可以与其他作家的写作风格区分开来. 然而,在实践中,这种假设受到流派,时间和AI辅助写作变化引起的分配变化的挑战. 现有的AV基准通常孤立地研究这些因素,并主要侧重于英语,限制了我们对模型稳健性在现实条件下的理解. 我们引入了AVShift,这是德国在多次分配转移下系统评价AV的第一个基准. AVShift包含超过15万对跨越三个流派和21年的文本配对,能够在统一的框架内对跨流派、时间和AI时代的转变进行有控制的评价。 我们以基于特点、基于嵌入和基于LLM的代表性方法作为基准。 我们的实验表明,经过微调的LLMS最充分地概括了各个流派,并且从形形色色的多样化培训数据中获益匪浅。 我们进一步表明,时间漂移是影响反车辆地雷的最强因素之一,随着文件之间时间间隔的增加,性能显著下降。 相比之下,我们没有发现任何证据表明AI时代在AVShift内部的分布发生了可衡量的转变. 最后,我们的特点分析揭示出各个流派之间保持稳定的形态特征,而其相对重要性则因具体流派过渡而异. 我们发布AVShift和我们的代码 用于未来的研究。

articles.title: Do Large Language Models Play Six Degrees of Separation? Measuring Topological Compression in Long-Context Manifolds
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable multi-hop reasoning capabilities over long contexts, yet the internal mechanisms enabling these distant cognitive leaps remain poorly understood. Traditional attention-based interpretability often fails to capture true semantic proximity due to routing artifacts like attention sinks. In this paper, we bypass attention weights to directly analyze the dynamic geometry of the hidden state manifold, proving that deep LLM latent spaces natively organize into Small-World networks. By sparsifying the continuous similarity matrices of long-context representations into unweighted graphs, we trace the connectivity between highly disjoint semantic anchors across two distinct architectures. Our findings reveal a sharp topological phase transition: while early syntactic layers remain entirely fractured, deep reasoning layers abruptly compress massive conceptual distances into highly navigable pathways strictly bounded by the "Six Degrees of Separation" limit (=< 6 semantic hops). Furthermore, we demonstrate the practical efficacy of this framework by applying it to zero-shot hallucination detection within Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using the RAGognize dataset. We show that factually grounded generations maintain structural integrity with their source context (approximately 3 hops), whereas hallucinations induce severe topological collapse. Ultimately, this work mathematically formalizes how transformers execute abstract reasoning and provides a novel, strictly geometric signature for evaluating factual reliability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型会玩六度分离吗? 测量长文本元件的地形压缩
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在较长的语境中展现出显著的多跳推理能力,然而,使得这些遥远的认知飞跃得以实现的内部机制仍然鲜为人知. 传统的基于关注的可解释性往往无法捕捉到真正的语义上的近似,因为像注意力汇这样的路由文物. 在本文中,我们绕过注意权重来直接分析隐藏状态多面体的动态几何学,证明了LLM深潜空间在本土组织成小世界网络. 通过将长文表达的连续相似性矩阵填充成未加权的图表,我们追踪到高度脱节的语义锚点之间跨越两个不同结构的连接。 我们的发现揭示了一个尖锐的地貌阶段过渡:虽然早期的合成层仍然完全断裂,但深层推理层却突然压缩了巨大的概念距离,形成严格以"六度分离"极限(QQ6语义跳动)为界限的高度可航行路径. 此外,我们利用RAGognize数据集,在Retrival-Augnment Generation(RAG)中将这一框架应用于零射入幻觉检测,从而证明了这一框架的实际效力。 我们显示,事实上,被植根的几代人保持了结构完整性,其源头环境(大约3跳),而幻觉则导致严重的地形崩溃。 归根结底,这部作品在数学上正式确定了变压器如何执行抽象推理,并提供了一个全新的,严格的几何签名来评价事实可靠性.

articles.title: Efficient RLVR Scheduling via Graph-Structured Online Difficulty Estimation
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models but relies on costly rollout exploration. Assigning the same exploration budget to samples with different difficulty levels is inefficient: easy samples may receive redundant rollouts, whereas difficult but learnable samples may receive too little exploration. Existing adaptive schedulers address this mismatch through curriculum-based sample selection or non-uniform rollout allocation based on estimated sample difficulty. However, obtaining reliable online difficulty estimates remains challenging: dedicated probing adds substantial generation overhead, whereas history-based estimators face a cold start with no initial observations and stale feedback, and typically ignore relations among samples. To address these limitations, we propose a plug-and-play graph-based online difficulty estimator that shares rollout feedback across related samples and continuously updates their difficulty estimates, mitigating cold start and staleness without dedicated probing. Specifically, we first construct a difficulty-aware sample graph based on semantic and reasoning similarities. Based on this graph, we introduce latent difficulty states and use a Potts prior to encourage neighboring samples to share the same state. We then employ a state-level Beta-Binomial model to aggregate the rollout outcomes associated with each state. Finally, we use an online mean-field variational algorithm to continuously update the latent-state assignments and state-level difficulty as new feedback arrives. Our framework can be integrated into sample-selection and rollout-allocation schedulers, enabling difficulty-adaptive exploration without dedicated probing. Experiments across multiple base models, RL schedulers, and benchmarks demonstrate that our framework achieves better performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高效 RLVR( 高效 RLVR ) 通过图定的在线难度估计安排
articles.content_zh: 具有可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)提高了大型语言模型的推理能力,但依赖于昂贵的推出探索. 将同样的勘探预算分配给有不同难度的样品是效率低下的:容易的样品可能会得到多余的推广,而困难但可学习的样品可能得到的勘探太少。 现有的适应性调度员通过基于课程的样本选择或基于估计样本难度的非统一推出分配来解决这种不匹配. 然而,获得可靠的在线难度估计仍然具有挑战性:专门调查增加了大量的发电费,而基于历史的估算者则面临一个冷酷的开端,没有初步观察和僵硬的反馈,通常忽略样本之间的关系。 为解决这些局限性,我们提出一个基于插件和播放图的在线难度估计器,共享跨相关样本的推出反馈,并不断更新其难度估计,在不进行专用检测的情况下缓解冷启动和停滞. 具体地说,我们首先根据语义学和推理学的相似性,构建出一个意识到难度的样本图. 基于这个图,我们引入了潜在的困难状态,并在鼓励邻近的样本共享同一状态之前使用波茨. 然后我们使用一个州级的Beta-Binomial模型来汇总每个州的推出结果. 最后,我们使用在线的中场变异算法,不断更新潜在状态任务和州级难度,随着新反馈的到来. 我们的框架可以整合到样本选择和推出分配调度器中,从而能够在没有专门探测的情况下进行难度调整探索。 跨多个基础模型的实验,RL排程器,和基准都表明我们的框架能实现更好的性能.

articles.title: Grading Needs a Rubric, Not Intelligence
articles.content: Small language models can grade open-ended examination answers as reliably as substantially more expensive models when they grade against an explicit rubric. We test this claim as the design principle behind any-to-bench: a frontier model reads source documents once, at ingestion, to extract each question and its rubric; lower-cost models then perform all repeated grading work. We evaluate six cost-efficient model configurations from two model families at three reasoning-effort levels. Each configuration answers 24 open-ended examination questions, and each also grades every answer sheet three times, yielding 3,456 per-question grades. Scores depend overwhelmingly on the answer being graded: answer identity explains 95.6% of score variance, whereas judge identity explains only 0.2%. Raising a writer's reasoning effort moves earned scores by as much as 0.143 of full marks, while raising a judge's reasoning effort moves assigned scores by at most 0.006. Six frontier-tier judges, added as a check, reproduce these scores and are no more reliable as a panel. Two ablations then decompose the rubric on the same questions and answers. Removing its criteria and levels while keeping the official answer changes nothing measurable. Removing the official answer as well collapses reliability (ICC 0.888 to 0.628), inflates scores, and makes judge reasoning effort matter again. The rubric is what decouples grading from judge intelligence, and within the rubric the official answer does nearly all the work. We find no evidence of length preference or same-family preference under rubric-anchored grading.

articles.title_zh: 梯级需要一个Rubric,而不是智能
articles.content_zh: 小型语言模型可以可靠地将开放式考试的答案评分为:在按明确标题评分时,其费用要高得多。 我们测试这一说法作为任何对基准的设计原则:边框模型一次在摄入时读取源文件,以提取每个问题及其标题;然后低成本模型进行所有重复的分级工作。 我们从三个推理-努力层面评估两个模型家庭的六个成本效益高的模型配置。 每个配置回答24个不限名额的考试问题,每个组合还给每个答题表分三次,每个问题分3,456分. 得分压倒性地依赖于被分级的答案:回答身份解释得分差异的95.6%,而法官身份解释得只有0.2%. 提高作家推理动作的得分高达满分0.143分,同时提高法官推理动作的得分分配最高为0.06分. 增加的6名前沿法官作为检查,复制这些分数,不再作为评委可靠。 两杯汽水然后在相同的问答上分解这个标题. 取消其标准和水平,同时保留官方答复,不会改变任何可衡量的情况。 移除官方答案也会崩溃可靠性(ICC 0.888至0.628),夸大分数,使判断推理努力再次重要. 标题是从法官的智慧中分级,在标题中,官方的答案几乎是所有的工作。 我们没有发现任何证据表明,在名义上的悬殊等级下,偏好或偏爱同家人。

articles.title: SpeechSense: A Paralinguistic-Focused Dataset for Fine-Grained Speech Sentiment Analysis
articles.content: Recent advances in AI have revolutionized speech processing, yet effective speech understanding requires discerning not just what is said, but how it is said. Speech Sentiment Analysis plays a critical role in decoding these paralinguistic cues for diverse real-world applications such as recruitment and customer service. However, existing Speech Sentiment Analysis research faces two primary limitations. First, dominant approaches rely on text-centric pipelines that cascade Automatic Speech Recognition with text analysis. This process inevitably discards essential acoustic features like prosody and tone, failing to capture attitudinal meanings in acoustically ambiguous utterances. Second, current benchmarks suffer from a mismatch in label granularity, prioritizing basic emotions (e.g., happy, sad) over the nuanced interpersonal stances (e.g., confident, impatient) necessary for social sensitivity. To address these limitations, we propose a novel dataset, SpeechSense, for fine-grained speech sentiment analysis. Specifically, we define a specialized 8-class taxonomy of interpersonal stances detectable primarily through prosodic cues beyond lexical content alone. We then construct a curated dataset based on this taxonomy, built from high-fidelity speech synthesis and rigorous human validation. Comprehensive experiments across multi-modal LLMs, text-only LLMs, and speech encoders demonstrate that models with acoustic access consistently outperform text-only baselines. These results empirically validate the primacy of acoustic cues in detecting subtle speaker attitudes, highlighting the necessity of SpeechSense. Dataset and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/Sher13cked/SpeechSense.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 发言感应:用于精致发言感应分析的辅助语言专用数据集
articles.content_zh: AI最近的进步使语音处理发生了革命性的变化,然而有效的语音理解不仅需要辨别所说的话,而且需要辨别所说的话。 语音感应分析在为征聘和客户服务等多种现实世界应用程序解码这些语言提示方面发挥着关键作用。 然而,现有的语音感知分析研究面临两个主要限制。 首先,主要做法依靠以文本为中心的管道,这些管道通过文本分析使自动语音识别升级。 这一过程不可避免地抛弃了诸如音质和语气等基本声学特征,未能在声学模糊的言论中抓住态度含义. 其次,目前的基准在标签颗粒性上出现不匹配,将基本情感(如快乐,悲伤)放在社会敏感性所必需的细微的人际立场(如自信,不耐烦)之上. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立一个新的数据集,即SpeechSense,用于精细的语音情绪分析. 具体地说,我们界定了一种专门的8级的人际立场分类法,这种分类法主要通过超出词汇内容的流派来探测。 然后,我们根据这个分类学 构建了一套精密的数据集, 由高度真实的语音合成和严格的人类验证而来。 跨多式LLMs、仅文本的LLMs和语音编码器的全面实验表明,声学访问的模型始终超过仅文本基线。 这些结果从经验上证实了声学提示在发现微妙的演说者态度时的首要地位,突出了演讲感的必要性. 数据集和补充材料见https://github.com/Sher13cked/SpeechSense。

articles.title: CABLE: Extending the Reach of Memory Retrieval via Complementary Antecedent-Based Linking and Expansion
articles.content: As LLM agents operate across structured workflows and sessions, preserving long-term history does not ensure that later contexts can recover relevant evidence through a bounded memory interface. We study this evidence-reachability problem in long-term conversational memory, where retrieval still relies heavily on semantic similarity. This works well for topical recall, but it often misses earlier experiences, plans, or motivations that are semantically distant from the later events they help explain. Existing memory graphs provide cross-memory structure, yet links driven mainly by semantic overlap can duplicate what the host retriever already recovers. We argue that link construction should instead prioritize a sparse set of retriever-complementary associations. We present CABLE (Complementary Antecedent-Based Linking and Expansion), a plug-in augmentation that constructs links designed to extend the host retriever's direct semantic reach. For each new memory, CABLE generates antecedent-oriented queries, retrieves prior memories, subtracts candidates in the direct semantic neighborhood, and verifies the remainder before adding the accepted complementary associations into a sparse directed graph. At retrieval time, CABLE expands the host system's retrieved seeds along these links to surface implicit supporting evidence. We evaluate CABLE with A-MEM on LoCoMo and MA-LongMemEval, and further integrate it into SimpleMem and Mem0g on LoCoMo, using Qwen3.5-27B, DeepSeek-chat, and GPT-4o-mini. CABLE yields higher mean LLM-judge scores in every evaluated system-level setting, with the largest gains in categories where useful evidence is distributed across memories or sessions, including open-domain, multi-session, and preference-oriented questions. These results support prioritizing sparse, reasoning-relevant associations that complement rather than duplicate the host retriever.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CABLE:通过基于补充先例的链接和扩展扩大记忆检索范围
articles.content_zh: 由于LLM代理在结构化的工作流程和会话中运行,保存长期历史并不能确保以后的上下文能够通过有界限的内存接口恢复相关证据. 我们在长期的对话记忆中研究这个证据的可获取性问题,在那里检索仍然严重依赖语义相似性. 这对专题记忆很有用,但往往忽略了以前的经验、计划或动机,而这些经验、计划或动机与它们帮助解释的后来的事件密不可分。 现有的内存图提供了跨记忆结构,然而主要由语义重叠驱动的链接可以重复主机检索器已经恢复的内容. 我们主张,连接的建设应该优先考虑少数的检索器辅助协会。 我们提出CABLE(基于先验的辅助连接和扩展),这是一种插件增强,它构建了旨在扩展主机检索器直接语义的连接. 对于每一个新的内存,CABLE都会生成面向事前的查询,检索之前的记忆,减去直接语义街区的候选者,并在将公认的互补关联添加到一个稀疏的定向图之前验证其余部分. 在检索时间,CABLE沿着这些链接将主机系统的检索种子扩展为表面隐含的支持证据. 我们利用Quen3.5-27B、DeepSeek-chat和GPT-4o-mini,在LoCoMo和MA-LongMemEval上与A-MEM评价CABLE,并进一步将其整合到LoCoMo上的SimpleMem和Mem0g。 在每一个评价的系统级别设置中,Cable的产量均高于平均LLM评分,在有用的证据分布于记忆或会议,包括开放领域、多会期和偏好问题等类别中收益最大。 这些结果支持优先安排与推理相关的、与分散的协会,这些协会补充而不是重复主机检索器。

articles.title: BEAR-Bench: A Bilingual Enterprise and Academic Reasoning Benchmark for Multimodal Models
articles.content: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made significant strides in visual comprehension, their ability to reason about text-dense, professional documents remains incompletely evaluated. Existing benchmarks emphasize information extraction, require external domain knowledge, or cover professional documents only as one of many settings. They are also largely English- or Chinese-centric, leaving other languages and Russian, in particular, substantially underrepresented. To address these limitations, we introduce BEAR-Bench (Bilingual Enterprise and Academic Reasoning), a self-contained, complex English-and-Russian benchmark comprising 1000 human-annotated questions based on text-rich business and scientific documents. We evaluate 16 proprietary and open-weight MLLMs, including Gemini 3.1 Pro and Qwen3.5-397B, on BEAR-Bench and observe clear headroom even for the strongest systems. Finally, we use the resulting model outputs to compare existing hallucination detection methods, evaluating not only how often models fail on BEAR-Bench but also how reliably those failures can be identified.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BEAR-Bench:多式联运模式的双语企业和学术理由基准
articles.content_zh: 虽然多式大型语文模型在视觉理解方面取得了长足进展,但其解释文本敏感性的能力和专业性文件仍然没有得到完整的评价。 现有基准强调信息提取,需要外部域知识,或仅将专业文件作为许多设置之一。 它们主要以英语或中文为中心,其他语言和俄语,特别是代表人数严重不足。 为了克服这些局限性,我们采用了BEAR-Bench(双语企业和学术理性),这是一个自成一体的、复杂的英语和俄语基准,由1000个基于文本丰富的商业和科学文件的人类附加说明的问题组成。 我们评价了BEAR-Bench上的16个专有和开放重量的MLLM,包括双子座3.1 Pro和Quen3.5-397B,并观察到即使是最强的系统都有一个清晰的头室. 最后,我们利用由此产生的模型输出来比较现有的幻觉检测方法,不仅评价模型在BEAR-Bench上的故障频率,而且评价能够在多大程度上可靠地识别这些故障。

articles.title: BayesPrompt: human readable prompts that make sense
articles.content: Reconstructing prompts that can elicit a desired answer or behaviour in an LLM is an open and important research topic. Optimisation methods which aim at minimising the perplexity of a given answer, however, consistently yield so-called pseudoprompts, unintelligible strings of tokens which can lack human interpretability. We argue that this is a consequence of the ill-posedness of the prompt optimisation task. By reframing the task as a Bayesian posterior inference over prompts, we propose an efficient algorithm to sample prompts which are both efficient (in terms of perplexity) and human readable. We compare our approach with state of the art alternatives showing on a real data set a marked improvement over a range of metrics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BayesPrompt: 人类可读的有道理的提示
articles.content_zh: 重新构建能够在LLM中引起期望的答案或行为的提示是一个开放和重要的研究课题. 然而,旨在尽量减少某个答案的模糊性的最佳方法,总是产生所谓的伪速率,即无法理解的代币串,而这些代币可能缺乏人的解释性。 我们认为,这是迅速优化任务的不良后果。 通过将任务重新定位为贝叶斯语对提示的后推论,我们提出了一个高效的算法来抽样提示,这些提示既高效(在模糊性方面),又便于人类阅读。 我们比较了我们的方法和最新技术的替代品,这些替代品在真实的数据集上显示比一系列衡量标准有了显著的改进。

articles.title: Encoded but Not Actionable: Auditing the Decode-Generate-Steer Gap in Frozen LLMs for Geometric Constraints
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on structured reasoning tasks, but what they encode and whether it informs model behavior remain unclear. We investigate this question through geometric reasoning, using parametric CAD constraints as a controlled testbed for separating local pairwise relations from sketch-level constraint status. By probing the hidden states of six frozen decoder-only LLMs, we examine four properties: linear decodability, forced-choice generation, activation-level influence, and behavioral steerability. Pretraining substantially improves the decoding of local geometric relations, and this advantage persists after accounting for positional cues with shuffled-order controls. In contrast, sketch-level DOF status is already highly decodable from randomly initialized representations and improves only modestly with pretraining, indicating that much of its probe performance is available without learned weights. Further analyses show that decodable information is not always actionable. Generation often fails to express this information, and on the two intervention-tested backbones, activation-restoration effects at the patched entity position vanish while decodability persists across depth. Mean-difference steering also does not reliably control outputs. These results show that decodability, generation, activation-level influence, and steerability can diverge in the tested setting. The audit provides a controlled way to distinguish failures to encode geometric structure from failures to express or control encoded information.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 编码但不可操作:为几何限制对冷冻LLMs中的解码-Generate-Steer漏洞进行审计
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在结构化推理任务上表现出了强大的性能,但是它们编码的内容以及它是否为模型行为所参考仍然不清楚. 我们通过几何推理来调查这个问题,使用参数CAD约束作为将本地对等关系与草图级约束状态区分开来的控制试验台. 通过探测6个冷冻解码器唯一的LLM的隐藏状态,我们考察了4个属性:线性解码,强迫选择生成,激活级影响,以及行为可引导性. 预训大大改进了本地几何关系的解码,这种优势在计算位置提示并使用洗牌订单控制后继续存在。 相比之下,草图级DOF状态已经从随机初始化的表示中高度解码,仅通过预训得到适度的改进,表明其探测性能中的大部分都是没有学习权重的. 进一步的分析表明,可解码的信息并不总是可以操作的。 一代人往往无法表达这一信息,在两个经过干预测试的骨干上,在补丁的实体位置的激活-恢复效应消失,而可解码性则持续存在。 平均偏差方向也无法可靠地控制产出。 这些结果表明,可解码性、生成性、激活级影响和可操纵性在试验环境中可能有所不同。 审计为区分编码几何结构失败和编码信息表达或控制失败提供了控制方式.

articles.title: From Global Benchmarks to Local Evaluations: Benchmarking LLMs for the German Public Sector
articles.content: Public institutions face a persistent challenge in selecting LLMs suited to their specific context. Existing benchmarks, however, are of limited use as they primarily reflect English-language and US-centric settings, and often only evaluate task performance. In this paper, we present first results of MÖVE, a holistic evaluation framework for the German public sector, examining three rarely considered governance dimensions: energy consumption, provider transparency, and knowledge of German-party positions. Our results reveal significant trade-offs, with no single model excelling across all dimensions: estimated energy consumption varies more than 60-fold and is not explained by model size alone, information disclosure varies systematically across providers, and European models do not exhibit stronger knowledge of German party positions. Model selection for public institutions thus cannot rely on performance rankings alone. Instead, evaluations should also reflect the governance requirements of the deployment context.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从全球基准到地方评价: 德国公共部门法学硕士
articles.content_zh: 公共机构在选择适合其具体情况的有限责任管理课程方面面临长期挑战。 然而,现有基准用处有限,因为它们主要反映英语和以美国为中心的环境,而且往往只评价任务业绩。 在本文中,我们介绍了德国公共部门整体评价框架 -- -- MÖVE -- -- 的初步结果,审查了三个很少考虑的治理层面:能源消耗、供应商透明度和对德国政党立场的了解。 我们的结果显示了重大的权衡,没有一个单一的模式能在所有层面发挥突出的作用:能源消费估计值有60倍以上,而且不能仅仅用模型大小来解释,信息披露在提供方之间有系统差异,欧洲模式对德国政党立场没有更深入的了解。 因此,公共机构的模式选择不能仅依靠业绩排名。 相反,评价还应反映部署方面的治理要求。

articles.title: Interpretable Humans, Alien LLMs: Expert Analysis of Latent Structures in Assessment Responses
articles.content: The evaluation of large language models (LLMs) relies heavily on human-designed assessments, implicitly assuming that AI and humans employ similar underlying cognitive constructs. Challenging this assumption, we investigate whether the latent factors governing LLM performance carry the same substantive, human-interpretable meaning as the cognitive constructs governing human learners. Using responses from humans and six LLMs across quantitative reasoning and chemistry assessments, we conducted Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) separately for both groups. Subject-Matter Experts (SMEs) then blindly evaluated the resulting factor graphs to ascribe pedagogical meaning to the emerged constructs. SMEs successfully interpreted most of the human-derived factors. Conversely, they could not ascribe meaning to any LLM-derived factors in quantitative reasoning and interpreted only half of the LLM factors in chemistry. By combining data-driven EFA with blind expert interpretation, this framework shows that LLMs frequently operate on statistically opaque mechanisms distinct from human reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 解释性人类,外国人 LLMS:评估对策中后期结构的专家分析
articles.content_zh: 对大语言模型(LLMs)的评价很大程度上依赖于人类设计的评估,隐含地假设AI和人类使用类似的基础认知结构. 我们对这个假设提出质疑,我们调查的是,指导LLM性能的潜在因素是否具有与指导人类学习者的认知结构相同的实质性、人的解释意义。 我们利用人类和6个LLMs在定量推理和化学评估中的反应,分别对这两个群体进行了探索性因素分析。 然后,主体-数学专家盲目评估了由此产生的因数图,将教学意义归于新出现的构造。 中小企业成功地解释了大部分人为因素。 反之,它们不能在定量推理中将LLM衍生因素的含意归于任何LLM衍生因素,只能解释化学中半数LLM因素. 这一框架将数据驱动的全民教育与盲目专家解释相结合,表明法学硕士经常在不同于人类推理的统计不透明机制上运作。

articles.title: Whether LLMs Can Navigate Beliefs and Facts Depends on How You Phrase It
articles.content: Humans naturally form and express beliefs in daily communication, e.g., "I think the answer is 3" or "I suppose that's right." Such beliefs inevitably intertwine with fact and knowledge, making the ability to handle them in tandem desirable for large language models (LLMs), as they are increasingly deployed in user-facing settings. Prior work showed that even capable LLMs exhibit a systemic weakness in acknowledging user beliefs grounded in incorrect information. We extend this evaluation to 10 LLMs across 18 epistemic expressions and find that the size and direction of the weakness depend on the verb used to express the belief, with the accuracy gap between factual and false information ranging from +50% on "I vaguely remember" to -14% on "I seriously doubt". We further show that the phenomenon stems from task confusion: models default to fact-checking the underlying claim, overriding the user's stated belief; chains of thought that explicitly fact-check show lower accuracy on false information than those that do not; and a single instruction can reverse the failure across verb families. Mechanistically, models attend more to false beliefs they fail to confirm, but suppressing this attention at decoding time recovers accuracy only partially and only in some models, calling for future work on intervention methods. Our findings clarify prior results and show how fact-checking, a generally desirable behavior, can interfere with belief tracking in LLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/ngqm/belief-fact-phrasing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMS 是否能够导航信仰和事实取决于您如何措辞
articles.content_zh: 人类在日常交流中自然形成并表达信仰,如"我认为答案是3"或"我想这是正确的". 这种信念不可避免地与事实和知识交织在一起,使大语言模式(LLMS)能够协同处理,因为这些模式越来越多地部署在与用户接触的环境下。 先前的工作显示,即使是有能力的有限责任公司,在承认基于不正确信息的用户信仰方面也表现出系统性弱点。 我们把这个评价扩展到了10个LLM, 涵盖18个感官表达, 发现弱点的大小和方向取决于用来表达信仰的动词, 我们进一步表明,这一现象源于任务混淆:模型默认检查基本说法的事实,压倒了用户所宣称的信念;明确检查事实的思维链显示虚假信息的准确性低于不真实信息的思维链;单一指令可以扭转动词家族的失败。 机械上,模型更多地关注他们未能证实的虚假信仰,但在解码时间压制这种关注只能部分恢复精度,也只在某些模型中恢复精度,要求今后就干预方法开展工作. 我们的调查结果澄清了先前的结果,并表明事实检查(一种普遍可取的行为)如何会干扰法学硕士的信仰跟踪。 我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ngqm/belief-fact-phrasing上找到.

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Reward Specification and Benchmark Reliability in GRPO-based LLM Unlearning
articles.content: Practical LLM unlearning is usually evaluated through two objectives: suppress target-specific knowledge and preserve non-target utility. In generative QA, this leaves a third behavior underspecified: when a target-adjacent prompt admits a broader answer without target-specific leakage, the model should answer at that level rather than leak, evade, or refuse. We study this specification problem in a controlled LoRA-GRPO RWKU setting, comparing four reward designs that span lexical suppression, anti-refusal shaping, rubric-based broad answering, and an explicit refusal contrast, with and without SFT warm-up. The experiments show that optimization success is not equivalent to behavioral unlearning: RWKU forget scores, held-out completion audits, terminal training-rollout audits, and training dynamics can point to different conclusions. We trace these disagreements to reward-hacking endpoints, policy-support limits in GRPO, benchmark probes that miss endpoint changes, and rewards that can select broad-topic answering with low semantic leakage during optimization.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关于基于GPRO的LLM中奖励规格和基准可靠性的经验研究 未学习
articles.content_zh: 实际的LLM未学习通常通过两个目标来评价:压制特定目标的知识,并保存非目标用途. 在基因QA中,这留下了第三种行为描述不足:当一个目标相邻的迅速承认一个没有特定目标泄漏的更广泛的答案时,模型应该在这个层次回答,而不是泄露,逃避,或者拒绝. 我们用LORA-GRPO RWKU的可控设置来研究这个规格问题,比较了四种奖励设计,这些设计跨越了语言压制,反反面塑造,基于面值的广义回答,以及一种明确拒绝的对比,与和没有SFT热身的对比. 实验显示,优化成功并不等同于行为失学:RWKU忘记分数,搁置完成审计,终端培训-滚动审计,以及培训动态可以得出不同的结论. 我们追踪到这些分歧,以奖励-打击端点、GRPO中的政策支持限制、错过端点变化的基准探测器,以及可以在优化期间选择低语义渗漏的广义答案的奖励。

articles.title: TraceSQL: Traceable Answerability Estimation for Reference-Free Text-to-SQL Verification
articles.content: Text-to-SQL systems are commonly evaluated using ground-truth SQL queries or reference execution results, but such supervision is unavailable at inference time in real-world deployments. This creates a critical verification problem: given only a user question, database context, and generated SQL, can a system estimate whether the generated query is likely to correctly answer the question? Recent approaches use LLMs as judge or specialized agents to inspect generated SQL, but their decisions can be difficult to trace. Outcome Reward Models (ORMs) address this by learning from execution-labeled candidate SQLs and assigning correctness scores to unseen queries, yet they still provide limited visibility into the signals behind each verification. To address this limitation, we propose TraceSQL, a lightweight and traceable verification model built on explicit diagnostic features. TraceSQL combines 67 features capturing question ambiguity, question requirements, question-schema-SQL consistency, SQL structure, and intent alignment. These signals remain available for examining which factors influence each prediction and for tracing decisions back to diagnostic evidence. On BIRD development databases, TraceSQL achieves 66.47% F1 and 64.48% ROC-AUC, compared with 61.87% F1 and 58.26% ROC-AUC for the GradeSQL-7B ORM baseline on the same generated-SQL evaluation. Feature attribution further shows that the model relies on both semantic grounding and deterministic SQL-structure signals. These results show that SQL verification can be performed with a lightweight learned model while retaining feature-level evidence for inspecting and diagnosing its predictions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TraceSQL:无参考文本对SQL的可追踪可回答估计 核查
articles.content_zh: 文本到SQL系统通常利用地面真实的SQL查询或参考执行结果进行评估,但在现实世界的部署中,这种监督在推断时是不存在的。 这造成了一个关键的验证问题:只给一个用户问题,数据库上下文,并生成了SQL,一个系统是否能够估计所生成的查询是否能够正确回答这个问题? 近期的方法使用LLMs作为法官或专门代理人来检查生成的SQL,但其决定可能难以追踪. 结果奖励模型(ORMs)通过从被执行标记的候选人SQLs学习并给隐形查询分配正确的分数来解决这个问题,然而它们仍然在每次核查背后的信号中提供有限的可见度. 为了消除这一局限性,我们提议建立基于明确诊断特征的轻量级和可追踪核查模型 TraceSQL。 TraceSQL结合了67个特征,捕捉了问题模糊,问题要求,问题-schema-SQL一致性,SQL结构,以及意图对齐. 这些信号仍可用于审查影响每项预测的因素,并用于将决定追溯到诊断证据。 在BIRD开发数据库中,TraceSQL实现66.47%的F1和64.48%的ROC-AUC,而在同一生成的SQL评价中,GradeSQL-7B ORM基线的ROC-AUC则达到61.87%的F1和58.26%. 特征归属进一步表明,该模型既依赖于语义定位,又依赖于决定性的SQL-结构信号. 这些结果显示,SQL验证可以用轻量级的学习模型进行,同时保留特征级证据,用于检查和诊断其预测.

articles.title: Preference Is Not Intervention: The Structure and Stability Boundaries of Reader-Specific Evidence Utility
articles.content: ML systems increasingly condition decisions on downstream model identity, but this is useful only if model-specific differences form reusable structure rather than input-local interactions. We test this in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where evidence utility can be measured under controlled interventions. Holding query, evidence, task, scoring, and intervention fixed, nine readers disagree on effect sign in 33\% of jointly affected cells; reader$\times$query interaction explains 29.8\% of utility variance versus an 8.4\% permutation null; and self-selected evidence improves F1 by $+0.031$ ($t=3.39$). We then ask the sharper question: \emph{which components of this heterogeneity are stable reader properties across queries?} Separating three measurable objects---evidence \emph{activity}, \emph{ordinal preference}, and \emph{conditional signed direction}---we find ordinal reader geometry stable across four independent settings (split-half $ρ=0.60$--$0.83$): leave-one-out interventions, PRISM preferences, RAMDocs, and RAGuard. Signed geometry is task-bounded: weak in open-ended QA (0.14, 0.35), especially for misleading and irrelevant evidence, but strong in binary fact-checking (0.75) with no significant ordinal gap, though still below its sparsity-matched ceiling. Sparsity, decoding noise, and metric artifacts do not explain the main ordinal--signed gap. Finally, stable ordinal similarity fails to predict cross-reader intervention transfer (oracle-distance $ρ=-0.27$; regret reliability $-0.28$). Reader-specific utility exists, but preference is not intervention: stable ranking similarity does not license transfer of help/harm decisions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 优先不是干预:读者的结构和稳定界限 -- -- 具体证据的效用
articles.content_zh: ML系统越来越多地将决策以下游模型身份为条件,但这只有在模型特定差异形成可重复使用的结构而不是输入-局部相互作用时才有用. 我们在回收强化生成(RAG)中检验了这一点,在这种生成中,证据效用可以在有控制的干预下加以衡量。 持有查询、证据、任务、评分和干预固定,9名读者在33 QQ的效应标志上意见不一;读者$\times$query交互解释29.8QX的功用差异,而8.4QQ的排位无效;自选证据将F1提高0.031美元(t=3.39美元)。 然后我们再问一个更尖锐的问题:\emph{ 此异质性的哪部分是稳定的阅读器属性, 跨越询问?} 分隔三种可测量对象- 证据\ emph{ 活动},\ emph{ 普通偏好}, 和\ emph{ 有条件的签名方向} - - - 我们发现四个独立设置的普通读取器几何稳定( 半美元 0. 60美元 - 0.83美元): 一次退出干预、 PrisM 偏好、 RAM Docs 和 RAGuard 。 已签名的几何学是受任务约束的:在无限制的QA(0.14,0.35)中软弱无力,特别是因为误导性和不相关的证据,但在二进制事实检查(0.75)中坚固,没有显著的正数差距,尽管仍然低于其螺旋相配的上限. 分级,解码噪声,以及度量文物并不能解释主正弦符号的空隙. 最后,稳定的正则相似性未能预测跨读器干预转移(oracle-train $ρ=-0.27美元;遗憾可靠性为0.28美元)。 读者特有的效用存在,但偏好不是干预:稳定的排序相似性不能允许转移帮助/伤害决定.

articles.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
articles.content: Take three frontier mixture-of-experts models (Alibaba, OpenAI, NVIDIA; 3.6-4.0B active parameters each) and fine-tune them to reason in a low-resource language. On accuracy benchmarks almost nothing happens, and the benchmark itself is noise at this scale: changing only the random seed moves the score by 7.7 points, more than every data and recipe effect we measured. That null is our first result. The real changes live where accuracy cannot see. Base models never think in Greek: 0 of 1,000 reasoning traces, even when the question is Greek, so the model answers correctly while reasoning in a form its user cannot read, audit, or correct. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), every released checkpoint reasons in the language of the question on ~98% of items, one family at 3x fewer tokens, with judged grammaticality improving on all four models and general ability within a few points of each base: nothing was forgotten, and fluency was gained. We propose six behavioural dimensions that make such changes measurable, each gated to reject any metric that correlates with output length, and we report how our own instruments lied: six failures, each caught by a control. What SFT cannot do is fix its own defects: a quarter of answers skip the requested format, answers leak into the reasoning channel, and an explicit "think in English" is obeyed under half the time. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, pre-registered before training, fixes the first two outright (fallback 24% to 2.5%, leak 3.5% to 0.0%, both against a flat random-reward control) and moves the third (+9.1pp), while the Greek reasoning habit survives an accuracy-only gradient untouched. We release five checkpoints. The instruments, the controls and the pre-registration travel to any low-resource language; Greek is the case that let us measure them.

articles.title_zh: 在低资源语言中思考: SFT 构建的东西, RL 修复的东西, 无法看到的准确性
articles.content_zh: 采用三种前沿专家混合模型(阿里巴、OpenAI、NVIDIA;每个3.6-4.0B活性参数),并以低资源语言对其进行精细调整,使之合理。 在精确度基准上几乎什么都没有发生,基准本身就是这个尺度上的噪音:只改变随机的种子将分数移动7.7分,超过我们所测量的每一个数据和食谱效果. 这个无效是我们的第一个结果。 真实的改变活在精度无法看到的地方. 基础模型在希腊语中从不思考:在1000个推理痕迹中只有0个,即使问题是希腊语,所以模型在以某种形式进行推理时正确回答,其用户无法读取,审计,或正确. 经过监督微调(SFT)后,每一次以问题语言在~98%的物品上发布的检查点理由,一个家庭以3x更少的代号,每个基数数数点内对所有四个模型的判断语法和一般能力都有改善:没有忘记任何东西,获得了流利. 我们提出可以衡量这种变化的六个行为层面,每个层面都拒绝与产出长度相关的任何衡量标准,我们报告我们自己的工具如何说谎:六个失败,每个失败都受到控制。 SFT不能做的是弥补自己的缺陷:四分之一的答案跳过所请求的格式,答案漏入推理通道,半个时间下会遵守一个明确的"英语思维". 用可核查的奖励进行强化学习,在训练前预先注册,将前两个完全修正(倒数24%到2.5%,漏出3.5%到0.0%,两者都对应一个平坦的随机奖励控制),并移动第三个(+9.1pp),而希腊推理习惯则未受精度限制的梯度。 我们放了五个检查站。 仪器、管制和预先登记旅行是使用任何低资源语言;希腊语就是让我们衡量它们的例子。

articles.title: What Aggregate Scores Miss: Measuring Item-Level Regressions in Commercial LLM API Migrations
articles.content: Context: Software systems that depend on commercial large language model APIs must migrate to successor versions when vendors deprecate older models. Migration decisions typically rely on aggregate benchmark scores, which compress heterogeneous item-level behaviour into a single net figure. Objective: We measure what that compression conceals. Method: On three pairwise upgrades in the GPT-5.4 to GPT-5.6 Sol product sequence, we query 900 public benchmark items (graduate-level knowledge, olympiad mathematics, instruction following) 50 times per item per model, classify each item as reliably improved, reliably regressed, practically equivalent, or inconclusive under false-discovery-rate control and a practical-significance threshold, and calibrate the results against a label-permutation null. Results: Across all nine migration-benchmark cells, reliable improvements and reliable regressions coexist. Edges with aggregate gains of up to 7.3 percentage points contain up to 8.3% reliably regressed items; edges with aggregate losses contain up to 10.7% reliably improved items. On the instruction-following benchmark, the gap between strict and loose scoring widens by 3.9 percentage points on the latest migration: a 3.9-point regression under strict scoring shrinks to 0.04 points under loose scoring. Conclusion: Migration decisions based on aggregate scores alone miss substantial bidirectional item-level change. The complete response-level archive and per-item scoring outputs are released.

articles.title_zh: 何为总分差 : 测量商业 LLM API 迁移中的项目级递减
articles.content_zh: 背景:当销售商贬值旧型时,依赖商业大语言模型API的软件系统必须迁移到后续版本. 移徙决定通常依靠总基准分数,将不同项目层面的行为压缩为单一净数。 目标:我们测量压缩所隐藏的东西。 方法 : 在GPT-5.4到GPT-5.6 Sol产品序列的三次双向升级中,我们查询了900个公共基准项目(研究生水平的知识、奥林匹亚数学、随后的教学),每个模型50次,将每个项目归类为可靠改进、可靠倒退、实际等同,或者在假发现率控制和实用标志阈值下无定论,并将结果与标签输出无效进行校准。 结果: 在所有九个移徙基准细胞中,可靠的改进和可靠的回归共存。 总收益高达7.3个百分点的边缘含有8.3%的可靠倒退项目;总损失的边缘含有10.7%的可靠改良项目。 在遵循指令的基准上,严格评分和松散评分之间的差距在最新移徙中扩大了3.9个百分点:严格评分下的3.9分回归,在松散评分下的0.04分缩小。 结论:仅根据总分数作出的移徙决定就错过了重大双向项目层面变化。 完整的响应级别归档和每个项目评分输出被发布.

articles.title: LLM-Derived Preference Judgments Are Not Self-Consistent
articles.content: Agents increasingly interpret a person's natural-language preferences by querying an LLM for numerical preference judgments, e.g., by asking how much the person would be willing to pay for an item. A growing body of work estimates a utility function from these judgments and then chooses actions based on their estimated utility. This pipeline assumes the judgments are approximately self-consistent: that a single utility function can reproduce them. But are they? To study this question, we measure the self-consistency of cardinal LLM preference judgments. For example, the difference in stated willingness-to-pay between two items should match the stated payment that makes a person indifferent to exchanging them. We develop statistical tests and interpretable measures of how far observed responses depart from the best-fitting self-consistent utility function. Experiments with flight, apartment, and hotel examples across six LLMs reveal large persistent inconsistencies. This suggests that LLM-derived preference judgments cannot be faithfully summarized by a single utility function.

articles.title_zh: LLM - Derived 优先判决不自律
articles.content_zh: 代理人越来越多地通过查询数字偏好判断的LLM来解释一个人的自然语言偏好,例如,询问一个人愿意为某一物品支付多少钱。 越来越多的工作从这些判断中估算出一种效用功能,然后根据估计的效用选择行动。 这种管道假设判断大致自成一体:单一的公用功能可以复制. 但是他们呢? 为了研究这个问题,我们衡量主要的法律优先判断的自我一致性。 例如,两个项目之间表明的付款意愿的差额应当与表明的付款相匹配,使个人对交换这些付款无动于衷。 我们制定统计测试和可解释的衡量标准,说明所观察到的反应在多大程度上偏离了最符合自我的效用功能。 有关飞行、公寓和旅馆的六个有限责任公司实例的实验表明,存在很大的长期不一致之处。 这表明,从LLM得出的偏好判断不能被一个单一的效用函数忠实地概括。

articles.title: MoNe: Modular Neural Memory for Efficient Long Context Inference
articles.content: We present MoNe, a lightweight modular neural memory that attaches to any frozen pretrained Transformer to enable long-context inference without retraining. MoNe reads context in fixed-size segments via test-time learning of fast-weight neural memory networks with layer-localized gradient updates; at inference, the memory generates keys and values from the query tokens alone, with no context tokens re-read. This two-phase design decouples inference cost from context length, achieving $O(N)$ preprocessing and $O(1)$ query cost with peak GPU memory that does not grow with $N$. At 128K tokens, MoNe reduces both compute and peak GPU memory by approximately 80% compared to ICL with only 6.4% parameter overhead. MoNe generalizes to context lengths far beyond the backbone's native window, achieving strong performance on needle-in-a-haystack and word extraction benchmarks from RULER, where ICL degrades sharply.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MoNE: 高效长背景推论的模块神经内存
articles.content_zh: 我们呈现的是MoNe,一种轻量级的模块神经记忆,它附着在任何被冻结的预先训练的变形器上,使得长时间的文字推论无需再培训. MoNE通过测试时间学习具有层局部化梯度更新的快速量级神经内存网络,在固定大小的区段中读取上下文;推论,内存单独从查询符中生成键和值,没有上下文符重读. 这种双阶段设计脱钩推论成本与上下文长度,实现$O(N)$预处理和$O(1)$查询成本,顶峰GPU内存不会随$N$增长. 在128K令牌上,MoNe将计算和峰值GPU内存都减少约80%,而ICL只有6.4%。 MoNe将背景长度概括到远远超出骨干原生窗口,实现了来自欧盟驻科法治团的针入海斯塔克和字词提取基准的强效性能,ICL在那里急剧退化.

articles.title: Multi-turn Conversational AI from Text to Multimodal Interaction: Data, Models, Evaluation, and Open Challenges
articles.content: Conversational AI is moving beyond isolated text prompts toward sustained, multimodal interaction. In real conversations, users clarify goals, revise requests, interrupt responses, switch topics, and introduce new evidence while expecting systems to preserve context across turns. This makes multi-turn dialogue a distinct challenge requiring systems to maintain and update memory, ground responses across modalities, tools, and external knowledge, and adapt across languages and cultures. This study reviews multi-turn conversational AI across text-only dialogue, AudioLLMs and speech-native systems, multimodal and omni-modal systems, and tool-augmented agents. We organize the literature around datasets and benchmarks, modeling paradigms, training strategies, evaluation setups, and cross-cutting challenges. Our analysis shows that support for multiple modalities has advanced faster than the ability to sustain coherent interaction across a session. Despite stronger capabilities to perceive, speak, and act across modalities, current systems still struggle with persistent memory, cross-turn grounding, full-duplex interaction, robust evaluation, and cultural alignment. We conclude with a research agenda for systems that can remember, revise, ground, speak, listen, act, and adapt across turns, modalities, and cultures. (https://github.com/faiza-sfa/multiturn-conversational-ai-survey)

articles.title_zh: 从文本到多式联运:数据、模型、评价和公开挑战的多回合对话AI
articles.content_zh: 对话 大赦国际正在超越孤立的文本提示,走向持续、多式联运的互动。 在真实的对话中,用户澄清目标,修改请求,中断回应,切换话题,引入新的证据,同时期待系统能够保存跨回合的上下文. 这使得多回合对话成为一个独特的挑战,需要系统维持和更新记忆、各种模式、工具和外部知识的地面反应以及各种语言和文化的适应。 本研究报告审查跨文本专用对话的多回合对话AI、AudioLLMs和语音本地系统、多式联运和全方位模式系统以及工具辅助代理。 我们围绕数据集和基准组织文献,模拟范例,培训战略,评价设置,以及交叉挑战. 我们的分析表明,对多种模式的支持速度快于保持整个会议之间连贯一致的互动的能力。 尽管认识、说话和跨模式行动的能力更强,但目前的系统仍然与持续的记忆、交叉转弯、全面互动、稳健的评价和文化协调作斗争。 最后,我们提出一个研究议程,研究能够记忆、修改、定位、说话、倾听、采取行动和适应各种转变、模式和文化的系统。 (https://github.com/faiza-sfa/multurn-conconversational-ai-survey) (中文(简体) ).

articles.title: Write, Execute, Refine: From Skill Followers to Skill Optimizers via Reinforcement Learning from Execution Feedback
articles.content: Expert-written natural language skills can improve tool-using agents, yet agent-authored skills perform 8-11 points worse than using no skill. This gap suggests that following procedural guidance and improving it from execution evidence are distinct capabilities. Inference time loops can repair skills but do not improve the model that writes the next one. We study how to organize execution experience from intermediate skills into training states for an optimizer. We introduce WER (Write, Execute, and Refine), a multi-phase framework that trains a Skill Optimizer outside a frozen executor. The optimizer proposes skills, a frozen agent executes each repeatedly, and a programmatic verifier scores the outcomes. The scores provide relative credit and select mixed-outcome records. Matched successful and failed trajectories from these records form the next phase's refinement states, so the optimizer learns from the consequences of its earlier outputs. On BFCL v4 multi-turn and tau2-bench, WER improves average Pass@1 over the no-skill baseline by 7.80 and 3.85 points, respectively. Under an identical refinement workflow, it outperforms the same backbone without optimizer training by 9.35 and 10.29 points. The trained 4B optimizer reaches 76.63 percent on BFCL v4, outperforming all evaluated off-the-shelf general-purpose models used as skill optimizers on average.

articles.title_zh: 写、执行、完善:通过执行反馈的强化学习,从技能跟踪者到技能优化者
articles.content_zh: 专家写作的自然语言技能可以改进工具使用代理,但代理作者的技能表现比不使用技能还差8-11分. 这一差距表明,遵循程序指导并从执行证据中加以改进是独特的能力。 推论时间循环可以修复技能,但不会改进写下一部的模型. 我们研究如何将执行经验从中级技能组织到培训阶段,以便优化人员。 我们引入了WER(Write, Execute, and Findine),这是一个多阶段框架,在被冻结的执行器外训练一个技能优化器. 优化者提出技能,冷冻剂会反复执行,方案核查员会给结果评分. 得分提供相对信用,并选择混合结果记录. 从这些记录中匹配成功和失败的轨迹,形成了下一阶段的完善状态,因此优化者从其早期产出的后果中学习. 在BFCL v4多转弯和tau2-bench上,WER将平均Pass@1比无技能基线分别提高7.80和3.85分. 在一个相同的完善工作流程下,它比同一个骨干运行,没有优化训练9.35分和10.29分. 经培训的4B优化器在BFCL v4上达到76.63%,所有被评价的现成通用模型都比平均用作技能优化器的通用模型高。

articles.title: Auditing Exposure to Harmful Content on TikTok using Multimodal Language Models: A Cross-National, Age-Stratified Study
articles.content: Online video platforms can expose young users to harmful content, but independent audits remain difficult because video annotation is costly and moderation judgments vary across languages. We audit TikTok in France, Italy, and Sweden with sockpuppet accounts representing four age personas (13, 16, 19, 40), collecting 36,971 videos from passive For-You-page scrolling and active sessions that scroll, search for harm keywords, and scroll again. To scale annotation, we validate four multimodal LLMs against native-speaker labels on a 300-video reference set. Gemini 2.5 Flash with eight sampled frames plus text performs best (aggregate kappa = 0.42), at half the per-call cost of native-video upload, and we apply it to a 10% sample for approximately \$50 in total API spend across both modalities. Keyword search returns 35-56% harmful content, a 1.5-7.5x increase over the scrolling baseline in ten of twelve country-age combinations; the spike is temporary and flattens the age differences observed in France and Sweden. Under passive scrolling, Italy has the highest harm rate at every age, with Italian age-19 reaching 48.6%. Overall, MLLM-based auditing offers a scalable approach for cross-national youth-safety audits, while provider safety filters (1.1% refusal rate) under-count the most explicit harms.

articles.title_zh: 使用多种语文模式对TikTok有害内容的审计:跨国家、年龄分级研究
articles.content_zh: 在线视频平台可以让年轻用户接触有害内容,但独立审计仍然很困难,因为视频注释成本高昂,不同语言的温和判断也各不相同. 我们审计法国、意大利和瑞典的TikTok, 使用代表四个年龄(13岁、16岁、19岁、40岁)的Sockpupet账户, 为了扩大注释范围,我们在300个视频参考集上对照本地语言标签验证了4个多式联运LLMs。 双子座2.5 Flash带有8个样本框加文本的性能最好(aggregate kappa=0.42),是本地视频上传的每集成本的一半,我们把它应用于10%的样本,大约为API在两种模式下的总开支的50%. 关键词搜索返回了35-56%的有害内容,在12个国家年龄组合中,有10个国家年龄组合比滚动基线增加1.5-7.5x;这一突起是暂时的,使法国和瑞典观察到的年龄差异趋于平缓。 在被动滚动下,意大利每个年龄的伤害率最高,意大利19岁达到48.6%. 总体而言,基于最低劳动报酬的审计为跨国青年安全审计提供了可扩展的方法,而供应商安全过滤器(1.1%的拒绝率)低估了最明显的伤害。

articles.title: Domain-Adapted Molecular Language Models for Efficient Search of Make-on-Demand Libraries
articles.content: Pretrained molecular language models are increasingly used as molecular encoders for learning structure-property relationships. However, their practical suitability for molecular discovery within and beyond their pretraining domain remains unclear. Herein, we systematically benchmark four molecular language models across six virtual molecular libraries spanning drug discovery, organic materials, and catalysis. Native molecular language model embeddings show substantial variation in discovery performance across libraries, whereas molecular fingerprints provide a consistently strong and robust baseline. Consistent with a potential domain-representation mismatch, we show that explicit domain adaptation substantially improves representation performance. Fine-tuning molecular language model encoders on structures from the target virtual library consistently improves sample efficiency, with several adapted encoders emerging as the top-performing representations across the benchmark tasks. These results show that molecular representation quality depends strongly on the target domain and that explicit adaptation can improve the practical utility of molecular foundation models. More broadly, our findings establish domain-adapted molecular representations as a promising strategy for sample-efficient adaptive decision making in virtual screening and self-driving laboratories.

articles.title_zh: 有效搜索 Make-on-Demand 图书馆的域优化分子语言模型
articles.content_zh: 预先训练的分子语言模型越来越多地被用作学习结构-财产关系的分子编码器. 然而,它们是否实际适合在其预先训练领域内外进行分子发现,仍然不清楚。 在此,我们系统地将四个分子语言模型 覆盖六个虚拟分子库 包括药物发现、有机材料和催化物 原生分子语言模型嵌入显示各库的发现性能有很大差异,而分子指纹则提供了一贯强健有力的基线. 与潜在的域代表不匹配情况相一致,我们显示,明确域的适应大大改进了代表性能。 对目标虚拟库结构上的分子语言模型编码器进行精细调整,不断提高样本效率,一些经过改造的编码器逐渐成为跨基准任务的顶级表现. 这些结果显示,分子表达质量在很大程度上取决于目标领域,明确的适应可以提高分子基础模型的实际效用. 更广泛地说,我们的调查结果将适合域的分子表示确定为在虚拟筛选和自驾车实验室中进行具有样本效率的适应性决策的有希望的战略。

articles.title: Reflex-Guard: A Low-Latency Guardrail for LLM Prompt Safety Using Dense Semantic Embeddings
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications often face the risks of specially crafted prompts designed to bypass the safety controls. Existing guardrail methods, such as LLM-as-a-judge and cloud-based safety APIs are able to detect unsafe content. However, they often add a delay of about 250-900 ms to each request. This delay is too high for real-time applications, when the system usually needs to respond in less than 100 ms. Furthermore, routing user prompts through external moderation endpoints raises significant data privacy concerns. This paper introduces Reflex-Guard, a lightweight guardrail that runs locally. It uses jailbreak-aware preprocessing, compact sentence-transformer embeddings, and seven fast binary classifiers. Together, these components enable high-accuracy prompt safety filtering with much lower latency than existing solutions. Through systematic evaluation on a strategically balanced dataset of 30,568 samples drawn from five complementary sources, we demonstrate that Reflex-Guard achieves 95.9% recall on harmful prompts at 37.6 ms end-to-end latency. It is faster than existing baselines, including Llama Guard 2 at 255 ms and SafeDecoding at 723 ms. It can detect 100% of GCG suffix attacks and Base64-encoded prompts using the default threshold. However, DrAttack structured prompts required lowering the threshold to 0.03 for optimal detection, as they produced a distinct probability distribution. Reflex-Guard achieves Reflex Efficiency Score (RES) scores up to 16.79, significantly outperforming Llama Guard 2 (11.90) and SafeDecoding (9.80). This analysis offers practical deployment advice and shows that different attack types occupy distinct regions in the embedding probability space.

articles.title_zh: Reflex-Guard:LLM快速安全低强度护栏,使用语义学 嵌入
articles.content_zh: 现实世界应用中的大语言模型(LLMs)经常面临专门设计来绕过安全控制的提示的风险. 现有的护卫方法,如LLM-as-a-judge和基于云的安全API,能够检测到不安全的内容. 然而,它们常常给每项请求增加约250-900毫秒的延迟. 这种延迟对于实时应用来说太高了,当系统通常需要用不到100ms的响应. 此外,通过外部温和端点的路由用户提示引起对数据隐私的重大关切。 本文引入了Reflex-Guard(英语:Reflex-Guard),这是一条在当地运行的轻量级护卫铁路. 它使用越狱预处理,紧凑的句子转换嵌入,以及七个快速二进制分类器. 这些组件加在一起,能够快速进行高精确度的安全过滤,其延迟度远低于现有的解决方案。 通过对来自五个补充来源的30,568个战略平衡的样本数据集进行系统评价,我们证明Reflex-Guard在37.6 ms的末端到末端延迟时对有害的诱发物进行了95.9%的召回。 它比现有的基线更快,包括255米的Llama Guard 2和723米的SafeDecoding。 它可以百分之百地检测GCG后缀攻击和使用默认阈值的Base64-编码提示. 然而,DrAttack结构化的提示要求将阈值降低到0.03,以便进行最佳检测,因为这些提示产生了一个明显的概率分布。 Reflex-Guard实现了Reflex效率分数(RES)的得分,最高达16.79分,显著超过Llama Guard 2 (11.90)和SafeDecoding (9.80). 这一分析提供了实际部署建议,并表明不同攻击类型在嵌入概率空间中占据不同的区域。

articles.title: Code as Representation: A Compilable Parsing Paradigm for Academic Documents
articles.content: Academic papers are a primary carrier of scientific knowledge, yet most of this knowledge remains locked in PDFs that are optimized for human reading rather than machine use. For Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), the core challenge is not only perception, but representation: scientific pages interleave text with Structured Academic Elements (SAEs) such as tables, formulas, charts, and pseudocode, whose structure, data, and logic are poorly preserved by common surrogates like Markdown. We therefore propose Compilable Academic Document Parsing (CADP), a paradigm that reconstructs a full page as contextual \LaTeX{} plus executable Python, so that structure-preserving elements and executable chart representations can be reconstructed, recompiled, and directly verified against the source page. To support this setting, we introduce CADP-Bench, an expert-verified benchmark of full academic pages containing tightly coupled text and multiple SAE types, evaluated through a re-injection compilation protocol. We further study current capabilities using SOTA MLLMs and an exploratory multi-agent baseline that incorporates common agentic techniques. Results show that even frontier models still struggle to produce high-fidelity executable reconstructions, highlighting substantial room for improvement in structure-aware scientific document parsing. CADP-Bench is released for future research.

articles.title_zh: 代表守则: 学术文件可编译解析范式
articles.content_zh: 学术论文是科学知识的主要载体,然而,这些知识大多仍然被锁定在PDF中,这些PDF被优化为人类阅读而非机器使用. 对于多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs),核心挑战不仅在于感知,而且在于表现:科学页与结构化学术元素(SAEs),如表格,公式,图表,以及伪码等文本互换,其结构,数据和逻辑被Markdown等常见代词保存不佳. 因此,我们提出可编译学术文档解析(CADP),这个范式将整页重建为背景\LaTeX{}+可执行 Python,这样结构保存元素和可执行图表表达可以重建,重新编译,直接对照源页面进行校验. 为支持这一设置,我们采用了CADP-Bench,这是经专家验证的全学术页面基准,包含紧密结合的文本和多种SAE类型,通过重新注入汇编协议进行评估. 我们利用SOTA MLLMs和包含共同剂技术的探索性多剂基线,进一步研究目前的能力。 结果显示,即使是前沿模型也仍然难以进行高可靠性的可执行重建,突出表明了在结构意识科学文件分析方面有很大的改进余地。 CADP-Bench发布 未来研究.

articles.title: CoAL-RAG: A Complexity-Aware Legal Retrieval-Augmented Generation Method
articles.content: Legal consultation questions exhibit multi-level complexity. A single retrieval strategy often leads to over-reasoning for simple questions and poor interpretability for complex ones, making it difficult to meet the requirements for both answer quality and efficiency in high-risk scenarios. To address this issue, this paper proposes CoAL-RAG, a complexity-aware legal retrieval-augmented generation method, which constructs a multi-dimensional evaluation mechanism based on ``question essence'' and ``retrieval consistency'' to enable adaptive routing of retrieval strategies. First, the reasoning demand is quantified according to the logical structure of the question. Then, the discrepancy between semantic retrieval and keyword retrieval is utilized to indirectly reflect problem complexity, thereby selecting the most appropriate retrieval strategy and dynamically filtering contextual information. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms baseline models not only on Chinese legal benchmarks (SocialLawQA, LawBench) but also demonstrates strong cross-jurisdictional generalization on English datasets (LexGLUE, CaseHold). Specifically, on Chinese datasets, the BLEU score improves by 42.5\% and ROUGE-L reaches 3.6 times that of knowledge graph-based methods. On English benchmarks, CoAL-RAG maintains highly competitive accuracy, achieving an optimal balance between generation quality, deep logical reasoning, and system efficiency across different legal systems.

articles.title_zh: CoAL-RAG: 复杂- 了解法律检索- 增强生成方法
articles.content_zh: 法律咨询问题具有多层次的复杂性。 单一的检索战略往往导致对简单问题提出过多的理由,对复杂问题解释不当,因此在高风险情况下难以满足回答质量和效率的要求。 为解决这一问题,本文件建议建立“法律检索——RAG”系统,这是一种具有复杂性的法律检索——增强生成方法,它构建了一个基于“问题实质”和“检索一致性”的多维评价机制,以便适应检索战略的路径。 首先,推理需求是根据问题的逻辑结构量化的. 然后,语义检索和关键字检索之间的差异被用来间接反映问题的复杂性,从而选择最适当的检索策略和动态过滤背景信息. 实验结果表明,拟议的方法不仅大大超过了中国法律基准(SocialLawQA,Law Bench)的基准模型,而且显示出了在英语数据集(LexGLUE, CaseHold)上强有力的跨法域通用. 具体来说,在中国数据集上,BLEU得分提高42.5\%,ROUGE-L达到以知识图表为基础的方法的3.6倍. 在英语基准上,CoAL-RAG保持高度竞争性的准确性,在不同法律制度的生成质量、深层逻辑推理和系统效率之间实现最佳平衡。

articles.title: ArborMem: Navigating Interaction States with Memory Forests
articles.content: Large language models increasingly serve as persistent conversational assistants, requiring memory that preserves relevant experience and maintains continuity across interactions. Existing methods improve access to conversational history through long-context processing, selective retrieval, and structured memory organization. However, most systems treat memory access as retrieving relevant past information without first determining which prior interaction state the current turn resumes. This limitation becomes particularly important when conversations interleave multiple tasks, people, and plans that may be interrupted and later revisited. We introduce ArborMem, an online memory framework that represents a long-running conversation as a navigable forest of interaction states. Each branch preserves a locally coherent trajectory, while the forest maintains multiple trajectories that may later be resumed. For each new input, ArborMem localizes the relevant state, restores its branch-local context, and augments it with reusable evidence retrieved across branches, preserving interaction continuity without conflating semantically related but structurally distinct trajectories. Existing long-term memory benchmarks cover diverse memory and reasoning capabilities but do not explicitly isolate branch-structured challenges. We therefore introduce BranchMemEval, a controlled diagnostic benchmark for interleaved and resumable interaction trajectories. Experiments on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, BEAM 100K, and BranchMemEval show that ArborMem outperforms the strongest baselines by 3.36 to 10.31 percentage points on the three established benchmarks and by 5.0 points on BranchMemEval. Its advantage grows under constrained read budgets, while complete memory queries remain below half a second.
